rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan/dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang*/rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul/phyag rdor dregs pa zil gnon/

tei:div.tei:p: rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan/ dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang*/ rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul/ phyag rdor dregs pa zil gnon/

oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /gser gling nor mdzod las byon rdor sems dang*/ /'dong chu byams pa'i snyan byon gu drag skor/ /pha wang rta mgo nas thon rta mgrin dang*/ /brag nag lha rtse'i gter byon phyag rdor bcas/ /yi dam 'thor bu'i chos sde'i them byang 'god/ de'ang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa las/ 'di ni yi dam zhi ba rdo sems thar lam lnga ldan dang*/ gu drag pad+ma yang gsang*/ rta mchog rol pa nyi ma'i snying po/ phyag rdor dregs pa zil gnon bcas rim par bkod pa la bzhi/ dang po rdzogs chen 'khor yongs grol las/ de'ang gzhung las/ rdzogs chen ma bsgoms sangs rgyas lag 'chang dang : longs sku'i zhing khams rang lus ngo sprod rnams: da lta skal ldan bu la gdams nas kyang : phyi rabs ma rig sems can rmu rgod la: nyon mongs dug lnga sel ba'i sman du bzhag: ces gsungs pa bzhin rdzogs chen 'khor yongs grol gyi cha lag /thar lam lnga ldan 'don chog tsam las da cha mi snang bas 'dir rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi them byang 'god pa la/ ka) rdo rje sems dpa'i brgyud 'debs bde chen thar pa'i them skas/ kha) rdor sems gsol 'debs prañdza'i ming gi mdzad pa/ ga) rdzogs pa chen po 'khor 'das yongs grol las: rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan/ nga) yan lag bdun pa dang bgegs gtor byin rlabs/ ca) byin 'beb pra dz+nyās mdzad pa/ cha) bdud rtsi lag mchod/ ja) bzlas dmigs shrī ming gis mdzad pa/ nya) bum sgrub/ ta) rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol las/ rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi zur 'gebs su zung bzhi'i skong bshags/ tha) rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol gyi rdor sems tshogs 'bum gsog thabs mchod sprin dbyings grol/ da) gtang rag mchod bstod/ na) gnas 'dren bde chen thar pa'i lam bgrod/

pa) rdzogs pa chen po 'khor 'das yongs grol las/ rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi cho ga'i 'don khrigs blo dman 'jug bde bcas chos tshan bcu bzhi bzhugs so/ ༈ gnyis pa ma hā gu ru pad+ma drag pos chos skor drag po gnam lcags 'khor lo'i chos sde'i them byang 'god pa la/ ka) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po las: rgyud gnam lcags me ri dmar po/ kha) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po las: dbang mchog gnam lcags go khrab/ ga) yang gsang dregs 'dul gnam lcags me 'khor las: rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub/ nga) gu ru drag po gnam lcags 'khor lo'i: gtum po klu 'dul gyi gsang sgrub bsdus pa/ ca) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang gi brgyud 'debs dbang chen dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs/ cha) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po las: las byang gnam lcags me yi 'khor lo/ ja) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang gi byin 'bebs/ nya) srung bzlog dmigs pa/ ta) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po las: cha lag gter srung mchod thabs/ tha) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po las: smad las me yi spu gri dmar po/ da) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po las: khyung nag me yi spu gri'i sgrub thabs/ na) gu ru gnam lcags me 'khor gyi smad las zur 'geb kha gsab/ pa) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po las/ rgyun gyi nyams len rnal 'byor srog tig /pha) rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsol 'debs/ ba) rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub 'don khrigs su bkod pa rngam pa'i rta skad/ ma) gu ru drag po gnam lcags 'khor lo'i gtum po klu 'dul gyi gsang sgrub rgyun khyer bcas chos tshan bco lnga bzhugs so/ ༈ gsum pa gsung rigs rta mgrin gi chos skor rta mchog rol pa nyi ma'i snying po ni/ gzhung las/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: klu srin sa bdag 'byung po 'khrugs: mi rung sna dgu rims yams dar: rgya nad bdun drug 'tshubs pa'i tshe: de dag 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru:

khro rgyal nā ga klu 'dul gyi: tshig nyung don 'brel byin rlabs che: drag sngags kun gyi mthar thug nyid: ces gsungs pa bzhin rta mchog nyi ma'i snying po'i chos sde'i them byang 'god pa la/ ka) dbang chen rta mchog rol pa nā ga klu 'dul gyi sngon 'gro skyabs yul gsol 'debs/ kha) rta mchog rol pa nyi ma'i snying po las: las byang yang gsang snying po/ ga) rta mchog rol pa'i snying po las: hūm̐ sgrub yang gsang*/ nga) zur 'gebs srung dmigs/ ca) bka' srung shan pa spun gsum gyi gsol mchod/ cha) rta mchog rol pa'i snying po las: smad las dug rlangs nag po bcas chos tshan drug bzhugs so// // ༈ bzhi pa gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i chos skor dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon chos sde'i them byang 'god pa la/ gnas ri so dgu ma las/ lci rgyud smug po lha rtse'i gnas mchog nas/ /phyag rdor dregs brgyad las mtha' gdan drangs tshe/ /nā ga rak+shas gter rgya dngos su phul/ zhes dang*/ kong yul lha lung brag gi gnas mchog nas/ /dregs pa phyag rdor chos ka bzhes pa'i tshe/ /kong btsun de mos gter gyi rgya grogs mdzad/ ces gsungs pa bzhin rtsa ba phyag rdor gyi chos sde gter gnas gnyis su byon yang*/ phal cher lag tu ma son/ da cha thor bu rnyed rigs kyi them byang ni/ ka) dpal chen dregs zil gyi gsol 'debs/ kha) dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las: las byang gnam lcags rdo rje'i go cha/ ga) dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las: khyab 'jug gtor 'bul byad ma rtsad brlag /nga) dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las: skong ba bar chad kun sel/ ca) dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las: smad las pha rol byad ma rgol 'joms bcas chos tshan bzhi bzhugs so/ slar smras pa/ gang dang gang du dam chos 'jigs pa der/ /me tshogs spu gri'i so yang brgal nas ni/ /'chi mthar thug gi bar du dam chos btsal/ /gsung bzhin 'bad pas btsal la phyogs gcig bkod/

/de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*/ /gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /gnam lcags zab gter gang de'i gtsos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e wam̐ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog / ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga'i grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyis skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // ka) rdo rje sems dpa'i brgyud 'debs bde chen thar pa'i them skas bzhugs so/ e ma hoḥ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /chos sku kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ /sna tshogs ma 'gags sprul pa'i pho brang nas/ /longs sku rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /pad 'byung yab yum sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /ke ri gsang ba mchog gi pho brang nas/ /ḍāk+ki mtsho rgyal sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas mchog yang rdzong shel gyi sgrub phug nas/ /dpal chen sangs rgyas ye shes la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab rgya sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i pho brang nas/ /karma las 'brel rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /chos bdag brgyud 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng nas/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang lus rtsa khams dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod gnas mchog nas/ /dam chos 'khor 'das yongs grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /mthu ldan dgra bgegs tshar gcod gnas mchog nas/

/bka' srung gter bdag rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol btab bden pa'i mthu byin gyis/ /bdag sogs skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs kun/ /'khrul med phyag rdzogs dgongs pa'i btsan sa zin/ /rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sa lam yongs bgrod nas/ /kun bzang klong du 'ub chud sangs rgyas shog / ces pa'ang rtogs ldan dkon rnam nas bkra shis pa'i lha reg bcas nan bskul ngor bka' ma ldog tsam dz+nyā na shrī bha dra'i ming nas sbyar ba'o// // kha) na mo badz+ra sa twa gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ye/ rigs kun khyab bdag kun bzang rdo rje 'chang*/ /rigs lnga zhi khro gsang bdag las kyi dbang*/ /bka' bab rig 'dzin chen po rnam brgyad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /rtsa gsum kun 'dus rdo rje thod phreng rtsal/ /dbyings phyug mtsho rgyal rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang*/ /gter bdag gling pa thugs mchog rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /skal ldan chos bdag rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams/ /rigs 'dus rdor sems dam pa rigs brgya dang*/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can gter bdag la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /snang grags rtog tshogs dkyil 'khor gsum du dag /rtsa rlung thig le dhū ti'i srog tu rdzogs/ /sku dang ye shes khyab brdal chen por smin/ /bdud bzhi rtsad gcod phyag rgya'i mchog 'grub shog / dbang blang ba ni/ bla ma'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las/ /'od 'phros rang gi gnas gsum thim/ /sgrib dag dbang dang dngos grub thob/ /snyoms zhugs bde stong ngo bor zhu/ /rang thim ye shes rgyud la smin/ /'od gsal gnyug ma'i dbyings la bzhag a a āḥ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*/ /'bral med chos kyi? sa dang lam? rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pra dz+nyā'i ming gis so/ ga) rdzogs pa chen po 'khor 'das yongs grol las: rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba'i sku: rol pa'i thugs las longs sku'i rnam rol ston: gang de'i mchog sprul pad+ma saṃ bha'i zhabs: ma 'ongs sems can 'dul dka'i mun sel btab: bkra shis byin chags bgyid pa'i gnas gang rung du: dkyil 'khor sa gzhi rgyas la lag len gzhan du gsal: kun tshang mchod pa sna lnga sna bdun bsham: bum rdzas tshang zhing dbang gi las rim bsags: de nas sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun 'phags pa'i tshogs: chos longs sprul gsum gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ sems can pha ma rigs drug 'khrul 'khor rnams: sdug bsngal kun bral bde ldan mchog reg pa'i: ma nor byang chub sa lam la 'god phyir: zung 'jug bde chen mchog tu sems bskyed do: gsum pa: hūm̐: bdag ni khro rgyal 'bar ba dbang gi sku: ye shes gsang gsum mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: byang chub dngos grub sgrub la bar gcod bgegs: mchod sbyin khyer la so sor rang gnas gshegs: om̐ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa gnod byed sarba u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las mi shigs rdo rje'i sku: ye shes las grub sra mkhregs pha lam ltar: mi shigs 'khor lo me ri mtshon cha'i gur: phyi nang sprul pa'i khro bos mtshams chod cig: om̐ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐: lnga pa: hūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul spyan gzigs lha mi'i tshogs: dpag med nam mkha'i khyon khengs kun bzang sprin: gzung 'dzin 'khri ba'i bag chags kun sbyangs nas: bla med bde gshegs mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ?shab+da āḥhūm̐: drug pa: hūm̐: thabs shes bde stong bhan+dha rab 'khyil dbus: byang sems dkar dmar bde chen bdud rtsi'i sprin: sbyor sgrol sman raka ting 'dzin tshogs gtor 'di:

sbyangs spel bsgyur ba'i ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ sarba a haṃ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza khā hi: bdun pa ni: hūm̐: sku gsum byin phob dbang bskur dngos grub stsol: ye shes sgo phyes 'khrul pa'i sgo bcad nas: dkyil 'khor mchod cing phyag 'tshal mi btang bsgrub: snang stong lha skur rtogs kyang sdig bshags bgyid: om̐ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐ sa twa āḥ brgyad pa: hūm̐: kun bzang rgyal ba ye sangs rgyas: āḥ 'gags med longs sku rang rtsal rdzogs: om̐: sgyu ma'i zung 'jug gsal snang dag: hrīḥ gnyis bsdus snang srid kun la khyab: om̐ ma hā shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na dharma hūm̐: dgu pa ni: hūm̐: nam mkha' rlung me sa chu las: dbang chen ri rab rdo rje'i gzhi: me ri dur khrod phyi nang rdzogs: 'khor lo pad nyi zla gdan dbus: ye shes sprul pa'i gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang : chos 'khor 'dod snam rtsig pa dang : pha gu drwa phyed rin chen brgyan: mda' yab pu shu bang rim ldan: ka gdung bla bre 'phan gdugs tshang : dbus su rin chen sna lnga'i tog: sgo rdzogs mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs tshang : phyi dang nang med zang thal klong : 'ja' 'od ye shes lnga ldan gtibs: de nang rma bya seng glang rta: khyung chen sde lnga'i khri 'phang du: zla ba'i lte bar yi ge hūm̐: gnas 'gyur rdo rje pad+mar gyur: de nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su rang nyid longs sku rdo rje sems: dkar gsal zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan 'bar: dbu skra smug 'bol spyi bor brgyan: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rigs bdag mthing : phyag gnyis snang stong rdor dril brten: sku lus 'od stong spyan ras gzigs: che mchog zhi khro rigs brgya rdzogs: ye shes na bza' cod pan 'phur: phyed skyil bde stong ting 'dzin ngang : gnas lnga rigs lnga'i longs spyod rdzogs: rtsa sgor rta mgrin dbyug tho dmar: gsang bar dbyings phyug bde bar sbyor:

sngon mo lang tsho mnyen lcug ldem: zil chags yab la spyan gzigs mdzes: skra grol rat+na'i cod pan 'phur: phyag gnyis mgul 'khyud gri thod 'dzin: spyan stong khengs pa'i 'ja' gur dbus: yum chen brgya rtsa bye ba stong : rgyan drug ga shal chas rdzogs mdzes: zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril: rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor bas: bde ba bskul zhing mi rtog 'char: zung 'jug gzi brjid cher rgyas bsgom: gnas lngar rigs lnga'i lha mo mdzes: phyogs bzhi ke'u ri yab yum brgyad: rang rtags phyag rgyas brgyan zhing 'gying : mtshams bzhir skyong ma mkha' 'gro bzhi: gri thod rgyan ldan 'gying stabs bzhugs: phyi rim thub pa rigs drug ni: 'gro drug skyabs mchis tshul du gsal: sgo bzhir stag seng khyung 'brug bzhi: rang rtags rgyan ldan rol stabs bsgom: de ltar dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha: dran snang chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: 'od zer dpag yas sprin 'tshubs bzhin: thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phro 'du las: skad cig gnas nas spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa twa bud+dha dz+nyā na sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bcu pa ni: dbang lha rigs lnga 'og min zhing nas byon: khrus bstsal sgrib dag dbu rgyan cod pan thob: byin rlabs dbang bskur dngos grub mchog thob nas: zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lha ru byin gyis rlobs: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

dang po spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: rnam dag chos sku g.yo med spros bral las: sna tshogs longs sku rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: gnyis bsdus sprul pa 'gro don yid snang phyir: kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis pa ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin dbyings la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang : sna tshogs thabs kyis sems can mun sel ba: kun tu snang ba rdo rje dkyil 'khor lha: dbyer med brtan par bzhugs shing chos 'khor bskor: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: gsum pa ni: hūm̐: drug pa khyab brdal kun gzhi brda yi chos: kun 'dus yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bag chags 'dag bya'i phyir: yul 'dzin ngo bo dag la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pu ho: bzhi pa ni: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos ma: zhal zas sil snyan gzugs sgra dri ro reg: glu ma gar ma sgeg mo phreng 'dzin sogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul: om̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: lnga pa ni: hūm̐: stong gsum rab 'byams ri rab gling khams nas: rgyal srid rin chen bkra shis rtags brgyad rdzas: phyi nang spyan gzigs kun tshang mchod pa'i sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul: om̐ badz+ra rā ni ta saṃ pra ra ni ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: drug pa ni: rang byung snod yangs mchog tu bskyil ba yi: dkar dmar byang sems pañtsa kun sbyar nas: sman raka gtor tshogs sbyor sgrol mchod pa 'di: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul: om̐ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: bdun pa ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: kun bzang klong nas zhi dang khro gar sprul: 'gro don yid snang dbyer med rdo rje sems:

kun 'dus yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dug lnga rnam dag rigs lnga longs spyod rdzogs: 'byung lnga rnam dag yum lnga so sor gsal: yab yum sku la zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: rtsa khams 'khor lo'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: kau rī tsau ri la sogs dbang phyug ging : sgo ba sgo ma sprul sku thub pa drug: mtshams dang laṅka la sogs 'gro 'dul gyi: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsnyen pa ni: om̐ gu ru bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: zhes rtags ma byung bar du bzlas: dang po tshogs chu gtsang gis bran zhing byin gyis brlabs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin rdo rje 'khrul med thugs ka nas: 'od 'phros sbyangs nas tshogs rdzas bdud rtsir gyur: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor zhing khams rab 'byams lha: byin gyis brlab phyir tshogs la gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gnyis pa ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha la zhal zas tshogs mchod 'bul: phyi nang spyan gzigs mchod pas thugs dam bskang : ru tra bsgral ba bzhes so nyes skyon bshags: gzigs mdzes rol cig dngos grub a la la: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra khā hi: ga ṇa shud+dhe hoḥ sid+dhi a la la hoḥ gsum pa ni: hūm̐: dpal gyi dam bzhag lhag sdud ma: bhan+dha'i skyogs thogs dur khrod nyul: mi sdug gzugs 'chang rngam pa'i tshogs: lhag ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: om̐ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa khā hi: bzhi pa ni: hūm̐: bzhengs shig rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: thugs rjes sems can 'dul slad du: ye shes rol pa'i rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: deng sang thugs dam tha tshig bskul: om̐ ma hā gu ru dz+nyā na hoḥ lnga pa ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe bar bskal tha ma dus gsum la: kun bzang rdor sems pad+ma yab yum gyis: dkyil 'khor zhal phyes dregs pas khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig phrin las mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐ bha ling+ta khā hi: drug pa: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bod khams skyong ba'i ma sring bdud sman tshogs:

gzugs mdzes gar sgyur glu len drod nyul ma: stag tshang mchims phur dbang rtags khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la gsang sngags mel tshe mdzod: ma ma hring hring phaiṃ phaiṃ dza bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: bdun pa: hūm̐: gtor gzhong 'og tu gnod byed dam sri khug: zhi khro'i bro brdungs dam sri thal bar brlag: nam yang mi ldang rdo rje'i rgyas gdab bo: rnam rtog mtshan ma'i chos nyid tshar chod cig: om̐ āḥnan hūm̐ nan satwaṃ bha ya nan dz+nyā na hoḥ de nas dbang bskur ba ni: slob mar khrus byas la: kyaiḥ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yi: dkyil 'khor smin pa'i dbang mchog dag: dam ldan bu la gnang bar stsol: phyin chad bskyed rdzogs rgyud la gnas: bla mas: hoḥ bum pa 'di nyid gzhal yas khang : bdud rtsi yi dam lha yi tshogs: khyod kyi gnas lngar bzhag pa yis: dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: dkyil 'khor ngo sprod: hoḥ slob ma mi dmigs rdo rje yis: zhi khro snang ba'i skur gyur nas: khyod kyi bag chags dbyings su yal: dkyil 'khor mi dmigs gsal bar sgoms: hūm̐: 'og min zhing nas zhi khro spyi bor byon: byin gyis rlobs shig lus kun bdud rtsis khengs: rtsa gnas lhar gsal mi rtog bskyed byed cing : sku gsum ye shes mngon gsum thob gyur cig: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ rtsa sngags brjod: a be sha ya a āḥ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: rgyas gdab: hūm̐: chos sku bum pa'i lto ba ru: rdor sems zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: skal ldan bu yi spyi bor bskur: bskyed rim sku yi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: hūm̐: thabs shes bhan+dha mtshan ldan 'di: bdud rtsi sngags phreng gsung dbyangs rdzogs: skal ldan bu yi mgrin par bskur: bzlas brjod sngags kyi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: hūm̐: shel rdo chos dbyings dkyil 'khor te: bde stong yan lag ngo sprod rdzogs: skal ldan bu yi snying gar bskur:

yongs rdzogs ka dag dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: hūm̐: gnyis med rmad byung yon tan rdzogs: kun 'dus gtor ma phrin las dbang : skal ldan bu la yongs rdzogs bskur: las bzhi'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: rtsa sngags: hūm̐: chos skur 'gro 'dul longs spyod rdzogs: gang 'dul thabs mkhas der ston pa: skal ldan bu la smin byas nas: 'gro 'dul re skong bkra shis shog: gtso bo'i ji ltar? sogs nas maṇ+ḍal rgyas par 'bul zhing gtang rag bya'o: bshags pa ni: hūm̐: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la: 'gal zhing cho ga lhag chad phud nyams sogs: las ngan bag chags skyon can ma dag sogs: rig pa rdor sems dkyil 'khor lha la bshags: om̐ badz+ra sa twa ?yig brgya brjod brtan bzhugs bya: hūm̐: gzugs rnams snang stong sgra rnams grags stong ngang : yid rnams dran rtog bskyed rdzogs sgyu ma'i lus: dkyil 'khor mi dmigs hūm̐ dang na dā yal: ma bcos lhun grub chos dbyings ngang la gnas: a a āḥ hoḥ ma rig 'khrul 'khor rigs drug sems can rnams: phan bde'i byang chub lam mchog bgrod pa'i phyir: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dge ba bsod nams tshogs: sa bcu byang chub go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo: na mo: 'khor gsum yongs dag rdor sems zhi khro yi: dkyil 'khor byang chub dam pa 'di bsgrubs pas: mtha' yas ma gyur 'gro kun sdug bsngal gyi: rgya mtshor bsgral nas sangs rgyas thob par shog: hūm̐: skyabs gsum ngo bo dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha: zhi khro rigs brgya'i bka' srung gter bdag gis: bar chad sel zhing chos bdag spel ba'i yul: bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: ces bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab: dbang gi las rim 'grub pa'i cha rkyen bcol: e ma nyon dang rje 'bangs ye shes gsum: rdzogs chen ma bsgoms sangs rgyas lag 'chang dang : longs sku'i zhing khams rang lus ngo sprod rnams: da lta skal ldan bu la gdams nas kyang :

phyi rabs ma rig sems can rmu rgod la: nyon mongs dug lnga sel ba'i sman du bzhag: gsang shog thob la rin chen gter su sbos: bka' yi srung ma e ka tsa ti dang : gter srung dge bsnyen bzhi dang shan pa spun: dam chos 'di yi bstan pa'i mel tshe mdzod: ye shes mtsho rgyal sras mchog karma hūm̐: las can smon lam ldan pa'i bu la sprod: skal ngan blo log dam nyams dbang po snubs: thub par srungs shig e ka tsa ti rgya: gtad par gyis shig a du tsa ti rgya: gu h+ya rgya: bka' rgya: thob rgya: lung rgya: gtad rgya: mi nub rgya: dam rgya: spel rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra karma las 'brel rtsal gyis gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// // nga) ༈ yan lag bdun pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrang ba'i dge ba rnams/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ tshad med bzhi ni/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral gyur cig /bde dang bral bar ma gyur cig /btang snyoms chen por gnas gyur cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams 'od zhu rang la thim par gyur: ces brjod/ ༈ bgegs gtor la/ om̐ sarba bigh+nān a kar+ṣa dzaḥ om̐ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs lan gsum gyis bsngo/ ca) ༈ byin dbab pa ni/

hūm̐/ 'og min lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas/ /kun bzang chos sku'i lha tshogs byin phob cig /ma 'gags dbyings rig zang thal pho brang nas/ /longs sku rdor sems lha tshogs byin phob cig /ma bcos sku lnga rang byung pho brang nas/ /sprul sku dga' rab rdo rjes byin phob cig /gang 'dul thugs rje mngon shar pho brang nas/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba kun 'dus byin phob cig /rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /rje btsun pad 'byung yab yum byin phob cig /mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas mchog nas/ /ḍāk+ki ye shes mtsho rgyal byin phob cig /bod yul dben gnas so so'i sgrub gnas nas/ /rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lngas byin phob cig /zab rgya sgo 'phar gter gyi pho brang nas/ /karma las 'brel rtsal gyis byin phob cig /dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /chos bdag rgyud 'dzin rnams kyis byin phob cig /spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng nas/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla mas byin phob cig /rang lus rtsa khams dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs byin phob cig /gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod gnas mchog nas: /dam chos 'khor 'das yongs grol byin phob cig /mthu ldan dgra bgegs tshar gcod gnas mchog nas/ /bka' srung gter bdag rnams kyis byin phob cig: las bzhi dam tshig gnyan po'i pho brang nas/ /yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i lha tshogs byin phob cig /chos sku'i byin 'bebs thugs rje sha ra ra/ /longs sku'i byin 'bebs bkrag mdangs ta la la/ /sprul sku'i byin 'bebs bag dro me re re/ /rig 'dzin byin 'bebs thugs rje spungs se spung*/ /dkyil 'khor byin 'bebs dpal 'bar lams se lam/ /gnas 'dir byin chen phob la dbang chen bskur/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dza/ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes byin 'bebs 'di yang rang gzhung rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i byin 'bebs kha bsgyur te pra dz+nyā'i ming gis sbyar ba'o/

cha) ༈ sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ khyab bdag bla ma kun tu bzang po mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab rdo rje la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen shrī singha dang*/ /pad+ma thod phreng mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ /rtsa gsum gling pa thugs mchog rdo rje la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /mi 'jigs rdo rje snyan grags rgya mtsho dang*/ /gsang sngags bstan rgyal tshe dbang 'dus pa rtsal/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /bka' bab lung bstan mkhyen rab grags pa'i zhabs/ /rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma thams cad la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /rigs bdag rdor sems dam pa rigs brgya dang*/ /yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /chos skyong srung ma dam can rgya mtsho dang*/ /nor lha gter bdag yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag /sman mchod 'bul lo phrin las rnam bzhi stsol/ bdud rtsi'i thig le gnas gsum du bkod la/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ bdud rtsi lce thog tu myong la/ badz+ra a mṛ ta sid+dhi m+mepra yats+tsha/ zhes pa 'di yang dkon rnam nas g.yu dang bcas bskul ngor pra dz+nyā'i ming gis sbyar ba'o/ ja) ༈ bzlas dmigs mdun bskyed dang sbrel na/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: gis 'dzab khang dbye/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ yig la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi rdor sems yab yum lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i thugs brgyud bskul te de rnams kyi mdun bskyed dwangs ma'i thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros phyogs bcu dus bzhi bde gshegs sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas bdag mdun gyi lha rnams la thim pas gzi byin mchog tu 'bar bas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mched lcam rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag bshags/

dam can chos skyong dregs pa can rnams dbang du bsdus/ phrin las rnam bzhi 'bad med du bsgrubs/ yang 'od zer rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas so so'i las dang rgyu mthun gyi rnam smin sdug bsngal sdig ltung nyams chag thams cad lhag med du sbyangs nas phyi nang snod bcud thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par gyur par bsams la/ om̐ gu ru bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: zhes rtags ma byung bar du bzlas: yi ge brgya pa ci mang bzla'o/ zhes dkon rnam nas lha reg bcas nan bskul ngor/ shrī ming gis rdor sems thun mtshams su bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ //

nya) ༈ dbang dang sbrel tshe gzhung ltar bum chog bya'o/ hūm̐: bum pa mtshan nyid kun tshang gzhal yas khang : bum nang zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gsal: bdud rtsi rang bzhin dbang lha rim zhu thim: sngags 'khor mchod bstod dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: ci mang bzla'o/ ta) ༈ rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol las/ rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi zur 'gebs su zung bzhi'i skong bshags bzhugs so/ gu ru badz+ra sa twa ya na mo/ rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi bdag /sems dpa' srid gsum mgon gcig pu/ /rigs kun khyab bdag der btud nas/ /zur 'gebs khrigs su ldeb pa bri/ 'dir rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi cho ga nyams su len pa la gsum las/ rnal 'byor pa 'jug pa'i sbyor ba/ zhugs pa'i cho ga dngos so/ cho ga'i yan lag gzhan du bshad pa'o/ dang po ni/ sku rten bris 'bur gang rung bkram pa'i mdun du/ stegs bu kheb can gyi steng du ras bris sam/ 'bru tshom lha grangs bkod pa'i steng du bla gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa rgyan spros can nam rtsa gsum spyi gtor gang rung*/ bum pa bcud ldan mgul chings can/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka /mdun du chad brtan/ bskul/ gter srung ma gza' dam gsum/ phyi mchod sna bdun sngon 'gro/ tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor bsags/ gnas lung dang sbrel tshe/ mtshan byang bye til yungs dkar sbyong chas/ me long khrus gzhung las bum zas bsngo mar me sogs 'du bya gnyis pa cho ga dngos/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po brgyud 'debs nas brtsams sbyor ba dngos gzhi'i cho ga las byang bzlas pa yan song nas/ 'dir las sbyor gyi bzlas pa bya bar spro na/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dang thugs rje'i 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas/ ngan song rnams sbyangs/ bdag gzhan dmigs yul gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing du bsgral bar gyur/

yi ge brgya pa'i sham bu'i mthar/ om̐ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces btags pa bzlas pas/ gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yang snying yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba nyams chag dang rtog sgrib thams cad sbyong bar byed pa 'di bzlas pas rnal 'byor pa rtog sgrib can/ nyams chag can/ gsog 'jog can/ bag chags ngan pa can khyed rnams kyi nyams chag bskangs te ngan song du ltung ba'i las kyi sgrib pa las thar bar 'gyur ro/ tshe 'di la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras kyi dam pa dgongs nas bsrung zhing skyob par mdzad la/ shi 'phos nas kyang bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras kyi thu bor 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o/ zhes gnang ba byin par bsam/ gnyis pa 'khor ba dong sprugs ni: lha tshogs rnams kyi sbyor mtshams nas: ye shes 'od zer 'phros pa yis: rigs drug sa bon bag chags bsregs: bde gshegs rigs drug zhing du gyur: yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭha te sarba pā paṃ a wa ra ṇa bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā: gong gi da ha sogs gsum dang*/ om̐ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha sarba nṛ ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ traṭa traṭa sarba a su ra ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba su ra ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzlas so/ gsum pa ltung ba bshags pa dang*/ spyir sdom pa gsum dang 'gal bar bshags pa dang*/ bye brag sngags kyi rtsa ltung la 'gal bar bshags pa'o/ sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i las gang bgyis par gnong 'gyod drag pos snying thag pa nas/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dge 'dun btsun pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol lo/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang*/

zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang*/ ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang*/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal bar bgyis pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal bar bgyis pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal bar bgyis pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa bgyis pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skur pa btab pa dang*/ pha dang ma la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ grogs tshangs par mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la ma gus pa bgyis pa la sogs te/ mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing*/ 'khor ba ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i nyes pa dang ltung ba'i tshogs ci mchis pa de dag thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ mi 'chab bo/ mi sbed do/ de ltar mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na mi 'gyur ba lags so/ zhes lan gsum gyis brjod/ gsum pa cho ga'i yan lag gi bshad pa la gnyis/ rang don tshogs bsags dang gzhan don gnas lung ngo*/ dang po la gsum/ phyag 'tshal bshags pa/ mchod pa/ bskang ba'o/ dang po tshogs zhing gsal gdab cing phyag 'tshal ba ni/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad rang mdun nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drang ba ni/ e ma hoḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi kun gyi bdag nyid che: bla ma rdor sems zhi khro yongs rdzogs dgongs: 'dir gshegs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: nyams chag na rag sbyang phyir phyag mchod bzhes: hoḥ bdag lus phung po bsdus bya sgyu ma yi: shes sgrib bag chags ma lus sbyang slad du:

rtsa khams zhing khams lha ru mos byas nas: rtse gcig gdung ba drag pos phyag 'tshal lo: bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: skye med chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: ci yang sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mngon par byang chub sku la phyag 'tshal lo: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: che mchog zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jam dpal sku yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: pad+ma gsung gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: yang dag thugs kyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: ma mo rbod gtong lha la phyag 'tshal lo: phur pa phrin las lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bla ma rig 'dzin lha la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha la phyag 'tshal lo: dmod pa drag sngags lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bka' sdod sgo ma'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: dam can rgya mtsho'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: kun bzang klong nas zhi dang khro gar sprul: 'gro don yid snang dbyer med rdo rje sems: kun 'dus yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: kun bzang yab yum thugs rje sprul pa ni: rdor sems spyan ma la sogs rigs lnga dang : sems dpa' sems ma yab yum bcu drug bcas: thub drug sgo ba yab yum brgyad la sogs: zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: che mchog la sogs khrag 'thung yab yum dang : kau rī siṃ ha phra men brgyad rnams sogs: sgo ba yab yum dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: khrag 'thung lnga bcu brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: ka dag dbyings rig sku la phyag 'tshal lo: zang thal khyab bdag sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'od gsal bde chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo: cir yang sa le'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mngon par byang chub sku la phyag 'tshal lo: rang rig rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: 'khor 'das ye shes chen por phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid sangs rgyas zhing la phyag 'tshal lo:

snod bcud gdod ma'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sgra grags gsung dbyangs drug cur phyag 'tshal lo: gang shar gnas lugs de la phyag 'tshal lo: nyag gcig thig le chen por phyag 'tshal lo: de ltar rab gus gdung bas phyag byas mthus: bskal pa thog ma med nas da lta'i bar: bdag sogs nyams chag sdig ltung ci bsags pa: lhag med byang nas rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sar: mngon rdzogs bla med byang chub thob par shog: gnyis pa la/ bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ tshig dbang dang sbrel ba'i bshags tshan bzhi las/ dang po ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid sgyu lus snang stong spyi bo'i steng : rig pa skye med dung mdog rdo rje sems: thabs shes phyag rgya bsnol zhing snyems ma 'khyud: skyil krung thugs kyi hūm̐ mthar yig brgyas bskor: sngags phreng 'khor zhing 'od zhu bdag la thim: bdud rtsis lus khengs bag chags g.ya' bral bsgom: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs? ma yengs brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na/ mtshams med lnga yi sdig pa 'dag /dang po ni: om̐: kṛ ya rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sgor zhugs nas: bdag lus gzhal yas khang du gnas pa yis: gnas lnga phung lnga rigs lnga yab yum ste: bskyed pa lha sku phyag rgya ma gsal zhing : gsal brtan dag gsum tshad du ma rdzogs nas: phung khams snod bcud lha ru rgyas ma thebs: rdzogs pa lus rtsa sprul sku ma rtogs nas: rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro tha mal 'dzin: rdo rje lus kyi ngo sprod ma rtogs nas: 'da' ka 'od kyi gong bu gdeng ma thob: yo ga'i bsgom don tshul bzhin ma rtogs nas: bskyed pa'i tshe na zhal phyag ma gsal zhing : rdzogs pa'i tshe na ting 'dzin ngo ma sprod: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs don dang mi ldan pas: bum dbang dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: tshogs mchod dus su ser sna'i zhen pas bcings: bskang bshags dus su bzlas brjod grangs nyung sogs: tshod yod chog shes le lo'i dbang gyur pa: bla med 'od gsal de bzhin ngang gis bshags:

dug lnga ye grol ye shes lnga ru bshags: dug gsum sku gsum mnyam nyid ngang du bshags: rnam rtog tshogs drug mi rtog dbyings su bshags: kun rtog ma rig ka dag ngang du bshags: phung khams rnam dag rigs lnga rgyal bar bshags: khams lnga rnam dag yum mchog rigs lngar bshags: 'byung lnga rnam dag lha mo lnga ru bshags: sgo dgu 'dzin rtog theg dgu'i ngang du bshags: rnam shes tshogs brgyad sems dpa' brgyad du bshags: skye mched bcu gnyis lha mo rnams la bshags: rigs drug 'khrul 'khor thub pa drug la bshags: rtag chad mu bzhi sgo ma bzhi ru bshags: 'khrul 'dzin sna tshogs dkyil 'khor lha ru bshags: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: gnyis pa ni: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo bla ma he ru kaḥ rdo rje sems dpa' nyams chag sbyong ba'i lha: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro byang sems tshogs: rigs lnga zhi khro'i lha tshogs thams cad dang : srung ma dam can tshogs bcas dgongs su gsol: bdag cag thog med dus nas da lta'i bar: ma rig sgrib pas tshor dang ma tshor gyis: sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag dang : mi dge mtshams med nyon mongs brgyad khri'i nongs: sdig pa mi dge bgyis dang bgyid du rtsal: yi rang byas shing rkyen gyur thams cad bshags: u pa man ngag gsang ba'i sgor zhugs nas: lus gnad tshogs drug lhug bzhag mi shes shing : phung khams lha skur ma rtogs rtsa khams sgrib: ngag gnad gzung 'dzin stong pa'i tshig la chags: ngag rlung sngags su ma dag srog rtsol sgrib: yid rlung dhū tir 'ching ba'i tshad ma phebs: gtum mo'i bde drod lus la ma shar ba: a nu mtha' bral gnas lugs don ma rtogs: gsang dbang dam tshig phog pa mthol lo bshags: mdor na so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi: sdom pa dam tshig nyams chag ci mchis kun: gnong 'gyod nongs pas mthol bshags phyin chad sdom: dag tshang sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol:

gsum pa ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i rig ma dgongs su gsol: dga' bzhi'i gnas gter rdo rje pho nya mo: thabs ldan las kyi phyag rgyar byin ma brlabs: snang stong yab yum zung 'jug mi shes shing : dbyings rig yab yum phyi nang ris su phyes: gsal stong yab yum ngang rgyun ma bsrings nas: bde stong ro la chags pas ting 'dzin bsgribs: dga' bzhi bcu drug bde stong nyams ma myong : dbab ldog 'dren dkram gnad du ma khel zhing : zag med lhan skyes ma mthong bdud rtsi nyams: sbyor ba'i tshe na bde stong dbye gsal dka': sgrol ba'i tshe na snying rje'i bag chags zhan: 'khrul gzugs rmongs pas mu stegs spyod par shor: ma hā bde ba chen po'i don ma rtogs: sher dbang dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: rtsa ltung bcu bzhi ni/ gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang gsungs/ /de bas de la brnyas pa ni/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang por bshad/ /dang po phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni/ /ltung ba gnyis pa yin par bshad/ /gnyis pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /rdo rje spun la khros pa ni/ /nyes par brjod pa gsum pa yin/ /gsum pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /sems can rnams la byams pa spangs/ /bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /bzhi pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /de spong pa ni lnga pa yin/ /lnga pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /chos la smod pa drug pa yin/ /drug pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba sgrogs pa bdun pa yin/ /bdun pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /phung po sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid/ /de la smod pa brgyad pa yin/ /brgyad pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos rnams la/ /som nyi za ba dgu pa yin/ /dgu pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /gdug la rtag tu byams ldan pa/

/byed pa de ni bcu par 'dod/ /bcu pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /ming sogs bral ba'i chos rnams la/ /der rtogs pa ni bcu gcig pa/ /bcu gcig phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /sems can dad dang ldan pa la/ /sems sun 'byin pa bcu gnyis pa/ /bcu gnyis phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /dam tshig rdzas ni ji bzhin rnyed/ /mi rten pa ni bcu gsum pa/ /bcu gsum phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /shes rab rang bzhin bud med la/ /smod par byed pa bcu bzhi pa/ /bcu bzhi phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /sngags pas 'di dag spangs nas ni/ /dngos grub nges par thob par 'gyur/ yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa bshags pa ni/ ma tshig dang ni mi ldan pa/ /rig ma bsten la dga' ba dang*/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rtsod pa dang*/ /gsang ba'i chos ni ston pa dang*/ /sems can dad dang ldan pa la/ /chos gzhan du ni ston pa dang*/ /nyan thos dag tu rlom byed pa/ /nang du zhag bdun gnas pa dang*/ /sbyor ba nges pa ma byas par/ /skal min gsang ba ston pa dang*/ /gang zhig phyag rgya mi mkhas par/ /lus kyi phyag rgya ston pa dang*/ /bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas pa/ /dkyil 'khor las la 'jug pa dang*/ /sdom pa gnyis kyi bcas pa la/ /dgos pa med par 'da' ba rnams/ kha na ma tho bcas gyur te/ /sngags pa de yi dam tshig zad/ /bde ba grub par mi 'gyur zhing*/ /bdud dang sdug bsngal shin tu 'phel/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin du bzla bar bya/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo rdo rje sems: rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i lung : bka' bzhin ma spyad slob dpon smad: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig kun: mi 'chab mi sbad mthol lo bshags: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig rnams: spyad par bya ba'i dam tshig dang : de bzhin mi spangs dam tshig lnga: dwang du blang dang shes par bya: sgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig rnams: nyi shu rtsa brgyad dam tshig dang : mi 'chab mi sbad mthol lo bshags: gzhan yang pha ma mkhan slob dang :

mched lcam khams gsum sems can la: mtshams med lnga yi las byas rnams: mi 'chab mi sbad mthol lo bshags: nya stong tshes brgyad dus las 'das: bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin lta log dang : phud dang gtsang sbra ma byas pa: le lo nyams pa mthol lo bshags: nyams sgrib tshogs 'dres bgyis pa dang : shes bzhin bag med 'jol nyog sogs: sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba rnams: de ring nyid nas byang gyur cig:

bzhi pa ni: hoḥ ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas dgongs su gsol: a ti yo ga'i mtha' bral don bzung nas: lta ba ltad med rgya yan mi shes shing : bsgom pa brdal khyab 'od gsal ma rtogs nas: spyod pa mtshan ma'i bag chags snang ba bsgrubs: 'bras bu gsum gyis so sor ris su phyes: dbyings rig dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: ka dag klong la gzhal med ma rtogs shing : zang thal rig pa'i tshogs drug 'gyu ba bgag: sems kyi rang bzhin stong nyid ma rtogs nas: rnam shes rlung la mtshan ma'i lta ba 'dzin: khregs chod dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: gzhi ni 'od gsal rang ngo ma mthong zhing : sems nyid chos skur ma rtogs thig le nyams: lam ni snang bzhi zad sar ma phyin zhing : khregs chod thod rgal nyams snang tshad ma phebs: 'bras bu yang dag mngon byang ma chub cing : a ti'i lta ba klong du ma gyur pa: tshig dbang dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: lta ba ye sangs rgyas pa'i klong du bshags: sgom pa mi dmigs rgya yan klong du bshags: spyod pa gang shar ro snyom klong du bshags: gzhi ni 'od gsal ma bcos klong du bshags: lam ni zang thal 'gags med klong du bshags: 'bras bu 'khor gsum yongs dag de bzhin bshags: bshags dang bshags bya stong nyid klong du bshags: a ti klong chen lta ba'i bshags pa yis: ye grol gdod ma'i dgongs pa la gnas shog: ces mi dmigs lta ba'i ngang nas bshags: spro na bde gshegs spyi bshags bya ba ni/ om̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas: rdo rje dam can ma lus dgongs su gsol: dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin byang chub go 'phang du: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje bsgrub pa'i phyir: yi dam lha dang rdo rje slob dpon dang : gsang ba'i dam tshig grangs su mnos pa la: dam bcas bka' las 'da' bar mi bgyi ste: las dang skal bas dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang :

phrag dog la sogs shor nas nongs bgyis pa: rdo rje slob dpon bstan pa'i sgron me la: snying nas smad cing dam tshig nyams pa dang : dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje spun rnams la: ngan sems log par lta ba la sogs pa'i: sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: yi dam lha yi phyag rgya ma gsal zhing : sngags kyi bsnyen pa grangs las chad pa dang : dus drug las kyi mchod pa khyad par du: bsnyen sgrub bskang ba'i cho ga ma bgyis te: bka' ltar ma lcogs gzhung bzhin rngo ma thogs: gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: rdo rje slob dpon byams pa'i sku drin gyis: snyan khung brgyud nas sems kyi dkyil du bzhag: thugs kyi man ngag byin pas dam tshig 'dres: gsang mtshams 'das nas 'chol bar smras la sogs: thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: chos rnams mnyam pa nyid du ma rtogs te: yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: le lo snyoms las gnyid kyi dbang gyur te: bsnyen sgrub dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: lus ngag yid kyi bsrung bya 'das pa yis: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa bshags: rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: yo byad 'byor tshogs chung ba mthol lo bshags: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du: mngon rtogs spong len bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi rnams kyi spyan lam du: khas blangs dam bcas nyams pa mthol lo bshags: chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: gtor ma lo zlar 'gyangs pa mthol lo bshags: dus gsum pha ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: drin lan lan gyis ma lon mthol lo bshags: mched dang lcam dral rnams kyi spyan lam du: dam tshig brtse gdung chung ba mthol lo bshags: 'gro drug sems can rnams kyi spyan lam du: snying rje phan sems chung ba mthol lo bshags: so sor thar pa rnams kyi sdom pa dang : byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa dang :

rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig la sogs pa: 'gal zhing nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags: mi 'chab mi sbad slan chad sdom par bgyi: dus gsum byas pa'i sdig sgrib mthol bshags na: tshangs par mdzad nas sku gsung thugs la sogs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: zhes sogs yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing bshags pa bya'o: bskang bshags nyams chag rang grol cha rkyen du: zhi khro'i klong bshags brjod pa rang grol bstan: 'di la brtson par gyis shig phyi rabs bu: ma 'ongs las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: zhi khro don gyi bshags pa klong bshags brjod pa rang grol zhes bya ba: o rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: dri med bshags pa'i rgyud nas bkod pa: ji srid 'khor ba'i 'jig rten ma stongs bar: de srid dam pa'i chos 'di ma rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: karma gling pa'i gter ma'o: gsum pa la drug las: dang po phyi mchod 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu? rgyas byin gyis brlabs shing mkha' khyab tu spel: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na: yan lag brgyad ldan gtsang ma'i chab: gtsang mar spos ldan zhabs bsil mtsho: dkar dmar me tog mdangs bcud ldan: spos mchog ngad ldan bdug pa'i sprin: nyi zla mar me 'od lnga 'tsher: gser mdog 'dag chal dri yi chab: 'bru sman sbyar ba'i zhal zas brjid: rnga dung sil snyan rol mo ldir: dkar mdzes me long pad+ma 'dzin: ser mdzes ting ting pi waṃ rdung : mthing mdzes dung chos rnga yab 'dzin: dmar mdzes dri mchog zhal zas stob: ljang mdzes pañtsa li ka thogs: mthing mdzes chos 'byung spyan mdzes bsnams: thams cad gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur: dngos 'byor mchod sprin brgya rtsa brgyad: yid sprul 'khor 'das kun 'gengs 'dis: rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs dam bskang :

bskangs nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: ngan song sdig ltung lhag med sbyangs: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa yis: 'bras bu sku gsum lhun grub shog: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sarba pañtsa ku la ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: gnyis pa skong chog la lnga las/ dang po bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: phung po lnga yi bhan+dha ru: rtsa rlung thig le'i bdud rtsis gtams: chos nyid don gyi ye shes rgyun: mtshon byed rtags kyi a mṛ tas: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing rtog sgrib dag: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: gnyis pa chags bral rak+ta'i skong ba ni: hūm̐: 'khor lo lnga yi bhan+dha ru: nyon mongs rtog tshogs bsgral ba'i khrag: rang grol gshis kyi dmar chen po: snang ba brda yi rak+ta 'dis: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing rtog sgrib dag: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: gsum pa rmad byung gtor ma'i skong ba ni: āḥ 'byung 'dus las kyi gtor gzhong du: sha khrag drod dbugs gtor ma bshams: dwangs ma lnga ldan longs spyod che: 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i bha ling+tas: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing rtog sgrib dag: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā bha ling+ta khā hi: bzhi pa snang gsal mar me'i skong ba ni: hoḥ sgron me drug gi kong bu ru: phung lnga rnam dag sdong bu btsugs: rang byung ye shes mar me sbar: 'od gsal snang bzhi'i mchod sprin 'dis: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing rtog sgrib dag: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol:

ma hā dz+nyā na dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā: mar me'i smon lam ni: hūm̐: bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: snying po byang chub lam la zhugs pa yis: 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi ltung zhing : chags sdang gcong rong gnas su mi skye dang : log lta dmyal ba'i zangs khar rbab mi 'gril: 'khon 'dzin gcan gzan gdug pa'i skad mi thos: nyon mongs mtshon rtse gdug pa'i zer mi phog: dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' drin che ba dang : srog gis sbrel ba'i mched dang lcam dral dang : gsum pa'i dbang gis sbrel ba'i rig ma gsum: skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du: mi 'bral rtse gcig 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: sa bcu khyad par rim gyis bgrod par shog: nam zhig tshe 'phos lus brjes dus byung nas: 'khor ba'i g.yang sar lan gcig ltung srid kyang : snang ba'i sgo 'byed zhun mar mdangs gsal 'dis: rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon cing : kun tu 'od kyi sa la rgyud sbyangs nas: pad+ma chen po'i sa la lhun gyis grub: rdo rje 'dzin dang bde ba chen po'i sa: 'khor lo tshogs chen sa la gshegs pa'i tshe: sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis mdun bsus shig: yi dam lha yis rgyab nas srog rten cig: byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mtha' skyor cig: mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis sna drongs shig: ma tshogs dbang mo rnams kyis rjes skyongs shig: ye shes bla ma'i sa la rgyud sbyangs nas: lcang lo can gyi sa la phyin pa'i tshe: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas nas kyang : rdo rje khro rgyal khyod kyi zhal mthong nas: rig 'dzin rnams dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang : bla med sku gsung thugs su 'grub par shog: lnga pa la gnyis las/ dang po dag 'gyur lha'i skong ba ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso bo kun tu bzang : sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi mes thugs dam bskang : ma dag phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga: ye nas rigs lnga yab yum thugs dam bskang :

khams dang skye mched rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: sems dpa' sems ma bcu drug thugs dam bskang : rnam shes tshogs brgyad rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: sgo ba yab yum brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : nyon mongs rigs drug rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: bcom ldan thub pa drug gi thugs dam bskang : bder gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs rang rtsal ni: khams drug yab yum bcu gnyis thugs dam bskang : dbang po rnam shes tshogs brgyad gnas gyur pa'i: gnas kyi kau rī ma brgyad thugs dam bskang : 'dod yon brgyad kyi rang bzhin gnas gyur pa'i: yul gyi phra men brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : rtag chad mu bzhi rang bzhin gnas gyur pa'i: ye shes sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : bag chags dbang gis las lus 'khor ba las: spor byed chen mo brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las thogs med sgrub: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang : rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ dang : rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang : rnal 'byor tshogs kyi longs spyod dang : snang gsal zhun chen mar me dang : sha chen gsur gyi dud pa dang : thod pa ltag sprod rnga sgra dang : rkang chen dung gi gling bu dang : thun mong mchod pa sna tshogs kyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : gnyis pa ting 'dzin rtogs pa'i skong ba ni: hūm̐: dngos po chos nyid yangs pa'i klong du bskang : snang ba ye shes chen po'i klong du bskang : gsal ba shes rab 'bar ba'i klong du bskang : sdug bsngal ka dag chos nyid klong du bskang : kun rdzob don dam skye med klong du bskang : hūm̐: bskang du med de skye med klong du bskang : mchod du med de gnyis med rol pas mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug chen por sbyor: bsgral du med de mnyam nyid dbyings su bsgral: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen po'i thugs dam bskang :

nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stong gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: de ltar skong bshags zab mo 'di yang 'bad na mtshams med lnga yi sdig kyang nges par byang nas gnas skabs kyi dam tshig 'phral du dag cing mchog thun mong dngos grub tshegs med par myur du thob pa'o/ dngos gzhi'i 'phros don gsum pa tshogs byin rlabs nas bstab pa'i bar btang ba la/ de nas tshogs bya ba ni: chu gtsang gis bran la: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gis byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid rdor sems thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge 'phros: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ las me rlung chus: dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor bdud rtsir bsgyur: hūm̐: phyi snod 'jig rten tshogs gzhong du: nang bcud sems can tshogs su bsgyur: 'khor 'das gnyis med mchod pa'i rdzas: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: om̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdor sems yab yum la: zhi ba sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyis bskor: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar dpyangs cod pan sna tshogs pu ru ru: rin chen snyan cha rgyan gdub khro lo lo: zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan dga' bro ya la la: glu len gar byed bro rdung khrigs se khrig: brda 'gros mnyen lcug 'khril ldem khyugs se khyug: bde stong nyams dbyangs sna tshogs lhangs se lhang : bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od phung kyi li li: byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus rtsal sha ra ra: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen myur du phob: tshogs mchod rdzas la bcud chen sna tshogs phob: dkyil 'khor rdzas la gzi brjid bkrag mdangs skyed:

gnas khang 'di la 'od phung 'ja' gur 'khyil: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mor nyams rtogs spel: rten 'brel phun tshogs dga' ston bskyed du gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ de nas tshogs mchod ni: hūm̐: bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes tshogs kyis mchod: sku lnga lhun grub bde chen ngang du bzhes: gnyis med bde stong mchod pas dgyes gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: de nas tshogs kyi skong ba ni: hūm̐: mchod sprin lha mo nam mkha'i gar bsgyur ma: sna tshogs dbang po tshim byed mchod 'dzin tshogs: bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: spyi bor bde chen 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: byang sems bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsis bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: shes rab skye med gsang ba'i rdzas kyis bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: gsal stong gnyis med sbyor ba'i mchod pas bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag gtor mas bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: nyon mongs rtsa mdud grol ba'i rak+tas bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: phung po 'byung lnga dag pa'i bhan+dha ru: dbang po rnam lnga mchod rdzas bcud kyis bkang :

bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa'i bhan+dha ru: ma 'gags lhun grub rang byung rdzas kyis bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐ ye shes lnga ldan lhun grub bhan+dha ru: dug lnga rnam dag sku lnga rdzas kyis bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: dam tshig sor chud nyams chag bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib bag chags thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib ma lus bral gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs pa'i phrin las mdzod:

de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma rdor sems zhi ba dbyings kyi lha: thugs rje brtse ba'i lcags kyus dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig bag med dbang gyur pas: phyi nang 'khrul pa'i blo rtog ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha la mthol bshags bzod par gsol: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ bud+dha sa twa hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ rat+na sa twa hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ karma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: sogs yi ge brgya pa bzlas lhag chad bkang : de nas tha ma bsgral ba ni: na mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya sngags dang ting 'dzin rnams kyi bden pas gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad tshogs tha ma 'di dang gnyis su med par khug cig: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha dza dgra bo nṛ tri mā ra ya dza dzaḥ lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug byas la: hūm̐: nga ni rig pa he ru kaḥ ro gcig lta ba khros pa'i sku: phyag g.yas thabs kyi rdo rje gsor: g.yon pas shes rab phur bu bsgril: ma rig gnyis 'dzin dgra bo rnams: snying rje'i phur bu 'debs shing bsgral: ka dag mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas shog: om̐ badz+ra dharma kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsgral lo: de nas gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams: chos nyid klong yangs dgyes pa'i zhal phyes shig: dug lnga ma rig bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rang grol bde ba chen por dgyes gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na la khā hi: de nas tshogs la rol: hoḥ gzigs shig sogs? zhes tshogs mchod 'di yang dgos zhes dkon rnam dang pad+ma tshe 'dzin zung nas lha rdzas bcas yang yang bskul ngor kun bzang zhi ba'i tshogs pra dz+nyā ming gis kha cung zad bsgyur ba'o/ tha) ༈ rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol gyi rdor sems tshogs 'bum gsog thabs mchod sprin dbyings grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

om̐ āḥhūm̐/ rig stong rdor sems chos nyid mngon sum dbyings/ /sku dang thig le'i nyams snang gong 'phel mchod/ /bskang bshags 'dzin grol rig sku tshad la phebs/ /lhag bzhes rdzogs chen chos zad bum skur stsol/ om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ bsdu na/ badz+ra sa twa ga ṇa tsakra sogs bsags kyang rung ngo*/ zhes pa dkon rnam dang pad 'dzin zung gis lha rdzas bcas yang yang bskul ngor pra dz+nyā'i ming gis sbyar ba'o/ da) ༈ gtang rag mchod bstod ni: om̐ badz+ra sa twa pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe?shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: bstod pa: hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: kun bzang klong nas zhi dang khro gar sprul: 'gro don yid snang dbyer med rdo rje sems: kun 'dus yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bstod par 'os p sogs kyis bstod/ shrī ming gis sbyar ba'o// // na) ༈ gnas 'dren bde chen thar pa'i lam bgrod bzhugs so/ tshe 'das gnas lung gi cho ga la bcu gcig /dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i khar ming byang sogs rten bzhag /'og tu dgos pa'i chas thams cad gong ltar tshang bar byas la/ dang po rten bskyed pa ni/ mtshan byang las bum chus bran la/ om̐ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri sarba dra byāṃ shwa dha ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la ming byang nṛ las chaiga'i gzugs kyi rnam pa ji lta bar gyur bar bsams la/ gnyis pa rnam shes dgug pa ni/ lcags kyu'i rgya dang snying gi hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis rnam shes bkug par bsams shing*/ na mo rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par sbyong ba la dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi?

bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum rigs drug gi gnas gang du gnas kyang skad cig gis rten 'dir mchis par gyur cig om̐ badz+ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ lan gsum gyis rnam shes dang*/ sarba pā paṃ a na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas sdig pa bkug nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rnam shes āḥdakar po'i rnam par rten la stim/ gsum pa bgegs sbyong ba ni/ gtor ma rten la bskor zhing*/ om̐ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo zhes nas ghṛh+ṇa daṃ bha ling+ta swā hā/ zhes sogs lan gsum gyis zhi ba ting lo dang changs bu bskor zhing hūm̐ bzhi pa lan gsum gyi phyed ma/ bden stobs sngar bzhin brjod pa'i mthar tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i gson gyi dus su tshe srog la bar du gcod pa gshin gyi dus su sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la dpag tshad dang rgyang grags su ma gnas par song zhig /gal te mi 'gro na ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod cing gu gul bdug yungs dkar gyis brab drag sngags bzla zhing*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ ha la ha la ha la hūm̐/ rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas pas gtor ma rgyang ring du dor te drag po'i sbyong ba'o/ bzhi pa sdig pa sbyong ba ni/ rten gyi mdun du til dang me chu bshams/ tshe 'das chaiga'i sdig sgrib thams cad kaṃ nag po'i rnam pa sna bug nas thon sna sgor sdig pa'i rnam par gyur te til la thim par bsams shing*/ til g.yas g.yon gyis mer bsregs chur dor la/ om̐ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ sdig pa thams cad ye shes kyi me chus sbyangs par bsam/ de nas sgrib sbyong gi sngags bzlas pa'i bye ma dang yungs dkar brab cing yig brgya dang*/

om̐ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sogs dang ngan song sbyong ba'i sngags mang du bzlas mthar/ tshe 'das bskal pa stong nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyong dka' ba om̐ pā paṃ badz+ra bhi shu shud+dhe ye swā hā/ sdig sgrib thams cad nyi mas ba mo bzhus pa bzhin dag par bsam mo/ lnga pa khrus bya ba ni/ thog mar dkyil 'khor sogs rten gyi gzugs brnyan shar ba'i me long la khrus gsol zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sku khrus gsol/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la/ /nyon mongs dri ma mi mnga' yang*/ /tshe 'das sgo gsum sgrib bral phyir/ /gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo/ om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ kā ya bi shwa dha ni swā hā/ zhes sku phyis pa'i khrus chus slar bum pas ming byang ngam rten la bkru zhing*/ hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni ye shes lnga yi ngang : tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol bas: dug lnga'i sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: yig brgya'i mthar tshe 'das chaiga'i shes bya'i sgrib pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ bag chags kyi sgrib pa dang*/ las kyi sgrib pa dang*/ kun nas bslangs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig: om̐ sarba pā paṃ shwa dha na ye swā hā/ gzhan yang*/ 'di ni phyin drug rang bzhin chu: nyon mongs dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: phar phyin chu yis legs bkrus pas: nyon drug dri ma dag gyur cig: ces dang yig brgya'i mthar: tshe 'das shes bya'i sgrib? sogs dang gong ltar brjod cing bkrus pas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis nyon mongs pa'i thal ba'ang sbyangs par bsam/ drug pa skyabs 'gror 'jug pa ni/

tshe 'das dkyil 'khor sa la phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'debs par bsams la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: kun bzang klong yangs zhi dang khro gar sprul: 'gro don yid snang dbyer med rdo rje sems: kun 'dus rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: dug lnga gnas dag rigs lnga longs spyod rdzogs: 'byung lnga gnas dag yum lnga so sor gsal: yab yum spyan la zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: rtsa khams 'khor lo'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: kau rī tsau ri la sogs dbyings phyug ging : sgo ba sgo ma sprul sku thub pa drug: mtshams dang laṅka la sogs 'gro 'dul gyi: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la: sogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ bdun pa dbang bskur ba ni/ tshe 'das skad cig gis dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te thim par gyur/ snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra a be sha ya a āḥ btags pa brjod la rol mo sgrog tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa brtan par bya/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: chos sku'i bum pa stong gsum 'di: rdor sems zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: khyod kyi gnas gsum bzhag pa yis: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bum pa gnas gsum reg cing bum chu 'dod yon nang du blug /brgyad pa zas gtad pa ni/ tshe 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i skur bskyed pa'i mdun du bza' btung sna tshogs bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin las grub pa'i 'dod yon gyi dngos po gzugs mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod kyi 'khor los sprin chen po gyur:

na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo? sngags rgyas byin brlabs la/ phyogs dus kun na gzugs sgra dri ro reg /reg bya khyad par dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob khyod la 'bul/ /zag med dga' bdes rtag tu tshim par shog om̐ gu ru bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra sa twa pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bsngos/ dgu pa 'khor bar ma chags par gdams pa ni/ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: rigs drug gnas na bde ba med: sdug bsngal las la ma chags par: ma yengs rtse gcig dran pas zungs: bcu pa lam ston gyis gnas spar ba ni/ hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: rnam shes rlung gi rta pho la: rig pa gsal ba'i mi bus bzung : dbu ma chos dbyings lam la gshegs: klong yangs 'og min zhing khams su: bcom ldan rdor sems yab yum bzhugs: dbyer med de yi sras nyid du: rlung gi shugs la sems kyi rtsal: rig pa dri med āḥdakar de: zang thal skar mda' chad pa ltar: phaṭ sgra drag po'i brtul shugs kyis: ldog med rdor sems thugs kar thim: hika: drag po gsum gyis spar/ zhes rnam shes āḥthung gi rnam pa spyi bo nas thon 'og min zhing du song nas rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar thim par bsam mo/ bcu gcig pa mtshan byang sreg pa ni/ nub tha ma'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi me zer byung bas tshe 'das kyi phung khams skye mched 'khor ba'i chos thams cad dmigs med ka dag gi dbyings su sbyangs par bsams la me sbar zhing*/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings kyi thabs khung du/ /bdag 'dzin phung po'i bud shing la/ /shes rab ye shes me sbar te/ /tshe 'das nyon mongs bag chags bsreg /'di ni skye 'gag smon pa dang*/ /gnas med mtshan ma med pa'i me/ /'di ni rang byung ye shes me/ /bdag 'dzin mtshan ma'i rtog pa bsreg /don la bsreg bya sreg byed kun/ /bya rtsol med par ye sangs rgyas/

/'bad med lhun grub chos kyi sku/ /rang byung ye shes der snang ngo*/ yig brgya'i mthar/ ag+ne dz+nyā na dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes zag bcas kyi phung po zag med du bsgyur bar bya'o/ thal ba sāts+tsha gdab/ bsngo ba smon lam ji ltar 'os pas mtshams sbyar ro/ bzhi pa tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma phyin chad mthar chags su btang bas 'grub par bya'o/ khyab bdag rdor sems thugs rje lcags kyu yis/ /'brel bcas 'gro kun ngan song gnas nas drangs/ /mgon po nyid mtshungs mngon dga'i zhing mchog tu/ /phyam gcig khams gsum 'khor ba dong sprugs shog /ces 'di'ang sgrub brtson karma mthar phyin nas yang yang bskul ngor dz+nyā na shrī bha dras gze rgyal gnas zhol bdud 'dul sngags gling du bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel/ nyes 'gal mchis na rtsa ba gsum la bshags/ sarba dā ka l+ye naṃ bha wan+tu// // pa) ༈ rdzogs pa chen po 'khor 'das yongs grol las/ rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi cho ga'i 'don khrigs blo dman 'jug bde zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ rigs kun khyab bdag bla ma rje/ /dbyer med rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /dngos po kun gyis rab btud nas/ /de sgrub cho ga'i 'don khrigs spel/ 'dir rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi cho ga nyams su len pa la gsum/ sbyor ba sta gon gyi rim pa dang*/ dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub kyi chog khrigs/ zur du cho ga'i yan lag gzhan du bshad pa'o/ dang po ni/ sku rten bris 'bur gang rung bkram pa'i mdun du/ stegs bu kheb can gyi steng du ras bris sam/ 'bru tshom lha grangs bkod pa'i steng du bla gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa rgyan spros can nam rtsa gsum spyi gtor gang rung*/ bum pa bcud ldan mgul chings can/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka /mdun du chad brtan/ bskul/ gter srung ma gza' dam gsum/ phyi mchod sna bdun sngon 'gro/ tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor bsags la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs sogs spyi ltar song nas/

brgyud pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ e ma hoḥ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /chos sku kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ /sna tshogs ma 'gags sprul pa'i pho brang nas/ /longs sku rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /pad 'byung yab yum sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /ke ri gsang ba mchog gi pho brang nas/ /ḍāk+ki mtsho rgyal sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas mchog yang rdzong shel gyi sgrub phug nas/ /dpal chen sangs rgyas ye shes la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab rgya sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i pho brang nas/ /karma las 'brel rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /chos bdag brgyud 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng nas/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang lus rtsa khams dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod gnas mchog nas/ /dam chos 'khor 'das yongs grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /mthu ldan dgra bgegs tshar gcod gnas mchog nas/ /bka' srung gter bdag rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol btab bden pa'i mthu byin gyis/ /bdag sogs skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs kun/ /'khrul med phyag rdzogs dgongs pa'i btsan sa zin/ /rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sa lam yongs bgrod nas/ /kun bzang klong du 'ub chud sangs rgyas shog /

gnyis pa la'ang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum/ sngon 'gro la'ang dgu las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba la/ skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa sad par byas la/ na mo: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun 'phags pa'i tshogs: chos longs sprul gsum gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ sems can pha ma rigs drug 'khrul 'khor rnams: sdug bsngal kun bral bde ldan mchog reg pa'i: ma nor byang chub sa lam la 'god phyir: zung 'jug bde chen mchog tu sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i dge ba rnams/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral gyur cig /bde dang bral bar ma gyur cig /btang snyoms chen por gnas gyur cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams 'od zhu rang la thim par gyur: ces brjod/ dkar gtor sngon du song nas bzhi pa bgegs gtor la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ om̐ sarba bigh+nān a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ rten la dgug

/om̐ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ?ghṛ h+na daṃ ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ hūm̐: bdag ni khro rgyal 'bar ba dbang gi sku: ye shes gsang gsum mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: byang chub dngos grub bsgrub la bar gcod bgegs: mchod sbyin khyer la so sor rang gnas gshegs: om̐ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa gnod byed sarba u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las mi shigs rdo rje'i sku: ye shes las grub sra mkhregs pha lam ltar: mi shigs 'khor lo me ri mtshon cha'i gur: phyi nang sprul pa'i khro bos mtshams chod cig: om̐ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐: drug pa mchod pa byin rlob ni/ hūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul spyan gzigs lha mi'i tshogs: dpag med nam mkha'i khyon khengs kun bzang sprin: gzung 'dzin 'khri ba'i bag chags kun sbyangs nas: bla med bde gshegs mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ?shab+da āḥhūm̐: bdun pa thun min nang gsang gi mchod rlob ni/ hūm̐: thabs shes bde stong bhan+dha rab 'khyil dbus: byang sems dkar dmar bde chen bdud rtsi'i sprin: sbyor sgrol sman raka ting 'dzin tshogs gtor 'di: sbyangs spel bsgyur pa'i ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ sarba a haṃ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza khā hi: brgyad pa byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'og min lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas/ /kun bzang chos sku'i lha tshogs byin phob cig /ma 'gags dbyings rig zang thal pho brang nas/ /longs sku rdor sems lha tshogs byin phob cig /ma bcos sku lnga rang byung pho brang nas/ /sprul sku dga' rab rdo rjes byin phob cig /gang 'dul thugs rje mngon shar pho brang nas/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba kun 'dus byin phob cig /rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /rje btsun pad 'byung yab yum byin phob cig /mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas mchog nas/

/ḍāk+ki ye shes mtsho rgyal byin phob cig /bod yul dben gnas so so'i sgrub gnas nas/ /rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lngas byin phob cig /zab rgya sgo 'phar gter gyi pho brang nas/ /karma las 'brel rtsal gyis byin phob cig /dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /chos bdag rgyud 'dzin rnams kyis byin phob cig /spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng nas/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla mas byin phob cig /rang lus rtsa khams dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs byin phob cig /gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod gnas mchog nas/ /dam chos 'khor 'das yongs grol byin phob cig /mthu ldan dgra bgegs tshar gcod gnas mchog nas/ /bka' srung gter bdag rnams kyis byin phob cig /las bzhi dam tshig gnyan po'i pho brang nas/ /yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i lha tshogs byin phob cig /chos sku'i byin 'bebs thugs rje sha ra ra/ /longs sku'i byin 'bebs bkrag mdangs ta la la/ /sprul sku'i byin 'bebs bag dro me re re/ /rig 'dzin byin 'bebs thugs rje spungs se spung*/ /dkyil 'khor byin 'bebs dpal 'bar lams se lam/ /gnas 'dir byin chen phob la dbang chen bskur/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dza/ a be sha ya a āḥ dgu pa brda sgo dbye zhing phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: sku gsum byin phob dbang bskur dngos grub stsol: ye shes sgo phyes 'khrul pa'i sgo bcad nas: dkyil 'khor mchod cing phyag 'tshal mi btang bsgrub: snang stong lha skur rtogs kyang sdig bshags bgyid: om̐ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐ sa twa āḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang bcu gcig las/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐: kun bzang rgyal ba ye sangs rgyas: āḥ 'gags med longs sku rang rtsal rdzogs: om̐: sgyu ma'i zung 'jug gsal snang dag: hrīḥ gnyis bsdus snang srid kun la khyab:

om̐ ma hā shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na dharma hūm̐: gnyis pa rten dang rten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: nam mkha' rlung me sa chu las: dbang chen ri rab rdo rje'i gzhi: me ri dur khrod phyi nang rdzogs: 'khor lo pad nyi zla gdan dbus: ye shes sprul pa'i gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang : chos 'khor 'dod snam rtsig pa dang : pha gu drwa phyed rin chen brgyan: mda' yab pu shu bang rim ldan: ka gdung bla bre 'phan gdugs tshang : dbus su rin chen sna lnga'i tog: sgo rdzogs mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs tshang : phyi dang nang med zang thal klong : 'ja' 'od ye shes lnga ldan gtibs: de nang rma bya seng glang rta: khyung chen sde lnga'i khri 'phang du: zla ba'i lte bar yi ge hūm̐: gnas 'gyur rdo rje pad+mar gyur: de nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: rang nyid longs sku rdo rje sems: dkar gsal zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan 'bar: dbu skra smug 'bol spyi bor brgyan: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rigs bdag mthing : phyag gnyis snang stong rdor dril brten: sku lus 'od stong spyan ras gzigs: che mchog zhi khro rigs brgya rdzogs: ye shes na bza' cod pan 'phur: phyed skyil bde stong ting 'dzin ngang : gnas lnga rigs lnga'i longs spyod rdzogs: rtsa sgor rta mgrin dbyug tho dmar: gsang bar dbyings phyug bde bar sbyor: sngon mo lang tsho mnyen lcug ldem: zil chags yab la spyan gzigs mdzes: skra grol rat+na'i cod pan 'phur: phyag gnyis mgul 'khyud gri thod 'dzin: spyan stong khengs pa'i 'ja' gur dbus: yum chen brgya rtsa bye ba stong : rgyan drug ga shal chas rdzogs mdzes: zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril: rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor bas: bde ba bskul zhing mi rtog 'char: zung 'jug gzi brjid cher rgyas bsgom: gnas lngar rigs lnga'i lha mo mdzes: phyogs bzhi ke'u ri yab yum brgyad: rang rtags phyag rgyas brgyan zhing 'gying :

mtshams bzhir skyong ma mkha' 'gro bzhi: gri thod rgyan ldan 'gying stabs bzhugs: phyi rim thub pa rigs drug ni: 'gro drug skyabs mchis tshul du gsal: sgo bzhir stag seng khyung 'brug bzhi: rang rtags rgyan ldan rol stabs bsgom: de ltar dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha: dran snang chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: 'od zer dpag yas sprin 'tshubs bzhin: thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phro 'du las: skad cig gnas nas spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa twa bud+dha dz+nyā na sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa dbang bskur ba ni/ dbang lha rigs lnga 'og min zhing nas byon: khrus bstsal sgrib dag dbu rgyan cod pan thob: byin rlabs dbang bskur dngos grub mchog thob nas: zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lha ru byin gyis rlobs: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bzhi pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: rnam dag chos sku g.yo med spros bral las: sna tshogs longs sku rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: gnyis bsdus sprul pa 'gro don yid snang phyir: kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lnga pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: rang bzhin dbyings la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang : sna tshogs thabs kyis sems can mun sel ba: kun tu snang ba rdo rje dkyil 'khor lha: dbyer med brtan par bzhugs shing chos 'khor bskor: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: drug pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: drug pa khyab brdal kun gzhi brda yi chos: kun 'dus yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bag chags 'dag bya'i phyir: yul 'dzin ngo bo dag la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pu ho: bdun pa phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos ma: zhal zas sil snyan gzugs sgra dri ro reg: glu ma gar ma sgeg mo phreng 'dzin sogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul:

om̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: brgyad pa yid sprul gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum rab 'byams ri rab gling khams nas: rgyal srid rin chen bkra shis rtags brgyad rdzas: phyi nang spyan gzigs kun tshang mchod pa'i sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul: om̐ badz+ra rā ni ta saṃ pra ra ni ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: dgu pa nang gsang gi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: rang byung snod yangs mchog tu bskyil ba yi: dkar dmar byang sems pañtsa kun sbyar nas: sman raka gtor tshogs sbyor sgrol mchod pa 'di: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul: om̐ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ khyab bdag bla ma kun tu bzang po mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab rdo rje la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen shrī singha dang*/ /pad+ma thod phreng mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ /rtsa gsum gling pa thugs mchog rdo rje la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /mi 'jigs rdo rje snyan grags rgya mtsho dang*/ /gsang sngags bstan rgyal tshe dbang 'dus pa rtsal/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /bka' bab lung bstan mkhyen rab grags pa'i zhabs/ /rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma thams cad la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /rigs bdag rdor sems dam pa rigs brgya dang*/ /yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /chos skyong srung ma dam can rgya mtsho dang*/ /nor lha gter bdag yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag /sman mchod 'bul lo phrin las rnam bzhi stsol/
