kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ bdud rtsi'i thig le gnas gsum du bkod cing lce thog tu myong la/ badz+ra a mṛ ta sid+dhi m+mepra yats+tsha/ bcu pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: kun bzang klong nas zhi dang khro gar sprul: 'gro don yid snang dbyer med rdo rje sems: kun 'dus yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dug lnga rnam dag rigs lnga longs spyod rdzogs: 'byung lnga rnam dag yum lnga so sor gsal: yab yum sku la zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: rtsa khams 'khor lo'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: kau rī tsau ri la sogs dbang phyug ging : sgo ba sgo ma sprul sku thub pa drug: mtshams dang laṅka la sogs 'gro 'dul gyi: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bcu gcig pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis/ dmigs bsal sgrub pa'i skabs dang bdag 'jug gnas 'dren sogs skabs khyad par can dang 'brel na dzap khang dbye ba ni/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ gis dbye ba las bsnyen rkyang skabs mi dgos/ dang po bsnyen dmigs ni/ bdag gi snying gar 'od lnga'i klong*/ /zla steng rang 'dra'i ye shes pa'i/ /thugs kar rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐/ /dkar gsal sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ /'od 'phros 'phags mchod byin rlabs bsdus/ /sems can sgrib sbyangs bde chen bkod/ /tshur 'dus sngags phreng nyid la zhugs/ bsnyen pa ni/ om̐ gu ru bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: zhes dang yig brgya ci nus bzlas/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyi nyams len dang bsnyen rkyang kho na'i skabs 'dir dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod dang bcas rjes kyi bya ba nongs bshags bsdu rim bsngo smon bkra shis sogs kyis mtha' dbyung bar mdzad pa yin no/ gnyis pa sgrub pa'i skabs bsnyen pa'i mgor dzap khang dbye la bsnyen pa khyug tsam song rjes bdag mdun dus gcig tu gsal btab la/

dmigs pa ni/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ yig la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi rdor sems yab yum lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i thugs brgyud bskul te de rnams kyi mdun bskyed dwangs ma'i thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros phyogs bcu dus bzhi bde gshegs sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas bdag mdun gyi lha rnams la thim pas gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mched lcam rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag bshags/ dam can chos skyong dregs pa can rnams dbang du bsdus/ phrin las rnam bzhi 'bad med du bsgrubs/ yang 'od zer rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas so so'i las dang rgyu mthun gyi rnam smin sdug bsngal sdig ltung nyams chag thams cad lhag med du sbyangs nas phyi nang snod bcud thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par gyur

par bsams la/ om̐ gu ru bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: mthar yi ge brgya pa ci mang bzla'o/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams dang mchod bstod bya/ gsum pa cho ga'i yan lag bshad pa la gsum/ rang don tshogs bsags dang bdag 'jug gzhan don gnas lung ngo*/ dang po la gsum/ phyag 'tshal bshags pa/ bskang ba'o/ dang po tshogs zhing gsal gdab cing phyag 'tshal ba ni/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad rang mdun nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drang ba ni/ e ma hoḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi kun gyi bdag nyid che: bla ma rdor sems zhi khro yongs rdzogs dgongs: 'dir gshegs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: nyams chag na rag sbyang phyir phyag mchod bzhes: hoḥ bdag lus phung po bsdus bya sgyu ma yi: shes sgrib bag chags ma lus sbyang slad du: rtsa khams zhing khams lha ru mos byas nas: rtse gcig gdung ba drag pos phyag 'tshal lo: bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: skye med chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: ci yang sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mngon par byang chub sku la phyag 'tshal lo: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: che mchog khro bo'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jam dpal sku yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: pad+ma gsung gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: yang dag thugs kyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: phur pa phrin las lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bla ma rig 'dzin lha la phyag 'tshal lo: ma mo rbod gtong lha la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha la phyag 'tshal lo: dmod pa drag sngags lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bka' sdod sgo ma'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: dam can rgya mtsho'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: kun bzang klong nas zhi dang khro gar sprul: 'gro don yid snang dbyer med rdo rje sems:

kun 'dus yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: kun bzang yab yum thugs rje sprul pa ni: rdor sems spyan ma la sogs rigs lnga dang : sems dpa' sems ma yab yum bcu drug bcas: thub drug sgo ba yab yum brgyad la sogs: zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: che mchog la sogs khrag 'thung yab yum dang : kau rī siṃ ha phra men brgyad rnams sogs: sgo ba yab yum dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: khrag 'thung lnga bcu brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: ka dag dbyings rig sku la phyag 'tshal lo: zang thal khyab bdag sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'od gsal bde chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo: ci yang sa le'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mngon par byang chub sku la phyag 'tshal lo: rang rig rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: 'khor 'das ye shes chen por phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid sangs rgyas zhing la phyag 'tshal lo: snod bcud gdod ma'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sgra grags gsung dbyangs drug cur phyag 'tshal lo: gang shar gnas lugs de la phyag 'tshal lo: nyag gcig thig le chen por phyag 'tshal lo: de ltar rab gus gdung bas phyag byas mthus: bskal pa thog ma med nas da lta'i bar: bdag sogs nyams chag sdig ltung ci bsags pa: lhag med byang nas rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sar: mngon rdzogs bla med byang chub thob par shog: gnyis pa la/ bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ tshig dbang dang sbrel ba'i bshags tshan bzhi las/ thog mar bshags yul gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid sgyu lus snang stong spyi bo'i steng : rig pa skye med dung mdog rdo rje sems: thabs shes phyag rgya bsnol zhing snyems ma 'khyud: skyil krung thugs kyi hūm̐ mthar yig brgyas bskor: sngags phreng 'khor zhing 'od zhu bdag la thim: bdud rtsis lus khengs bag chags g.ya' bral bsgom: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs? ma yengs brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na/ mtshams med lnga yi sdig pa 'dag /dang po bum dbang bskyed rim dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig nyams chag bshags pa ni/

om̐: kṛ ya rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sgor zhugs nas: bdag lus gzhal yas khang du gnas pa yis: gnas lnga phung lnga rigs lnga yab yum ste: bskyed pa lha sku phyag rgya ma gsal zhing : gsal brtan dag gsum tshad du ma rdzogs nas: phung khams snod bcud lha ru rgyas ma thebs: rdzogs pa lus rtsa sprul sku ma rtogs nas: rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro tha mal 'dzin: rdo rje lus kyi ngo sprod ma rtogs nas: 'da' ka 'od kyi gong bu gdeng ma thob: yo ga'i bsgom don tshul bzhin ma rtogs nas: bskyed pa'i tshe na zhal phyag ma gsal zhing : rdzogs pa'i tshe na ting 'dzin ngo ma sprod: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs don dang mi ldan pas: bum dbang dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: tshogs mchod dus su ser sna'i zhen pas bcings: bskang bshags dus su bzlas brjod grangs nyung sogs: tshod yod chog shes le lo'i dbang gyur pa: bla med 'od gsal de bzhin ngang gis bshags: dug lnga ye grol ye shes lnga ru bshags: dug gsum sku gsum mnyam nyid ngang du bshags: rnam rtog tshogs drug mi rtog dbyings su bshags: kun rtog ma rig ka dag ngang du bshags: phung khams rnam dag rigs lnga rgyal bar bshags: khams lnga rnam dag yum mchog rigs lngar bshags: 'byung lnga rnam dag lha mo lnga ru bshags: sgo dgu 'dzin rtog theg dgu'i ngang du bshags: rnam shes tshogs brgyad sems dpa' brgyad du bshags: skye mched bcu gnyis lha mo rnams la bshags: rigs drug 'khrul 'khor thub pa drug la bshags: rtag chad mu bzhi sgo ma bzhi ru bshags: 'khrul 'dzin sna tshogs dkyil 'khor lha ru bshags: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: gnyis pa gsang dbang dang 'brel ba'i bshags pa ni/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo bla ma he ru kaḥ rdo rje sems dpa' nyams chag sbyong ba'i lha: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro byang sems tshogs: rigs lnga zhi khro'i lha tshogs thams cad dang : srung ma dam can tshogs bcas dgongs su gsol:

bdag cag thog med dus nas da lta'i bar: ma rig sgrib pas tshor dang ma tshor gyis: sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag dang : mi dge mtshams med nyon mongs brgyad khri'i nongs: sdig pa mi dge bgyis dang bgyid du stsal: yi rang byas shing rkyen gyur thams cad bshags: u pa'i man ngag gsang ba'i sgor zhugs nas: lus gnad tshogs drug lhug bzhag mi shes shing : phung khams lha skur ma rtogs rtsa khams sgrib: ngag gnad gzung 'dzin stong pa'i tshig la chags: ngag rlung sngags su ma dag srog rtsol sgrib: yid rlung dhū tir 'ching ba'i tshad ma phebs: gtum mo'i bde drod lus la ma shar ba: a nu'i mtha' bral gnas lugs don ma rtogs: gsang dbang dam tshig phog pa mthol lo bshags: mdor na so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi: sdom pa dam tshig nyams chag ci mchis kun: gnong 'gyod nongs pas mthol bshags phyin chad sdom: dag tshangs sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: gsum pa ni sher dbang dang 'brel ba'i bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i rig ma dgongs su gsol: dga' bzhi'i gnas gter rdo rje pho nya mo: thabs ldan las kyi phyag rgyar byin ma brlabs: snang stong yab yum zung 'jug mi shes shing : dbyings rig yab yum phyi nang ris su phyes: gsal stong yab yum ngang rgyun ma bsrings nas: bde stong ro la chags pas ting 'dzin bsgribs: dga' bzhi bcu drug bde stong nyams ma myong : dbab ldog 'dren dkram gnad du ma khel zhing : zag med lhan skyes ma mthong bdud rtsi nyams: sbyor ba'i tshe na bde stong dbye gsal dka': sgrol ba'i tshe na snying rje'i bag chags zhan: 'khrul gzugs rmongs pas mu stegs spyod par shor: ma hā bde ba chen po'i don ma rtogs: sher dbang dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: bzhi pa tshig dbang dang 'brel ba'i don bshags ni/ hoḥ ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas dgongs su gsol: a ti yo ga'i mtha' bral don bzung nas:

lta ba gtad med rgya yan mi shes shing : bsgom pa brdal khyab 'od gsal ma rtogs nas: spyod pa mtshan ma'i bag chags snang ba bsgrubs: 'bras bu gsum gyis so sor ris su phyes: dbyings rig dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: ka dag klong la gzhal med ma rtogs shing : zang thal rig pa'i tshogs drug 'gyu ba bgag: sems kyi rang bzhin stong nyid ma rtogs nas: rnam shes rlung la mtshan ma'i lta ba 'dzin: khregs chod dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: gzhi ni 'od gsal rang ngo ma mthong zhing : sems nyid chos skur ma rtogs thig le nyams: lam ni snang bzhi zad sar ma phyin zhing : khregs chod thod rgal nyams snang tshad ma phebs: 'bras bu yang dag mngon byang ma chub cing : a ti'i lta ba klong du ma gyur pa: tshig dbang dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: lta ba ye sangs rgyas pa'i klong du bshags: sgom pa mi dmigs rgya yan klong du bshags: spyod pa gang shar ro snyom klong du bshags: gzhi ni 'od gsal ma bcos klong du bshags: lam ni zang thal 'gags med klong du bshags: 'bras bu 'khor gsum yongs dag de bzhin bshags: bshags dang bshags bya stong nyid klong du bshags: a ti klong chen lta ba'i bshags pa yis: ye grol gdod ma'i dgongs pa la gnas shog: ces mi dmigs lta ba'i ngang nas bshags: spro na bde gshegs spyi bshags bya ba ni/ om̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas: rdo rje dam can ma lus dgongs su gsol: dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin byang chub go 'phang du: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje bsgrub pa'i phyir: yi dam lha dang rdo rje slob dpon dang : gsang ba'i dam tshig grangs su mnos pa la: dam bcas bka' las 'da' bar mi bgyi ste: las dang skal bas dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang : phrag dog la sogs shor nas nongs bgyis pa: rdo rje slob dpon bstan pa'i sgron me la:

snying nas smad cing dam tshig nyams pa dang : dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje spun rnams la: ngan sems log par lta ba la sogs pa'i: sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: yi dam lha yi phyag rgya ma gsal zhing : sngags kyi bsnyen pa grangs las chad pa dang : dus drug las kyi mchod pa khyad par du: bsnyen sgrub bskang ba'i cho ga ma bgyis te: bka' ltar ma lcogs gzhung bzhin rngo ma thogs: gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: rdo rje slob dpon byams pa'i sku drin gyis: snyan khung brgyud nas sems kyi dkyil du bzhag: thugs kyi man ngag byin pas dam tshig 'dres: gsang mtshams 'das nas 'chol bar smras la sogs: thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: chos rnams mnyam pa nyid du ma rtogs te: yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: le lo snyoms las gnyid kyi dbang gyur te: bsnyen sgrub dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: lus ngag yid kyi bsrung bya 'das pa yis: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa bshags: rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: yo byad 'byor tshogs chung ba mthol lo bshags: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du: mngon rtogs spong len bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi rnams kyi spyan lam du: khas blangs dam bcas nyams pa mthol lo bshags: chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: gtor ma lo zlar 'gyangs pa mthol lo bshags: dus gsum pha ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: drin lan lan gyis ma lon mthol lo bshags: mched dang lcam dral rnams kyi spyan lam du: dam tshig brtse gdung chung ba mthol lo bshags: 'gro drug sems can rnams kyi spyan lam du: snying rje phan sems chung ba mthol lo bshags: so sor thar pa rnams kyi sdom pa dang : byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa dang : rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig la sogs pa: 'gal zhing nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags: mi 'chab mi sbed slan chad sdom par bgyi:

dus gsum byas pa'i sdig sgrib mthol bshags na: tshangs par mdzad nas sku gsung thugs la sogs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: zhes sogs yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing bshags pa bya'o/ gsum pa skong ba la bdun/ dang po thun mong phyi yi nyer spyod dang 'dod yon lnga yi bskang ba ni/ skong rdzas rnams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu? byin gyis brlabs shing mkha' khyab tu spel/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na: yan lag brgyad ldan gtsang ma'i chab: gtsang mar spos ldan zhabs bsil mtsho: dkar dmar me tog mdangs bcud ldan: spos mchog ngad ldan bdug pa'i sprin: nyi zla mar me 'od lnga 'tsher: gser mdog 'dag chal dri yi chab: 'bru sman sbyar ba'i zhal zas brjid: rnga dung sil snyan rol mo ldir: dkar mdzes me long pad+ma 'dzin: ser mdzes ting ting pi waṃ rdung : mthing mdzes dung chos rnga yab 'dzin: dmar mdzes dri mchog zhal zas stob: ljang mdzes pañtsa li ka thogs: mthing mdzes chos 'byung spyan mdzes bsnams: thams cad gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur: dngos 'byor mchod sprin brgya rtsa brgyad: yid sprul 'khor 'das kun 'gengs 'dis: rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs dam bskang : bskangs nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: ngan song sdig ltung lhag med sbyangs: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa yis: 'bras bu sku gsum lhun grub shog: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sarba pañtsa ku la ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she dharma dhā tu pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: gnyis pa bdud rtsi sman gyi skong ba ni/ hūm̐: phung po lnga yi bhan+dha ru: rtsa rlung thig le'i bdud rtsis gtams: chos nyid don gyi ye shes rgyun: mtshon byed rtags kyi a mṛ tas: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing rtog sgrib dag:

bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: gsum pa chags bral rak+ta'i skong ba ni/ hūm̐: 'khor lo lnga yi bhan+dha ru: nyon mongs rtog tshogs bsgral ba'i khrag: rang grol gshis kyi dmar chen po: snang ba brda yi rak+ta 'dis: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing rtog sgrib dag: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: bzhi pa rmad byung gtor ma'i skong ba ni/ āḥ 'byung 'dus las kyi gtor gzhong du: sha khrag drod dbugs gtor ma bshams: dwangs ma lnga ldan longs spyod che: 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i bha ling+tas: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing rtog sgrib dag: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā bha ling+ta khā hi: lnga pa snang gsal mar me'i skong ba ni/ hoḥ sgron me drug gi kong bu ru: phung lnga rnam dag sdong bu btsugs: rang byung ye shes mar me sbar: 'od gsal snang bzhi'i mchod sprin 'dis: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing rtog sgrib dag: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā dz+nyā na dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā:

mar me'i smon lam ni: hūm̐: bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: snying po byang chub lam la zhugs pa yis: 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi ltung zhing : chags sdang gcong rong gnas su mi skye dang : log lta dmyal ba'i zangs khar rbab mi 'gril: 'khon 'dzin gcan gzan gdug pa'i skad mi thos: nyon mongs mtshon rtse gdug pa'i zer mi phog: dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' drin che ba dang : srog gis sbrel ba'i mched dang lcam dral dang : gsum pa'i dbang gis sbrel ba'i rig ma gsum: skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du: mi 'bral rtse gcig 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: sa bcu khyad par rim gyis bgrod par shog: nam zhig tshe 'phos lus brjes dus byung nas: 'khor ba'i g.yang sar lan gcig ltung srid kyang : snang ba'i sgo 'byed zhun mar mdangs gsal 'dis: rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon cing : kun tu 'od kyi sa la rgyud sbyangs nas: pad+ma chen po'i sa la lhun gyis grub: rdo rje 'dzin dang bde ba chen po'i sa: 'khor lo tshogs chen sa la gshegs pa'i tshe: sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis mdun bsus shig: yi dam lha yis rgyab nas srog rten cig: byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mtha' skyor cig: mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis sna drongs shig: ma tshogs dbang mo rnams kyis rjes skyongs shig: ye shes bla ma'i sa la rgyud sbyangs nas: lcang lo can gyi sa la phyin pa'i tshe: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas nas kyang : rdo rje khro rgyal khyod kyi zhal mthong nas: rig 'dzin rnams dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang : bla med sku gsung thugs su 'grub par shog: drug pa dag 'gyur lha'i skong ba ni/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso bo kun tu bzang : sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi mes thugs dam bskang : ma dag phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga: ye nas rigs lnga yab yum thugs dam bskang : khams dang skye mched rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i:

sems dpa' sems ma bcu drug thugs dam bskang : rnam shes tshogs brgyad rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: sgo ba yab yum brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : nyon mongs rigs drug rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: bcom ldan thub pa drug gi thugs dam bskang : bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs rang rtsal ni: khams drug yab yum bcu gnyis thugs dam bskang : dbang po rnam shes tshogs brgyad gnas gyur pa'i: gnas kyi kau rī ma brgyad thugs dam bskang : 'dod yon brgyad kyi rang bzhin gnas gyur pa'i: yul gyi phra men brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : rtag chad mu bzhi rang bzhin gnas gyur pa'i: ye shes sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : bag chags dbang gis las lus 'khor ba las: spor byed chen mo brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las thogs med sgrub: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang : rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ dang : rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang : rnal 'byor tshogs kyi longs spyod dang : snang gsal zhun chen mar me dang : sha chen gsur gyi dud pa dang : thod pa ltag sprod rnga sgra dang : rkang chen dung gi gling bu dang : thun mong mchod pa sna tshogs kyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bdun pa ting 'dzin rtogs pa'i skong ba ni/ hūm̐: dngos po chos nyid yangs pa'i klong du bskang : snang ba ye shes chen po'i klong du bskang : gsal ba shes rab 'bar ba'i klong du bskang : sdug bsngal ka dag chos nyid klong du bskang : kun rdzob don dam skye med klong du bskang : hūm̐: bskang du med de skye med klong du bskang : mchod du med de gnyis med rol pas mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug chen por sbyor: bsgral du med de mnyam nyid dbyings su bsgral: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen po'i thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig:

rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: de ltar skong bshags zab mo 'di yang 'bad na mtshams med lnga yi sdig kyang nges par byang nas mchog thun mong dngos grub tshegs med par myur du thob pa'o/ rang don du bdag 'jug bya ba la/ dkyil 'khor dbang rdzas mchod rdzas sogs ma tshang ba med pa gzhung bzhin 'du bya la/ gzhung gi gsol 'debs skyabs sems nas bzung bdag bskyed mchod bstod bar song nas dzap khang dbye zhing*/ bdag mdun dbyer med kyi bskyed bzlas bya/ de nas rnam bum dang las bum bsgrubs nas mchod bstod 'od zhu bcas kyi mthar gsol kha nas bshags skong tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ de nas dngos gzhi ni/ ji ltar dam pa sogs? las bum chus khrus byas la/ spro na bgegs gtor spyi ltar dang bsdu na hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ gu gul bdug badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms/ sa gzhi spos chu?maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po laḥ byang chub ma thob bar du ni: skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi: sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: 'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed do: sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir: gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod: don dam spros bral byang chub sems: rang byung mtha' bral gsal stong bsgom: zhes lan gsum skyabs sems tshogs bsags dkyus gcig tu grub par byas te/ kyaiḥ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yi: dkyil 'khor smin pa'i dbang mchog dag: skal ldan bu la gnang bar stsol: phyin chad bskyed rdzogs rgyud la gnas: zhes gsol ba btab cing dam bca'/ de nas ye shes pa dbab pa ni/

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ t swa bhā w rang nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gsal ba'i snying gar ye shes sems dpa' rdor sems yab yum rjes su chags pa'i sbyor bas snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du spyan drangs te snying ga nas sib sib thim par mos la 'bebs rdzas dang rol mo'i sgra sbyar zhing*/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra sa twa dz+nyā na a be sha ya a aḥ ra ra ra ra tsā la ya tsā la ya hūm̐ āḥhaḥdzhaiṃ/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brtan par bya'o/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang bar badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bar mos la/ hūm̐: chos sku bum pa'i lto ba ru: rdor sems zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: skal ldan bu yi spyi bor bskur: bskyed rim sku yi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de ltar bum pa'i dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gnas skabs lus lhar bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthar thug snod bcud kyasi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bdag nyid bcom ldan dpal rdo rje sems pa'i sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs par yin no/ bhan+dha bde ba chen po'i pho brang du bla ma yab yum sbyor ba'i dkar dmar byang sems bhan+dhar 'khyil ba'i bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag la/

hūm̐: thabs shes bhan+dha mtshan ldan 'di: bdud rtsi sngags phreng gsung dbyangs rdzogs: skal ldan bu yi mgrin par bskur: bzlas brjod sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes bdud rtsi myangs pas rtsa thams cad bdud rtsis gang*/ dug gsum gyi rnam rtog 'gags/ bde ba'i ye shes skyes par bsam/ des gsung gi dbang thob ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gnas skabs ngag sngags kyi 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthar thug sgra skad thams cad grags stong 'gag med bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems pa'i gsung mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ shes rab ye shes ni/ bde stong dbyer med mtshon byed me long sin+dhū ra'i thig le snying gar byugs pas gzugs dang lang tsho rdzogs pa'i shes rab ma snyems ma'i ngo bo pang du 'khod par bsams la/ hūm̐/ 'di bsten sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bla med byang chub mchog gi lam/ /skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas/ /dga' bzhi ye shes rgyas par shog /karma mu dra dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes 'du shes sum ldan gyis rig ma dang mnyam par sbyar bas dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas lhan skyes kyi bde ba brtan par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+mā kau3 haṃ/ zhes brjod cing 'khyud rgya bya/ de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/ thugs kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gnas skabs su lam pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthar thug 'khor 'das kyi rtog tshogs thams cad bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ de nas tshig gi dbang ni/ rang byung ye shes gsal la mi rtog pa'i mtshon byed shel rdo bstan la/ hūm̐: shel rdo chos dbyings dkyil 'khor te: bde stong yan lag ngo sprod rdzogs:

skal ldan bu yi snying gar bskur: yongs rdzogs ka dag dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar dbang bzhi pa bskur bas sgo gsum cha mnyam gyis bsags pa'i bag chags dri ma dag lam khregs chod thod rgal bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na: slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol: bsod nams? bdag 'jug rgyas par mi spro na/ dbang bskur gnas 'dren rab gnas sogs la 'brel ba'i tshe rig me dor ba tsam gyis chog par gsungs pa ltar na/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya om̐/ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swā badz+ra sa ma ya swā/ hā badz+ra sa ma ya hā/ zhes me tog phul bas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams gnyis su med par bsam zhing*/ om̐/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig /om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya ho/ zhes dngos grub bskul zhing bstim mo/ gnang ba zhu ba ni/ thal mo sbyar bas btud de/ om̐/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi slob mar 'jug par 'tshal/ zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ dbang bskur gyi tshe bdag 'jug rgyas par blangs kyang gnang ba zhu ba 'di ni nges par bya dgos so/ gsum pa gzhan don gnas lung gi cho ga 'og tu shes par bya'o/ ༈ rtsa ba'i gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ thog mar tshogs bya ba ni/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gis byin gyis brlabs: hūm̐: bdag nyid rdor sems thugs ka nas:

tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge 'phros: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ las me rlung chus: dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor bdud rtsir bsgyur: hūm̐: phyi snod 'jig rten tshogs gzhong du: nang bcud sems can tshogs su bsgyur: 'khor 'das gnyis med mchod pa'i rdzas: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: om̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdor sems yab yum la: zhi ba sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyis bskor: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar dpyangs cod pan sna tshogs pu ru ru: rin chen snyan cha rgyan gdub khro lo lo: zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan dga' bro ya la la: glu len gar byed bro rdung khrigs se khrig: brda 'gros mnyen lcug 'khril ldem khyugs se khyug: bde stong nyams dbyangs sna tshogs lhangs se lhang : bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od phung kyi li li: byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus rtsal sha ra ra: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen myur du phob: tshogs mchod rdzas la bcud chen sna tshogs phob: dkyil 'khor rdzas la gzi brjid bkrag mdangs skyed: gnas khang 'di la 'od phung 'ja' gur 'khyil: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mor nyams rtogs spel: rten 'brel phun tshogs dga' ston bskyed du gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ de nas tshogs mchod ni: hūm̐: bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes tshogs kyis mchod: sku lnga lhun grub bde chen ngang du bzhes: gnyis med bde stong mchod pas dgyes gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: de nas tshogs kyi skong ba ni: hūm̐: mchod sprin lha mo nam mkha'i gar bsgyur ma: sna tshogs dbang po tshim byed mchod 'dzin tshogs:

bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: byang sems bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsis bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: shes rab skye med gsang ba'i rdzas kyis bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: gsal stong gnyis med sbyor ba'i mchod pas bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag gtor mas bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: nyon mongs rtsa mdud grol ba'i rak+tas bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: phung po 'byung lnga dag pa'i bhan+dha ru: dbang po rnam lnga mchod rdzas bcud kyis bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa'i bhan+dha ru: ma 'gags lhun grub rang byung rdzas kyis bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: ye shes lnga ldan lhun grub bhan+dha ru: dug lnga rnam dag sku lnga rdzas kyis bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: dam tshig sor chud nyams chag bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib bag chags thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib ma lus bral gyur cig:
khams gsum 'khor ba stongs pa'i phrin las mdzod:

de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma rdor sems zhi ba dbyings kyi lha: thugs rje lcags kyus brtse bas dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig bag med dbang gyur pas: phyi nang 'khrul pa'i blo rtog ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha la mthol bshags bzod par gsol: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ bud+dha sa twa hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ rat+na sa twa hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ karma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: sogs yi ge brgya pa bzlas lhag chad bkang : de nas tha ma bsgral ba ni: na mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya sngags dang ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bden pas gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad tshogs tha ma 'di dang gnyis su med par khug cig: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha dza dgra bo nṛ tri mā ra ya dza dzaḥ lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug byas la: hūm̐: nga ni rig pa he ru kaḥ ro gcig lta ba khros pa'i sku: phyag g.yas thabs kyi rdo rje gsor: g.yon pas shes rab phur bu bsgril: ma rig gnyis 'dzin dgra bo rnams: snying rje'i phur bu 'debs shing bsgral: ka dag mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas shog: om̐ badz+ra dharma kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsgral lo: de nas gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams: chos nyid klong yangs dgyes pa'i zhal phyes shig: dug lnga ma rig bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rang grol bde ba chen por dgyes gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na la khā hi: tshogs 'bum gsog thabs ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin rdo rje 'khrul med thugs ka nas: 'od 'phros sbyangs nas tshogs rdzas bdud rtsir gyur: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor zhing khams rab 'byams lha: byin gyis brlab phyir tshogs la gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha la zhal zas tshogs mchod 'bul: phyi nang spyan gzigs mchod pas thugs dam bskang :

ru tra bsgral ba bzhes so nyes skyon bshags: gzigs mdzes rol cig dngos grub a la la: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra khā hi: ga ṇa shud+dhe hoḥ sid+dhi a la la hoḥ bsdu na/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥs pa ri wā ra bh+ya ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha ling+ta khā hi/ yang bsags chog /de nas tshogs la rol/ lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: dpal gyi dam bzhag lhag sdud ma: bhan+dha'i skyogs thogs dur khrod nyul: mi sdug gzugs 'chang rngam pa'i tshogs: lhag ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: om̐ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa khā hi: thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: thugs rjes sems can 'dul slad du: ye shes rol pa'i rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: deng sang thugs dam tha tshig bskul: om̐ ma hā gu ru dz+nyā na hoḥ chad mdo ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar bskal tha ma dus gsum la: kun bzang rdor sems pad+ma yab yum gyis: dkyil 'khor zhal phyes dregs pas khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig phrin las mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐ bha ling+ta khā hi: brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bod khams skyong ba'i ma sring bdud sman tshogs: gzugs mdzes gar sgyur glu len drod nyul ma: stag tshang mchims phur dbang rtags khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la gsang sngags mel tshe mdzod: ma ma hring hring phaiṃ phaiṃ dza bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: rta bro ni/ hūm̐: gtor gzhong 'og tu gnod byed dam sri khug: zhi khro'i bro brdungs dam sri thal bar brlag: nam yang mi ldang rdo rjes rgyas gdab bo: rnam rtog mtshan ma'i ru tra tshar chod cig: om̐ āḥnan hūm̐ nan satwaṃ bha ya nan dz+nyā na hoḥ de nas dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub gnas lugs lta ba'i ngang : ka dag dbyings rig 'od gsal snying po can: nam yang bstan pa'i rgyal sa zin pa yi: 'dod rgu'i ye shes dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: om̐ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: rjes chog la drug /dang po gtang rag mchod bstod ni/

om̐ badz+ra sa twa pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe?shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: kun bzang klong nas zhi dang khro gar sprul: 'gro don yid snang dbyer med rdo rje sems: kun 'dus yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bstod par 'os p sogs kyis bstod/ gnyis pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la: 'gal zhing cho ga lhag chad phud nyams sogs: las ngan bag chags skyon can ma dag sogs: rig pa rdor sems dkyil 'khor lha la bshags: om̐ badz+ra sa twa ?yig brgya brjod la brtan bzhugs bya/ gsum pa bsdu rim ni/ hūm̐: gzugs rnams snang stong sgra rnams grags stong ngang : yid rnams dran stong bskyed rdzogs sgyu ma'i klong : dkyil 'khor mi dmigs hūm̐ dang na dā yal: ma bcos lhun grub chos dbyings ngang la gnas: a a āḥ sa gsal snang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bsdus la/ om̐ gu ru bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: gis slar ldang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rak+ṣa maṃ/ bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ ma rig 'khrul 'khor rigs drug sems can rnams: phan bde'i byang chub lam mchog bgrod pa'i phyir: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dge ba bsod nams tshogs: sa bcu byang chub go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo: lnga pa smon lam ni/ na mo: 'khor gsum yongs dag rdor sems zhi khro yi: dkyil 'khor byang chub dam pa 'di bsgrubs pas: mtha' yas ma gyur 'gro kun sdug bsngal gyi: rgya mtshor bsgral nas sangs rgyas thob par shog: drug pa bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: skyabs gsum ngo bo dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha: zhi khro rigs brgya'i bka' srung gter bdag gis: bar chad sel zhing chos bdag spel ba'i yul: bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: ces bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab bo/ ༈ gsum pa gzhan don gnas lung gi cho ga la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/

dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor sogs sngar bshad pa ltar byas pa'i mdun/ mtshan byang dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i khar bzhag /'og tu dgos pa'i chas bye til yungs dkar sbyong chas/ me long khrus gzhong las bum zas bsngo mar me sogs 'du bya/ gnyis pa cho ga dngos la/ dang po brgyud 'debs nas brtsam dngos gzhi'i cho ga las byang bzlas pa yan song nas/ 'dir las sbyor gyi bzlas pa bya bar spro na/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dang thugs rje'i 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas/ ngan song rnams sbyangs/ bdag gzhan dmigs yul gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing du bsgral bar gyur/ yi ge brgya pa'i sham bu'i mthar/ om̐ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces btags pa bzlas pas/ gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yang snying yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba nyams chag dang rtog sgrib thams cad sbyong bar byed pa 'di bzlas pas rnal 'byor pa rtog sgrib can/ nyams chag can/ gsog 'jog can/ bag chags ngan pa can khyed rnams kyi nyams chag bskangs te ngan song du ltung ba'i las kyi sgrib pa las thar bar 'gyur ro/ tshe 'di la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras kyi dam pa dgongs nas bsrung zhing skyob par mdzad la/ shi 'phos nas kyang bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras kyi thu bor 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o/ zhes gnang ba byin par bsam/ dbang dang gnas 'dren sogs las gzhan sbrel tshe gzhung ltar bum chog bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ gzungs thag la 'khril te bum pa'i nang du song*/ lha yab yum gyi thugs rgyud bskul 'od zer spro bsdu don gnyis mdzad sku'i cha thams cad nas byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar

bsams la rtsa bsnyen bzla/ las bum gong du ma song na 'dir bya/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod song nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul bas lha 'od du zhu ba'i bum chu bdud rtsir bsam mo/ gnyis pa tshe 'das gnas lung gi cho ga la bcu gcig /dang po rten bskyed pa ni/ mtshan byang las bum chus bran la/ om̐ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri sarba dra byāṃ shwa dha ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la ming byang nṛ las chaiga'i gzugs kyi rnam pa ji lta bur gyur bar bsams la/ gnyis pa rnam shes dgug pa ni/ lcags kyu'i rgya dang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer gyis rnam shes bkug par bsams shing*/ na mo rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par sbyong ba la dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi? bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum rigs drug gi gnas gang du gnas kyang skad cig gis rten 'dir mchis par gyur cig om̐ badz+ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ lan gsum gyis rnam shes dang*/ sarba pā paṃ a na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas sdig pa bkug nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rnam shes āḥdakar po'i rnam par rten la bstim/ gsum pa bgegs sbyong ba ni/ gtor ma rten la bskor zhing*/ om̐ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo zhes nas ghṛh+ṇa daṃ bha liṃ d+ye swā hā/ zhes sogs lan gsum gyis zhi ba ting lo dang changs bus bskor zhing hūm̐ bzhi pa lan gsum gyi drag por sbyong ba dang*/ na mo rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par sbyong ba la dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/

gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi? bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i gson gyi dus su tshe srog la bar du gcod pa gshin gyi dus su sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la dpag tshad dang rgyang grags su ma gnas par song zhig /gal te mi 'gro na ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod cing phyed mas sbyongs la gu gul bdug yungs dkar gyis brab drag sngags bzla zhing*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ ha la ha la ha la hūm̐/ rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas pas gtor ma rgyang ring du dor te drag po'i sbyong ba'o/ bzhi pa sdig pa sbyong ba ni/ rten gyi mdun du til dang me chu bshams/ tshe 'das chaiga'i sdig sgrib thams cad kaṃ nag po'i rnam pa sna bug nas thon sna sgor sdig pa'i rnam par gyur te til la thim par bsams shing*/ til g.yas g.yon gyis mer bsregs chur dor la/ om̐ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ sdig pa thams cad ye shes kyi me chus sbyangs par bsam/ de nas sgrib sbyong gi sngags bzlas pa'i bye ma dang yungs dkar brab cing yig brgya dang*/ om̐ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sogs dang ngan song sbyong ba'i sngags mang du bzlas mthar/ tshe 'das kyis bskal pa stong nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyong dka' ba om̐ pā paṃ badz+ra bi shwa bhi shud+dhe ye swā hā/ sdig sgrib thams cad nyi mas ba mo bzhus pa bzhin dag par bsam mo/ lnga pa khrus bya ba ni/ thog mar dkyil 'khor sogs rten gyi gzugs brnyan shar ba'i me long la khrus gsol zhing*/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs sku khrus gsol/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la/ /nyon mongs dri ma mi mnga' yang*/ /tshe 'das sgo gsum sgrib bral phyir/ /gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo/ om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ kā ya bi shwa dha ni swā hā/ zhes sku phyis/ khrus chus slar blugs pa'i bum pas ming byang ngam rten la bkru zhing*/ hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni ye shes lnga yi ngang : tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol bas: dug lnga'i sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: yig brgya'i mthar tshe 'das chaiga'i shes bya'i sgrib pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ bag chags kyi sgrib pa dang*/ las kyi sgrib pa dang*/ kun nas bslangs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig: om̐ sarba pā paṃ shwa dha na ye swā hā/ gzhan yang*/ 'di ni phyin drug rang bzhin chu: nyon mongs dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: phar phyin chu yis legs bkrus pas: nyon drug dri ma dag gyur cig: ces dang yig brgya'i mthar: tshe 'das shes bya'i sgrib? sogs dang gong ltar brjod cing bkrus pas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis nyon mongs pa'i thal ba'ang sbyangs par bsam/ drug pa skyabs 'gror 'jug pa ni/ tshe 'das dkyil 'khor sa la phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'debs par bsams la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: kun bzang klong yangs zhi dang khro gar sprul: 'gro don yid snang dbyer med rdo rje sems: kun 'dus rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: dug lnga gnas dag rigs lnga longs spyod rdzogs: 'byung lnga gnas dag yum lnga so sor gsal: yab yum spyan la zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: rtsa khams 'khor lo'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo:

hūm̐: kau rī tsau ri la sogs dbyings phyug ging : sgo ba sgo ma sprul sku thub pa drug: mtshams dang laṅka la sogs 'gro 'dul gyi: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ sogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ bdun pa dbang bskur ba ni/ tshe 'das skad cig gis dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te thim par gyur/ snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra a be sha ya a āḥ btags pa brjod la rol mo sgrog tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa brtan par bya/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: chos sku'i bum pa stong gsal 'di: rdor sems zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: khyod kyi gnas gsum bzhag pa yis: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bum pa gnas gsum reg cing bum chu 'dod yon nang du blug /brgyad pa zas gtad pa ni/

tshe 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur zhes bskyed pa'i mdun du bza' btung sna tshogs bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin las grub pa'i 'dod yon gyi dngos po gzugs mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod kyi 'khor los sprin chen po gyur: na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo? sngags rgyas byin brlabs la/ phyogs dus kun na gzugs sgra dri ro reg /reg bya khyad par dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob khyod la 'bul/ /zag med dga' bdes rtag tu tshim par shog om̐ gu ru bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra sa twa pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bsngos/ dgu pa 'khor bar ma chags par gdams pa ni/ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: rigs drug gnas na bde ba med: sdug bsngal las la ma chags par: ma yengs rtse gcig dran pas zungs: bcu pa lam ston gyis gnas spar ba ni/ hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: rnam shes rlung gi rta pho la: rig pa gsal ba'i mi bos bzung : dbu ma chos dbyings lam la gshegs: klong yangs 'og min zhing khams su: bcom ldan rdor sems yab yum bzhugs: dbyer med de yi sras nyid du: rlung gi shugs la sems kyi rtsal: rig pa dri med āḥdakar de: zang thal skar mda' chad pa ltar: phaṭ sgra drag po'i brtul zhugs kyis: ldog med rdor sems thugs kar thim: hika: drag po gsum gyis spar/ zhes rnam shes āḥthung gi rnam pa spyi bo nas thon 'og min zhing du song nas rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar thim par bsam mo/ bcu gcig pa mtshan byang sreg pa ni/ nub tha ma'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi me zer byung bas tshe 'das kyi phung khams skye mched 'khor ba'i chos thams cad dmigs med ka dag gi dbyings su sbyangs par bsams la me sbar zhing*/

hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings kyi thabs khung du/ /bdag 'dzin phung po'i bud shing la/ /shes rab ye shes me sbar te/ /tshe 'das nyon mongs bag chags bsreg /'di ni skye 'gag smon pa dang*/ /gnas med mtshan ma med pa'i me/ /'di ni rang byung ye shes me/ /bdag 'dzin mtshan ma'i rtog pa bsreg /don la bsreg bya sreg byed kun/ /bya rtsol med par ye sangs rgyas/ /'bad med lhun grub chos kyi sku/ /rang byung ye shes der snang ngo*/ yig brgya'i mthar/ ag+ne dz+nyā na dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes zag bcas kyi phung po zag med du bsgyur bar bya'o/ thal ba sāts+tsha gdab/ bsngo ba smon lam ji ltar 'os pas mtshams sbyar ro/ de nas tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma phyin chad mthar chags su btang bas grub par bya'o/ zhes rdzogs pa chen po 'khor 'das yongs grol las/ rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi cho ga'i 'don khrigs blo dman 'jug bde zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ lam 'dir mos pa mi phyed dge ba can rang slob rdo bla au ḍī ya na'i mtshan 'dzin nas/ sngar gyi dz+nyā na shrī bha dra'i chog khrigs zhib mor bzhugs kyang phal cher tshan thor du gyur pa dang 'ga' zhig rjes 'jug rnams kyis/ rang 'dod bzhin gsar btsud mdzad pas rtsa ba'i sa bcad 'khrugs shing lta mi bde bar gyur pa dang*/ gzhan yang du ma zlos skyon can sogs bdag 'dra'i blo dman rnams kyis nyams su len par mi bde bas/ tshul 'dir bsnyen sgrub kyi 'jug pa bde phyir kha gsal zhing nar 'gros su bklag chog bgyis na/ ma 'ongs par sgrub sde rnams dang grong chog pa su la'ang phan thogs par 'dug pas/ cis kyang de bzhin bsgrigs rogs zhes nan bskul ngor lung zin chos kyi bdag po ar+ya dh+wa dza'i skyes mthar 'bod pa'i gdol spyod pa/ gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis gter gzhung rtsa ba'i tshig rkang dang dz+nyā na shrī bha dra'i bsgrigs chags la gzhi bcol/ rigs mthun gzhan nas kyang kha 'gengs dgos pa sab la mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po srid 'dir bltams par mdzad pa'i gnas mchog

/lum+bī ni'i tshal dang gu ru pad+mas gangs can gdul bya bdag gir bzhes pa'i thugs bskyed gnang ba'i yul/ mchod sdong chen po bya rung kha shor sogs khyad du 'phags pa'i gnas mchog du mas brgyan pa'i bal yul chos ldan gyi khab chen po'i char/ sgrub gnas kyi rgyal po yang le shod gnam lcags sgrub sder rab byung bcu bdun pa chu mo lug gi lor/ cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can du brtsams par bgyis skabs/ yi ge pa ni bskul ba pos bgyis la de bzhin zhu dag gi mthun 'gyur 'brong smyon mkhyen rab zla shar gyis mdzad pas/ 'di la dge ba'i cha mchis na ma rgan gyi gtsos pa'i 'brel thogs sems can rnams mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du skye ba'i rgyu ru smon zhing nor 'khrul mchis na/ rtsa gsum lha la mthol zhing bshags kyi bzod par mdzad du gsol lo// // ka) dpal chen dregs zil gyi gsol 'debs ni/ e ma ho/ gnas mchog lcang lo can gyi pho brang du/ /sangs rgyas thugs kyi sprul pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /dpal chen phyag na rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /steng 'og phyogs bzhir thugs kyis 'gro don mdzad/ /ye shes sprul pa'i bya khyung la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang 'dul der ston thog med rtsal shugs 'chang*/ 'jigs mdzad rā hu la la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyi/ /gnas skabs 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /mthar thug don gnyis 'bad med yid bzhin 'grub/ /gsang ba'i bdag po nyid dang dbyer med shog / ces gsang bdag dregs pa zil gnon gyi cha lag tu 'di bzhin dgos zhes 'phan bla'i ngor sgo blas so// // kha) ༈ dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las: las byang gnam lcags rdo rje'i go cha bzhugs so: bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon lha la 'dud:

sa ma ya: de yang dpal chen gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po g.yul las rgyal byed sgrub par byed pa la: thog mar bsgrub pa'i dal du 'jug cing : nyams len thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bcas kyi phyi nang nyer spyod 'khod par bya: mchod pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi spyi mthun nyer mkho bsham: de nas bsgrub pa'i dal du 'jug pa ni: thog mar: na mo: dpal chen kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: sgo gsum rtsol bral ngang gis skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa: hoḥ ma gyur 'gro ba srid bsdus kun gyi ched: bdag gis dpal chen bsgrubs nas go 'phang dgod: gsum pa: hūm̐: bdag nyid gsang bdag 'bar ba'i pho nya y-i: bden pas gnod byed gtor ma len phyir khug: om̐ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ gnod byed bgegs tshogs aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ bzhi pa ni: hūm̐: bgegs rnams mchod sbyin gtor mas tshims shing bzhud: bar chod glags lta u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje'i gur khang bla bre phyi nang 'khrigs: log 'dren bgegs kyis rgyu ba mtshams chod cig: badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: drug pa ni: hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid kyi tshogs: sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs mchod pa bla med gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta om̐ āḥhūm̐: dang po: hūm̐: dang por chos rnams dmigs su med: bar du 'gags med rtsal snang las: tha mar sna tshogs sprul skur sgrub: de las yig 'bru phun sum tshogs: om̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ suṃ keṃ bh+rūm̐: 'byung ba yongs gyur gzhal yas khang : sgo gru mu mtha' tshang ba'i dbus: lha srin sde brgyad khri steng du: pad+ma nyi zla'i steng dbus su: hūm̐ las skyes pa'i dpal chen sku: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo gri: g.yon gsum khyung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs:

gtum gshe rngam rgod tshul du gsal: spyi bor thugs kyi bya khyung lding : mdun du gza' mchog glog dmar 'khyugs: ye shes me dpung klong du gsal: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros 'og min phyogs bcu nas: dpal chen lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: gnyis pa: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang dang : lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: gtum chen khro rgyal gshegs su gsol: ri rab 'bar ba'i dbus nyid nas: mkha' lding 'bar ba gshegs su gsol: nam mkha'i dbyings kyi 'od klong nas: ki kang gza' mchog gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas pho brang dbus su bzhugs: sku gsum lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ gnyis pa mchod pa ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod gar ma lang ling tshogs kyis mchod: gsang mchod gzugs mdzes dpag med gtibs pas mchod: sbyor mchod zag med bde ba dgyes pas mchod: sman mchod dza gad gser skyems phud kyis mchod: gtor mchod ba liṃ rgyan rdzogs bcud kyis mchod: rak+ta dgyes pa chags med mdangs ldan mchod: bsgral mchod nyon mongs ye sgrol shes par mchod: mnyam bzhag rang bzhin rdzogs chen kho na'i mchod: mchod yul sbyin mkhan bla med ngo bor mchod: gsang bdag gtum por kun gzhi 'gyur med mchod: bya khyung rgyal por gsal stong 'gags med mchod: gza' mchog rgyal por tshogs drug lhug bzhag mchod: kun kyang chos dbyings ye shes chen po yi: rtsol bral rin chen mchod pas dgyes gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na kha kha khā hi: om̐ sarba dharma dz+nyā na pañtsa om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsum pa bstod pa ni: hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos dpal chen zil gnon khro: bdud las rab rgyal dregs pa'i rje bo ni:

sku mdog mthing nag chos sku 'gyur ba med: dkar dmar mthing bzhad dgyes pa'i khro bo yi: rab 'jigs zhal nas hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: spyan rtsa sdang mig 'khyil bas srid gsum sngangs: dbu skra gyen brdzes lha khams yom zhing 'gul: thod skam dbu rgyan rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs: cod pan spras pas zhing khams rgyan 'phyangs rdzogs: phyag g.yas rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo yis: snang srid lha srin zil gyis gnon par byed: phyag g.yon khyung khra kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul zhags kyis: srid gsum gdon bgegs 'byung po 'joms par byed: rdo rje'i sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs pa yis: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha zlog par byed: glang ko'i zhing lpags stag sham brjid pa yis: bdud srin dam sri 'gong po 'dul bar byed: rdo rje'i go ldan rus rgyan chu srin gyis: nyon mongs 'khrul 'dzin rtsad nas gcod par byed: sbrul gzugs rgyan phreng rin chen spras pa yis: 'khor 'das rtog pa zil gyis gnon par byed: zhabs bzhis lha srin steng du 'gyings pa yis: che btsan kun gyi nus pa zil gyis gnon: sku la dus mtha'i me dpung 'bar ba yis: stong khams g.yo zhing khyab pa'i gzi brjid mched: bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon sku la bstod: hūm̐: spyi bor thugs kyi sprul pa ga ru ṭa'iḥ gnam lcags rwa la rdo rje'i mchu sder bgrad: ma rungs klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul bar byed: me gshog rdeb cing gser mig 'khyil ba yis: dregs pa yongs kyi cho 'phrul zlog par byed: dug sbrul gsol zhing gdol pa 'dzin pa yis: ma rungs bdud srin rtsad nas 'joms par byed: bya khyung 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dzaḥ snang srid dbu ma'i dbyings kyi las byed pa: stong khams 'di ru drag rtsal ldan pa yi: lho nub gnas pa'i ki kang dmar 'od can: pha ni srin po ma ni 'dod chags klu: klu bdud bshos pa rlung khams dud kha'i mdangs:

dbu dgus theg pa rim dgu'i bstan pa srung : spyi bor bya rog bstan pa'i bya ra byed: phyag g.yas ral gri gnam lcags thog mda' yis: ma rungs gdug pa'i snying la 'debs par byed: phyag g.yon cod pan sbrul nag zhags pa yis: bdag la sdang ba'i byad ma 'ching bar byed: sku lus thams cad mig gis gang ba yis: dregs pa kun gyi gzi brjid 'phrog par byed: lto bar srid pa las kyi zhal gdangs pas: nyon mongs 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem par byed: sbrul mjug rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khyil ba yis: 'byung ba las kyi mnga' dbang bsgyur bar byed: rdzu 'phrul gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs pa yis: bdud sde'i tshogs la mtshon cha'i thog chen 'bebs: gsang sngags bstan pa'i srung mar bdag bstod do: bsnyen dmigs ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid gtum po'i thugs ka ru: gser gyi mchod rten ser po'i dbus: me long nyi zla 'khor lo'i steng : hūm̐ mthing tshwa tshwa 'phros pa'i mthar: rtsa sngags g.yas su 'khor ba yis: lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bsregs: yar 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mchod: mar 'phros stong gsum dgra bgegs bcom: tshur 'dus gzi byin 'bar bar gyur: gtum chen sngags phreng ni: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ khyung sngags ni: om̐ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ khyab 'jug sngags ni: om̐ ki kang hrī rā hu la ke sha ke ta hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ drag sngags bcu tsho re la: khyung sngags brgya phrag re khyab 'jug lnga bcu tsam bzla: gzhung gi bsnyen sgrub ji ltar bya rung : khyad par lha srin sde brgyad kyis 'khu na drag sngags rang bzlas kyang mthun: rgyun gyi thams cad spros med lugs ltar bsgrubs kyang rung : zhogs par las byang tshar gcig bskyed rim gsal gdab: nyin mo hūm̐ sgrub bcas ci lcogs bya: ༈ de nas tshogs gtong ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen thugs ka nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ dang om̐ āḥhūm̐:

dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor bla med spel: tshogs mchod 'dod yon bdud rtsir gyur: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ dharma shud+dhe āḥhūm̐: dang po ni: hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod pho brang nas: dpal chen gsang bdag gtum po la: sprul pa bka' skyong srung mas bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gnyis pa mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gsum pa skong bshags ni: hūm̐: phyi nang spyan gzigs mthun rdzas kyis: gsang bdag lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag sor chud nyes ltung bshags: phyin chad mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: sogs yig brgya brjod: bzhi pa bsgral mchod ni: hūm̐: lcags khang nang du ru tra mngon sum gsal: mchog gsum bden pas dgra bo gzugs la phob: phur thun mtshon cha 'bar bas bsgral gtubs nas: dpal chen gtum po'i lha tshogs zhal du mchod: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi:

lnga pa lhag ma ni: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan gnas nyul lhag sdud ma: mi sdug gzugs 'chang dur khrod tshogs khang 'grim: sha khrag la dgyes ging chen laṅka srin: lhag ma 'di bzhes gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: om̐ ma tri rak+sha ṇa yak+sha u tsi ta kha kha khā hi: dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen lha tshogs thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i phyi nang 'gal rkyen sol: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs byad zor bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ he ru ka kro ti shrī tsaṇ+ḍa a i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gnyis pa chad mdo gtong ba ni: hūm̐: 'og min gnas dang me ri 'bar ba nas: lha srin sde dpon dregs sdes khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la gsang sngags bstan pa skyongs: ma rungs dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog: om̐ kro ta kro ti he ru ka la yak+sha ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod khams skyong mdzad brtan ma skyong ba'i tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan spras gar sgyur gtor ma longs: 'dzam gling 'di ru bdag gnas yul gru'i tshogs: tshe chos zas nor longs spyod bkra shis spel: om̐ ma ma ting ting rak+mo rak+sha i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa rta bro brdung ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kas: dam sri bsgral nas rta bro rdung : chem chem dgra bo'i mgo nas rdung : mnan mnan nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ bh+rūm̐ tsakra ya dgra bo nan: lnga pa dngos grub 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: lcang lo can gyi khyab bdag he ru kaḥ bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon dkyil 'khor gyi: dbang bskur sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: lha srin dbang du 'du ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ sa ma ya badz+ra dha ra sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: drug pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: stong nyid snying rjes 'gro ba'i klong la khyab: nges don ma rtogs rmongs gzugs nyon mongs tshogs:

sku bzhi'i dbyings thim skye med a ru ldang : a a āḥ bdun pa bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐: nam mkha'i gos can srid gsum lto bar 'gengs: 'bar ba'i pho nya mkha' lding dbyings la 'gyed: rlung zhags 'gengs pa dbu ma'i pho nya rgyu: zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bkra shis shog: brgyad pa bsngo ba smon lam ni: hoḥ bsngo bya ye nas ma grub sbyin gtong bral: bsngo mkhan byed po ma dmigs gnyug ma'i gshis: bsngo 'bras 'khor gsum yongs dag dge ba bsngo: kun kyang sa bcu'i rtser son byang chub shog: ces mi dmigs 'khor gsum yongs dag dge ba bsngo: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug dregs 'dul dkyil 'khor gyi: sgrub pa'i go rim las gzhung don chen bzhag: yang gsang 'di nyid jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis: yi ger bgyis nas zab gsang gter du sbos: yang mtha'i snyigs dus rtsod ldan shar ba'i tshe: rig 'dzin rdo rje'i ming dang 'phrad nas kyang : skal ldan rdo rje las ldan de la sprod: rdo rje gsang bdag zab don-i atsha rgya: rdo rje dbyings kyi bdag pos rgya 'di srungs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kho bo gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes lha rtse brag nas lcags phag lor gdan drangs pa 'di kong po brag gsum rdo rje'i brag nas phyag na rdo rje dregs pa zil gnon gter gnas zung 'jug yin pa ste mdo khams nā ga ko ṭa'i rā dza badz+ra ā yur wā gīs e waṃ du shog ser nas bshus so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ga) dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las: khyab 'jug gtor 'bul byad ma rtsad brlag bzhugs so: rdo rje gtum po rab tu 'bar ba la gus pas 'dud: de yang thun gtor 'bul ba ni: lcags zangs bhan+dha'i snod gang du: dpal gtor g.yas gcus 'khor gsum la: dmar rgyan bcas pas spras nas su: hūm̐ dzaḥ bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i pho brang nas: mngon spyod las mdzad ki kang mi bsrun pa: khyab 'jug chen po 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs:

dug khrag nag po ngad ldan rlabs su 'phyur: dmar chen gtor ma bcud ldan ri ltar brjid: dgra bgegs don snying nang rol dbang po'i tshogs: drang srong ki kang rgyal po'i zhal du 'bul: sde brgyad stong rtsa brgyad kyi zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs cham la phob: gsang sngags gnyan la gdug pa'i dgra dar na: mthu ldan chos skyong khyed kyis sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ hrīḥrā hu la ki kang hrīḥshag ru raṃ dgra bgegs kyi bla srog la kha raṃ khā hi: rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter ma'o: nga) dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las: skong ba bar chad kun sel bzhugs so: bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas skong ba bya ba'i rim pa ni: phyi nang gsang ba'i nyer mkho mchod rdzas rnams tshang bar bsags shing : yid dmigs ting 'dzin rnam gsum dang ma bral bar g.yo med khyab brdal ye shes chen po'i rnal 'byor gyi ngang nas skong ba bya'o: hūm̐: lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: gtum chen khro rgyal he ru kaḥ gsang bdag dregs pa zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus pa: thugs dam bskang phyir gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam gyi gdan la bzhugs: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: phyi mchod 'dod yon lha mo'i tshogs: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dga' ba bzhi: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga: rten gtor rtag gtor thun gtor dang : ga ṇa tshogs kyi longs spyod rdzas: bdud rtsi su ra chang gi phud: spyan gzigs gzugs 'gros sna tshogs pa: blos blangs dngos 'byor yid sprul nas: ma tshang med pa'i bskang rdzas 'dis: gsang bdag gtum po'i thugs dam bskang : ye shes khyung gi thugs dam bskang : gza' mchog rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang :

gter srung dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bskang ba skye med ngang du bskang : mchod du med de gnyis med mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug sbyor: sgrol du med de dug lnga sgrol: bshags su med de dbyings su bshags: ye mchod ye grol chen po 'dis: thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur cig: phyi nang dam tshig nyams pa sol: las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen zil gnon lha tshogs dgongs: bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur pa'i: nyams chag nyes ltung ci mchis pa: mthol lo bshags so bzod par gsol: om̐ badz+ra sogs? sa twa āḥ sogs yig brgya brjod: rjes shes mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go: mthar tshogs bshags bsgral ba lhag ma phyin chad bya'o: zhes dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags rdo rje'i go cha'i skong bsdus so: sarba maṅga laṃ/ e ka pre tsa// // ca) dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las: smad las pha rol byad ma rgol 'joms bzhugs so: bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang dpal chen gsang bdag gi: las mtha' byad bzlog bstan pa la: lcags snod dam ni gang rung du: ma traṃ dbus su chos 'byung steng : liṅga gzhug cing 'gugs gzhug bya: de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi bri: phyi rol rdo rje me ris bskor: 'bru nag dpal gtor che ba la: chung ba bzhi dang khrag skyus bskor: mdun du gza' gtor g.yas gcus bzhag: rtsang dang zor rdzas mtha' ru bskor: drag po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas: rnga brdung dung 'bud rak+tas bran: sa ma ya: dang po sgrub pa'i lha bskyed ni: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid drag po'i zhing : gtum drag 'byung ba bang rim bsnol mar brtsegs: sa gzhi smug nag dur khrod me dpung klong : bh+rūm̐ las sra mkhregs gnam lcags gzhal yas khang :

gru bzhi sgo bzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i tog: de dbus nyi zla ti ra bam chen steng : mthing nag hūm̐ las gsang bdag dpal chen sku: mthing nag zhal gsum gdangs shing spyan rtsa g.yo: sma ra smin ma dbu skra me ltar 'bar: bhan+dha skam po'i rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: tshwa tshwa 'khrugs pa'i dar nag cod pan 'phur: dug sbrul rigs lngas skra bcing lhu tshigs brgyan: g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri phyar: za byed rngam pa'i khro bo me ltar 'bar: g.yon gsum khyung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul zhags 'phen: gsod byed khro mo sha za chu ltar khol: stobs bcu'i dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs: zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgegs dpung sa la bsgyil: sku la stong khams sreg pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: 'jigs byed dpa' bo stobs ldan sku ru gsal: spyi bor thugs kyi sprul pa ga ru ṭaḥ lcags ru zangs mchu gser mig sder gshog bgrad: klu dang sa bdag ma rungs zil gyis gnon: mdun du khyab 'jug dud kha dbu dgu pa: phyag bzhi ral gri chu srin mda' gzhu sbrul: sku lus mig brgyan lte zhal sbrul mjug 'khyil: ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal: hūm̐: shar du ban byed 'joms pa'i stag gdong ma: sku mdog dmar nag rngam pa'i nga ro can: phyag g.yas me zor g.yon pas chu zor bsnams: lho ru bon byed 'joms pa'i dred gdong ma: sku mdog kham nag gdug pa'i mche ba gtsigs: phyag g.yas kong zor g.yon pas thun zor bsnams: nub tu 'dre rgod 'joms pa'i dom gdong ma: sku mdog mthing nag gtum chen drag sngags can: phyag g.yas nyungs zor g.yon pas khram zor bsnams: byang du dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i spyang gdong ma: sku mdog ljang nag sha khrag dgyes pa mo'i: g.yas pas mtshe zor g.yon pas khrag zor bsnams: thams cad gar stabs dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: ha ha dgyes pa'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrog: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha 'joms par gsal:

de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: gsang bdag khro rgyal lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: 'og min lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: gtum chen khro rgyal lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: dbus phyogs ri rgyal 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas: khyung chen mkha' lding rgyal po gshegs su gsol: nam mkha' dbyings kyi dug rlangs 'tshubs dbus nas: gza' mchog ki kang 'bar ba gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi thod mkhar me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus: srog gcod ma mo rigs bzhi gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas pho brang gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: ye shes sku gsum lha la phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ gsum pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid kyi tshogs: sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs mchod pa bla med 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas byad ma bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe sogs?nas shab+da sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa bstod pa ni: hūm̐: gtum chen khro rgyal gsang bdag he ru kaḥ lha srin dregs pa 'dul ba'i mthu stobs can: ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar gcod pa: thugs mchog khro rgyal sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: spyi bor thugs kyi sprul pa ga ru ṭaḥ gnam lcags rwa ldan rdo rje'i mchu sder bgrad: ma rungs sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul bar byed: bya khyung 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dzaḥ snang srid dbu ma dbyings kyi las byed pa: stong khams 'di ru drag rtsal ldan pa yi: lho nub gnas pa'i ki kang rā hu la: gza' mchog khyab 'jug sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ drag shul rngam pa'i dpa' stobs gar dgus brgyan: snang srid yongs kyi byad kha dgra la 'bebs:

las la chas byed srog bdag khro mo'i tshogs: ma rungs rgol ba 'joms mdzad bzhi la bstod: lnga pa bsnyen pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid gtum po'i thugs ka ru: gser gyi mchod rten ser po'i dbus: me long nyi zla 'khor lo'i steng : hūm̐ mthing tshwa tshwa 'phros pa'i mthar: rtsa sngags g.yas su 'khor ba yis: lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bsregs: yar 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mchod: mar 'phros stong gsum dgra bgegs bcom: tshur 'dus srog thim gzi brjid skyed: slar yang khro bo 'khor la phog: rab 'phros pha rol byad kha bzlog: kun kyang gzi brjid 'bar bar bsgom: gtum chen sngags phreng ni: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ khyung sngags ni: om̐ khroṃ raṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ khyab 'jug gi sngags ni: om̐ ki kang hrīḥrā hu la ke sha ke ta hūm̐ dza dzaḥ khro mo'i sngags ni: oṃ kro ti raṃ bh+yo tsa tur mu kha tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces gtum po'i sngags rtags ma byung bar du bzla: khyung dang khyab 'jug de'i bcu cha tsam: khro mo las rung ni khri yis chog: byad bzlog zor thun gyi sngags ni: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa he kro ta kā la sa ha tsakra lo hi tsakra ti tri tsakra ya gnod byed 'byung po byad ma rnams kyi srog rtsa la rbad rbad: om̐ kri ti ma tri baṃ bh+yo tsa tur mu kha ram̐ ha la ya: pha rol gyi byad zor phur kha ngan pa thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: zlog sngags ni: hūm̐ trig rā dza ya thun bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yoḥ dgra la zlog: raṃ ha la mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yoḥ dgra la zlog: trag ha la nā ga ye bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yoḥ dgra la zlog: shag rak+ta rbad tri ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yoḥ dgra la zlog: mā ra ya rbad thun bh+yo rak+sha bh+yoḥ zhes bzlog thun gyi char phab pas pha rol byad ma rdul du brlags nas ming yang med par bsam: sa ma ya: de nas bsad pa'i las la 'jug pa ni: mdun du gser skyems gtsang bshos:

hom khung nang du nya bo dang : g.yab dar bya rog 'ug pa'i sgro: mtshon cha thun rdzas bsgral chas bsag: sngags 'chang nga rgyal dang ldan pas: gzu dpang mkhyen par gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum dang yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong srung ma bcas: khyad par dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs dang : sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol: bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shing : dben par bla ma lha dang yi dam gyi: bsnyen sgrub bskyed sngags rdzogs gsum gzhir bzung nas: phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par dam bcas kyang : gnod byed dam med 'di yis mi ster ro: dgongs shig kun mkhyen khyed kyis gzigs mdzod la: bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma sgrol: mthu rtsal nus phyungs mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: gser skyems rim par 'thor: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : sgyu 'phrul zhi khro rab 'byams dregs 'dul tshogs: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: khyad par dpal chen phyag na rdo rje dang : mkha' lding khyab 'jug khro mo rigs bzhi yis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: dpal chen chos srung dam can srung ma'i tshogs: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad yul bdag gnas: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: mkha' la rgyu ba'i dregs ldan 'khor bcas kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: rbad pa'i dam can srung ma mthu ma chung : deng 'dir bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

hom bskyed ni: phaṭḥ mdun du gnam lcags las grub pa'i btson khang nag po kha dog la: mthil yangs pa: zin na thar pa med pa: nṛ tri las skyes pa'i gnod byed byad ma'i gzugs phung sngo la ham pa skya la rid pa kha ngu ba mig shi mig: yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams shing nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gyur: na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du yang dpal chen phyag na rdo rje dregs 'dul drag sngags kyi bka' bden pa dang : thugs sprul bya khyung 'bar ba'i bka' bden pa dang : gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu'i bka' bden pa dang : bka' sdod dregs tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi bka' bden pa dang : lha sngags ting 'dzin rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : rnal 'byor bdag gi drag sngags dmod pa'i mthu la brten nas: gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs dam sri byad phur mnan gtad ngan sngags byed pa'i dgra gdon mi dang mi min spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra: sgos rnal 'byor pa bdag la sdang ba: mdor na bsam sbyor ngan pa 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong dam log bdud rigs bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i lha srung mgon byed dang bcas pa thams cad: skad cig rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cig: nṛ tri yaṃ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas 'gugs shing pho nya 'gyed pa ni: bh+yoḥ dzaḥlas rdo rje lcags kyu ma: dgra bo'i snying nas zungs la shog: hūm̐ las rin chen zhags pa ma: dgra bo'i mgul nas chings la shog: baṃ las pad+ma lcags sgrog ma: dgra bo'i yan lag sdoms la shog: hoḥlas karma dril bu ma:

dgra bo'i dran pa myos su chug: rang dbang med par khug la shog: rbad pa'i pho nya mthu ma chung : badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ pā sha hoḥ s+pho ṭa baṃḥ ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ lha dbye bya ba ni bya rog 'ug sgro thogs la: hūm̐: khā kha mu kha bya rog gdong : phyag na spu gri dmar po bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo lha dang phyes: srung skyob mgon byed phral bar gyis: hu lu mu kha 'ug pa'i mgo: phyag na rlung gi 'khor lo 'dzin: dam nyams dgra bo bdud dang sprod: bcings shing byad du bcug par gyis: om̐ khā kha mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: hu lu mu kha dgra bo rbad thum ril trig nan mā ra ya rbad: de nas phur pa thogs la: hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa'i sras: gtum chen badz+ra kī la ya'i: phyag gnyis ri rab phur pa bsgril: rgya mdud 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: 'chang bzung glog dmar khyugs se khyug: chu srin ser ba chi li li: zur gsum thog rgod sha ra ra: rtse mor tshwa tshwa si li li: btab bo badz+ra kī la ya: dkar nag snying gi rtsa chod la: myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya gnod byed 'byung po tshal pa shag gtub mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces pas bsgral zhing rnam shes spar: 'o khyod kyi rnam shes āḥyig dkar por gyur nas 'og min gyi gnas su phaṭḥ ces pas 'og min gyi gnas su 'phang : de nas thun rdzas btab cing : hūm̐: nyungs thun khro bo sha ra ra: dug thun bu yug chi li li: me thun dmar nag lhabs se lhab: khrag thun nad rlangs thibs se thib: rdo thun zi ra khyugs se khyug: mtshe thun las rlung 'u ru ru: rdo rje'i thog rgod sha ra ra: phur thun drag po hri li li: ral gri mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ myog thun tshal pa ya shig shig: ces pas gtubs shing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gtum chen khro rgyal he ru kaḥ dpal chen phyag rdor lha tshogs kyi:

zhal phyes dgra bo'i sha khrag 'bul: dug lnga skye med dbyings su rol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: zhes phul byad ma dgra bgegs dngos su gsol bar bsam: sa ma ya: de nas zlog thabs bstan pa ni: dmar gtor liṅga lha grangs bshams: 'gugs gzhug drag po lan gsum bya: rkang gling rol mo dar nag g.yab: sha chen gsur btang rak+tas bran: hūm̐: 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: dpal chen phyag rdor dregs pa zil gnon pa: gtum chen drag po'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dmag dpung skyed la bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gtum chen khro rgyal rab 'jigs he ru kaḥ sku mdog mthing nag chos sku 'gyur ba med: dkar dmar mthing bzhad dgyes la khro ba yis: sku gsum sgrib pa'i nyon mongs dgra la zlog: rab 'jigs zhal nas hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: ye shes khro bo'i drag sngags dgra la zlog: spyan rtsa sdang mig glog ltar 'khyugs pa yis: 'jig rten khro bo'i dmod pa dgra la zlog: dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzis pa yis: lha khams yom zhing 'gul ba'i ltas ngan zlog: thod skam rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa yis: rigs lnga'i sa lam bar chad dgra la zlog: dar nag cod pan rgyan 'phyang 'phur ba yis: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i sun ma dgra la zlog: phyag g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri yis: snang srid lha 'dres zil gnon dgra la zlog: phyag g.yon khyung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul zhags kyis: srid gsum gdon bgegs 'byung po dgra la zlog: rdo rje'i sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs pa yis: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha dgra la zlog: glang ko zhing lpags stag sham brjid pa yis: nyon mongs dug lnga'i 'khrul 'dzin dgra la zlog: rdo rje'i go khrab rus rgyan chu srin gyis: bdud srin dam sri 'gong po dgra la zlog:

sbrul gdugs rgyan phreng rin chen spras pa yis: 'khor 'das rtog pas zil gnon dgra la zlog: zhabs bzhi lha srin steng du 'gyings pa yis: che btsan kun gyis zil gnon dgra la zlog: sku la dus mtha'i me dpung 'bar ba yis: stong khams yom zhing 'khrug pa dgra la zlog: bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon lha tshogs kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad zor bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: spyi bor thugs kyi sprul pa ga ru ṭaraḥ gnam lcags rwa ldan rdo rje'i mchu sder bgrad: ma rungs klu gnyan sa bdag bzlog tu gsol: me gshog rdeb cing gser mig 'khyil ba yis: dregs pa yongs kyi cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: dug sbrul gsol zhing gdol pa 'dzin pa yis: bdud dang klu srin ma rungs bzlog tu gsol: bya khyung rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa yis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad zor bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: dzaḥ snang srid dbu ma dbyings kyi las byed pa: lho nub gnas pa'i klu srin rā hu la: sku mdog dud kha dbu dgu bya rog mgos: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ru tra bzlog tu gsol: phyag g.yas ral gri gnam lcags thog mda' yis: ma rungs dgra bgegs 'byung po bzlog tu gsol: phyag g.yon rgyal mtshan sbrul nag zhags pa yis: bdag la sdang ba'i byad ma bzlog tu gsol: sku lus thams cad mig gis brgyan pa yis: dregs pa yongs kyi byad zor bzlog tu gsol: lte ba srid pa'i zhal gdangs khros pa yis: nyon mongs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzlog tu gsol: sbrul mjug rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khyil ba yis: 'byung lnga'i tsha grang 'thab pa bzlog tu gsol: rdzu 'phrul gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs pa yis: bdud sdes mtshon char 'bebs pa bzlog tu gsol: drang srong gza' mchog rgyal po'i lha tshogs kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad zor bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod:

hūm̐ bh+yoḥ thod mkhar dmar nag me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus: khrag mtsho nyi zla bam gyi gdan gyi steng : shar du stag gdong dmar nag rngam pa yis: ban de'i byad zor phur kha bzlog tu gsol: lho ru dred gdong kham nag khros pa yis: bon po'i byad zor mdzo dmar bzlog tu gsol: nub tu dom gdong mthing nag gtum pa yis: 'dre rgod 'byung po'i byad zor bzlog tu gsol: byang du spyang gdong ljang nag dgyes pa yis: pha rol dgra bo'i byad zor bzlog tu gsol: g.yas g.yon phyag na zor chen 'phen pa yis: byad zor phur kha 'bebs pa bzlog tu gsol: thams cad gar stabs dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: dur khrod ma mo'i khrag nad bzlog tu gsol: ha ha dgyes pa'i gad mo sgrog pa yis: pha rol gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol: las byed srog bdag khro mo sde bzhi yis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs rgol ba 'joms pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags bzlog tu gsol: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags bzlog tu gsol: yi dam mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad bzlog tu gsol: sde brgyad dregs pa'i pho nya bzlog tu gsol: phyogs skyong bcu yi dmod pa bzlog tu gsol: gling bzhi skye bo'i mda' zor bzlog tu gsol: yugs sa bud med dmod zor bzlog tu gsol: 'dre rgod 'byung po'i glags lta bzlog tu gsol: yul lha gzhi bdag cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol: ma bdud srin mo'i bla rkun bzlog tu gsol: ban de sngags pa'i hoṃ sbar bzlog tu gsol: g.yung drung bon gyi mthu gtad bzlog tu gsol: drag sngags sna tshogs sbyor ba bzlog tu gsol: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs bzlog tu gsol: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rigs bzlog tu gsol: tshe 'phrang bdud kyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chod bzlog tu gsol:
