bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma'i dbal gyis zlog: bsgyur ro zhing bcu tshang ba dgra la sgyur: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong dang bcas pa mā ra ya rbad rbad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces dgra bgegs byad ma yul mkhar rjes med du brlags par bsam: sa ma ya: drag po'i rtsang bzlog bya ba ni: rak+ta mchod cing 'di skad gyer: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: pho nya rtsang gi lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: las mkhan shan pas bzlog bsgyur dus la bab: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: rno dbal zhe sdang drag po'i rtsang phur 'di: chos skyong dam can pho nya 'tshogs pa'i gnas: che chung tshad ni ri rab 'bar ba tsam: mang nyung tshad ni bskal pa'i bye ma tsam: mtho dman tshad ni srid gsum dbyings dang mnyam: rno ngar tshad ni bdun 'gyur chu gri tsam: myur mgyogs tshad ni ki kang 'gyu ba'i gzugs: gtum drag tshad ni gsod byed gshin rje rngam: rtse mor hūm̐ las me ri wa la la: sked par bh+yo yig dam can 'tshogs pa'i gnas: rtsa bar dzaḥyig mun pa thibs se thib: las kyi pho nya rngam pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: pha rol byad ma rbod gtong rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: lha srin 'khrugs pa'i cho 'phrul zlog: gza' dang lha srin bar chod zlog: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs zlog: bzlog bzlog phyi nang bar chad zlog: bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: rbad myog shag thum baṃ ril mā ra ya zlog zlog: ces phrin las bcol zhing khro tshogs rnams kyis bzlog pa'i las mdzad par bsam: sa ma ya: dang po sgo'i phyi ru gser skyems sbrengs nas dar nag gzengs shing khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis 'di skad do: hūm̐: phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha:

mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: yi dam zhi khro mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang : dam can gter srung myur mgyogs pho nya rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: lha srin sde brgyad gzhi bdag drag rtsal can: mkha' la rgyu zhing gdong la gnas pa dang : lo zla zhag dus chu tshod dbang ba rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir drag po gtor ma'i zor lam phyes: gdong du ma sdod g.yas g.yon sku gzur la: ma rungs dam nyams dgra la zor sna drongs: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas gser skyems 'thor zhing sgo dbye bya ba ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs sgo ma lcags kyu mas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang shar sgo phyes: dmag dpung bskyed cing bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: lho phyogs sgo ma zhags pa mas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang lho sgo phyes: dmag dpung bskyed cing bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: nub phyogs sgo ma lcags sgrog mas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang nub sgo phyes: dmag dpung bskyed cing bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: byang phyogs sgo ma dril bu mas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang byang sgo phyes: dmag dpung bskyed cing bzhes su gsol: ces sgo phye zhing phrin las bcol: de nas zor bskul bya ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon thugs rje'i klong nas bzhengs: dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor: rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: zor sna sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la:

dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces yi dam pho rgyud mo rgyud chos skyong dang bcas pas bdag gi grogs mdzad par bsam: de nas khro mo rigs bzhi'i zor rnams rim par thogs la: bh+yoḥ shar du ban byed 'joms pa'i stag gdong ma: sku mdog dmar nag rngam pa'i nga ro can: phyag g.yas me zor g.yon pas chu zor 'dzin: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rnams: rdul du brlags nas rjes shul med par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo ma tri mu kha ye ha la byad ma bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: bh+yoḥ lho ru bon byed 'joms pa'i dred gdong ma: sku mdog kham nag gdug pa'i mche ba gtsigs: phyag g.yas kong zor g.yon pas thun zor bsnams: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rnams: rdul du brlags nas rjes shul med par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo ma tri mu kha ye ha la byad ma bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: bh+yoḥ nub tu 'dre rgod 'joms pa'i dom gdong ma: sku mdog mthing nag gtum pa'i drag sngags can: g.yas pas nyungs zor g.yon pas khram zor 'phen: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rnams: rdul du brlags nas rjes shul med par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo ma tri mu kha ye ha la byad ma bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: bh+yoḥ byang du dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i spyang gdong ma: sku mdog ljang nag sha khrag dgyes pa mo: g.yas pas mtshe zor g.yon pas khrag zor 'phen: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rnams: rdul du brlags nas rjes shul med par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo ma tri mu kha ye ha la byad ma bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

ces 'phang ngo : de nas zor chen thogs la: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings nas khro rgyal lha tshogs bzhengs: deng 'dir bdag gi rgyab rten phrin las bskul: sangs rgyas bstan dgra dam nyams byad ma la: drag po'i dmar nag zor chen snying la ya: bsad cing rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ byad ma 'byung po 'dre rgod snying la mā ra ya rbad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces dgra phyogs su 'phang ngo : de nas dgongs gsol bya ba ni: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: gzigs su gsol lo: gsan du gsol lo: hoḥ 'og min chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing khams nas: zhi khro 'dus pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: rang byung lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: dpal chen phyag na rdo rje dregs pa zil gnon gyi lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: dbus phyogs ri rab 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas: sprul pa'i mkha' lding khyung chen 'bar ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: snang srid dbu ma dbyings kyi pho brang nas: gza' mchog dug gdong 'bar ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: drag shul rngam brjid rol pa'i dur khrod nas: sha za khro mo rigs bzhi'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: gaṅgā rba klong 'khrugs pa'i gnas mchog nas: gter srung klu yi dge bsnyen dang : gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo: hoḥ zhing bcu tshang ba'i bstan pa'i spyi dgra: dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra: rnal 'byor pa bdag la tshad btsugs shing ya bo 'dzin pa: dmag sna rkun sna ston pa'i dgra bo byad ma: ngo log rgyab ston byed pa: bka' las 'gal zhing dam las log pa: mi med lha med zer ba: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba: brnag pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di: lo zla zhag dus ma bzhag par drag po bka' yi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes shig: rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: om̐ badz+ra ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa ga ru ṭa rā hu la tri dgra bo byad ma mā ra ya rbad rbad chings chings nan nan:

zhes dar nag g.yab cing phrin las bcol: brtan ma skyong la gtor bro brdung : dmag dpon khyung gis sgab 'dre bcad: nang du log la tshe 'gugs bya: gtang rag tshogs mchod rten 'brel legs par brtag: bkra shis bsngo smon bgyid cing mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: phyi rabs skal ldan las can rnams kyi don: byad zor ltas ngan log lta bzlog pa'i ched: dus mtha'i sngags pa dug sbrul 'dra ba yis: dregs pa bsgrubs nas chos pa kun la 'tshe: de phyir ma rungs de dag rnams la bsngags: smad las zab mo pha rol rgol 'joms rgya: shes rab snying rje can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: 7o rgyan gter bdag gling pa'i zab gter nyid cung zad dkrugs bsdebs bgyis te rong smyon pas spel ba dge'o// // ka) ༈ dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po las: rgyud gnam lcags me ri dmar po bzhugs so: yang gsang 'dus pa'i lha la bstod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: gsang rgyud me ri dmar po bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: oṃ dharma dz+nyā na swa bhā he: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: a tsa li badz+ra sa mur he: mi g.yo rdo rje yang dag pa: bhi dho bhi shwa prañdzā he: rig pa rdo rje shes rab bo: ga ga su khaṃ e ka he: nam mkha' thig le nyag gcig ste: a nu hṛ da aṣ+ṭa he: bla med snying po'i gsang ba'o: kṛ ya sarba ta thā rgya: rgyud ni thams cad de bzhin sbas: su bhi tsit+ta gu h+ya rgya: e maḥ 'og min lhun grub bkod pa chos dbyings yangs pa'i klong chen smra brjod blo las 'das pa'i ngang tshul la: rang byung gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su ting nge 'dzin gyi glang po brtan pa'i steng du: snang mtha' rig pa'i rgyal po 'od mi 'gyur ba'i sku:

de nyid gsal la ma 'gag cing : lhan ne lham me lhang nger dbyings rig thog ma'i mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs so: de'i rang rtsal rol pa'i cho 'phrul ma 'gags pa'i ngang las: rgyu byung sprul pa'i hrīḥyig dmar po rdo rjes mtshan pa can 'phros te: lta ba ye nas 'khyil ba'i rgya mtsho 'o ma can la phog: spre'u lor mtsho skyes rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas 'jig rten khams su byon te rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas 'gro don rgya cher mdzad: khyad par ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtse mor: mi g.yo rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i tshe: 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre drag po rnams kyis tho 'tsham: khyad par btsan yam shud dmar po dang : bdud mo gser mig ma: gnyan gu lang ral gri can: dam sri ya ma spun bdun gyis bar chad brtsams pa'i tshe: mdun gyi nam mkha' nas rdo rje drag mo khro gnyer spyan gyis lung bstan pa: kyaiḥ snying stobs ldan pa'i dpa' bo brtul zhugs 'chang : chos dang bar chad zung 'brel rkyen dbang che: bdud rigs kha 'byams sangs rgyas bstan la 'tshe: gsang sngags bstan dang phyi rabs skal ldan don: bdud bzhi tshar gcod drag po'i skur bzhengs 'tshal: ting 'dzin mtshon chas mi g.yo rtsal phyungs shig: ces gsungs te: mkha' 'gro ma yang grogs mo'i tshul gyis bdud rtsis bhan+dha bkang ba bsnams nas: gu ru'i spyan sngar byon te: 'chi med bdud rtsi phul: gu rus bdud rtsi gsol zhing mkha' 'gro ma la bstod pa: hoḥ shes rab drwa ba'i rang bzhin gzugs 'dzin la: 'jo sgeg mdzes ldan gsang gsum bde ba'i bcud: legs 'dzin dpa' mo rdo rje gtum pa mo: brda bzhi 'khor lo'i dbang mo khyod la bstod: ces gsungs shing bstod: de nas mkha' 'gro ma yang gsang ba'i rig mar gyur te: de'i shugs las ting nge 'dzin gsal ba gsum gyis rgyud bskul bas: dbyings rang byung dur khrod rngam sgra rol pa nas:

che mchog rdo rje drag rtsal: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa: de la rang 'dra ba'i khro bo bzhi: sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro yang sprul: khro tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas 'ja' lhags pa ltar gsal lo: de'i tshe pad 'byung yab yum yang : drag po dang dbyer med du gyur te: sku las me ri stong gsum kheng bar 'bar: gnam lcags can gyi rtser byon nas drag po'i rngam sgra bsgrags: hūm̐: nga ni che btsan rdo rje drag po rtsal: lha srin sde brgyad 'byung po bgegs kyi tshogs: thams cad 'dir 'dus bdag gi bka' la nyon: dam 'gal bgegs srin 'byung po tshar chod cig: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa he ru ka kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bhig sha badz+ra: ya ma dam sri tri thum: a mu ka gzer thum trig nan: yam shu rak+ta kha thun rbad rbad: du ta du nan mā ra ya shag shag: tri tri kha la dam sri myags thum: drag sngags rdo rje'i mtshon char phab pas: 'byung po ma rungs pa rnams dbang du bsdus shing tshar bcad: thams cad kyis srog snying phul: 'byung po ma rungs pa phal cher gnam lcags me ri'i 'khor los gtubs shing dran med du 'gyel: de'i tshe drag po gnam lcags me yi 'khor lo can du grags so: de nas drag po dbyings la thim zhing gu ru rin po che nyid dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams sngar ltar gyur: de'i tshe gsang ba rdo rje drag mo khro gnyer can gyis gu ru'i rdzu 'phrul ci lta bu rgyud ltar brda'i yi ger btab nas: rin po che'i sgrom du bzhag ste ma la ya'i rtse mor sbas: gter srung khyab 'jug ljang sngon la bcol lo: sa ma ya: de nas bod yul mchims phu'i dben gnas su bzhugs pa'i tshe: ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis gu ru rin po che la gser g.yu'i maṇ+ḍal phul zhing : ma 'ongs pa'i don du zhus pa: e maḥ rgyal sras rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas lags: ma 'ongs bod 'di bde skyid ci ltar 'byung : gsang sngags bstan pa gang gi phyogs su rgyas:

rjes 'jug gter ston rig 'dzin ci ltar 'byon: chos dang zab khyad gdams pa gang ltar gces: zhes zhus so: de'i tshe gu ru'i zhal nas: e ma nyon dang ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: da lta phun sum tshogs pa'i bde skyid la: sems can rgyud ngan dmus long bod 'bangs kyis: rten 'brel kha bsags ngan pa'i dus ngan smra: de phyir kha smon log pa'i las stobs kyis: bod yul 'jig rten bde ba gnas skabs tsam: ma 'ongs tha ma bod yul mi min chags: bde ba zad la sdug bsngal mtsho ltar 'khyil: dam sri nag po mun pa'i zug rngu can: mtshon gyi bu yug 'gyed cing dbus gtsang 'joms: gtsug lag chos 'khor phal cher sprul pas sdud: bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyang sil bur 'thor: chos rgyal sde dpon rnams ni gri ru 'chi: mi sde dmangs chung rnams kyang rim gyis zad: lo nyes nad yams dar zhing mi thog 'bud: dam sri nag pos stod smad ru bzhi dkrug: de dus bod kyi bde skyid zad pa stai: blun rmongs bod 'di bsha' lug mgo 'khor 'dra: de dus rang dbang can rnams rong bzhi dang : sbas gnas rnams su phyin na blo re bde: de dus kho bo nga yi sprul pa ni: bstan pa gso ba'i gter ston mang rab 'byon: gsang sngags bstan pa rong bzhi sbas yul tsam: mdo yang rim sdud dgong ga'i nyi zer 'dra: de dus zab chos bka' brgyad yang gsang dang : nga nyid drag por sgrub pa'i gdams pa ni: gnam lcags me yi 'khor lo'i yang snying zab: jo mo mtsho rgyal yid la de ltar bcag: ces gsungs so: mtsho rgyal gyis yang maṇ+ḍal phul zhing zhus pa: e maḥ sangs rgyas dbang po rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : ma 'ongs bod kyi sdug bsngal de ltar na: 'bros sa'i rong bzhi sbas yul gang ltar lags: khyed kyi sprul pa gter ston ci ltar 'byon: sgrub pa'i zab chos gdams pa stsal du gsol: zhes zhus so: slob dpon gyis: e ma nyon dang ye shes mtsho rgyal ma:

gsang sngags dar zhing 'bros sa'i sbas yul ni: shar gyi phyogs du sbas yul khyung khra rdzong : ma rmos lo thog pus nub tsam du skye: mi rnams longs spyod bsod nams dpal dang ldan: zhi ba me long sprul pa'i sbas yul yin: gnas der phyin pas mchog gi dngos grub thob: lam yig bzang po gze rgyal dung mtshor sbas: shar du rgyal mo rong zhes bya ba ru: chu btsan brag rngam sa skor 'dom gang tsam: de ru phyin na sa bon tsam zhig thar: gnas de'i sgo 'byed gter ston rol pa rtsal: me khams spre'u lo pa sha mtshan ldan: skal ldan skyes bu de yis 'byed par 'gyur: lho yi phyogs na sbas yul pad+ma bkod: ma rmos lo thog phun sum tshogs pa skye: mi rnams longs spyod 'bras bu phun sum tshogs: rgyas pa dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams yin: gnas der phyin pas 'ja' lus dngos su 'grub: lam yig bzang po seṅge rdzong la sbas: lho ru kha bkra klo rong bya ba yod: chu btsan ca dgos sa skor 'dom gang tsam: de ru phyin pas sa bon tsam zhig thar: gnas de'i sgo 'byed rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal: shing khams khyi yi lo pa sha mtshan ldan: skal ldan skyes bu de yis 'byed par 'gyur: nub kyi phyogs nas sbas yul kha la shod: ma rmos lo thog shing 'bras phun sum tshogs: mi rnams longs spyod bde ba blo las 'das: dbang chen sor rtogs sprul pa'i sbas yul yin: gnas der phyin pas 'chi med rig 'dzin thob: lam yig bzang po bdud ri rnga 'drar sbas: nub tu rdo bal tsha ba rong pa ru: ca dgos sa btsan lam skor 'dom gang tsam: de ru phyin na sa bon tsam zhig thar: gnas de'i sgo 'byed gter ston bde ba rtsal: me chu'i khams la khyi lo sha mtshan can: skal ldan skyes bu de yis 'byed par 'gyur: byang gi phyogs na sbas yul be ta rdzong : ma rmos lo thog gro ma'i 'tsho ba yod: mi rnams 'tsho ba gzhan las bcud kyang che: las rab bya grub sprul pa'i sbal yul lo:

gnas der phyin na sdug bsngal ming yang med: lam yig bzang po yer ba'i phug tu sbas: byang du ag ta rong zhes bya ba der: brag rngam ri btsan sa skor 'dom gang tsam: de ru phyin na sa bon tsam zhig thar: gnas de'i sgo 'byed gter ston las rab rtsal: sa khams 'brug gi lo pa sha mtshan ldan: skal ldan skyes bu de yis 'byed par 'gyur: de dus sbas yul sgo 'byed yul skyong zhing : gnas srung rten 'brel che ba'i zab chos ni: shar phyogs khyung khra rdzong gi chos bka' rnams: da lta ri rgyal me ri 'bar bar yod: lho phyogs pad+ma rong gi chos bka' ni: da lta ri bo gnam lcags can du yod: nub phyogs kha la shod kyi chos bka' ni: da lta lho phyogs bsil ba tshal du yod: byang phyogs be ta rdzong gi chos bka' ni: da lta dur khrod ma ru rtse la yod: de ltar chos kyi lung bstan phran bu tsam: sbas yul chos bka' so so'i kha byang ni: da lta gsang mdzod mkha' 'gro'i yul la yod: legs par gdams so dbyangs can mtsho rgyal ma: zhes gsungs so: de nas mtsho rgyal gyis zhus pa: sbas yul de rnams 'byed pa'i sa rtags ci: sbas pa'i chos bka' de rnams 'don dus gang : pad 'byung 'khrul med dgongs pas gsungs su gsol: zhes zhus so: gu ru'i zhal nas: e ma nyon dang dbyangs can mtsho rgyal ma: ma 'ongs sbas yul sgo 'byed sa rtags ni: bzhi bcu kha ral mu stegs nag po rdol: sum cu kha ral hor dmag bod du 'byung : nyi shu mgo tshugs mtha' yi ru bzhi rdol: nyi shu kha ral mi gzan kha dmar 'byung : khrag gi char pa zla ba bcu gsum 'bab: mtshon gyi skar ma lo drug zla bdun 'char: me yi nyi ma lo gsum dus bzhir 'bar: bsam yas gtsug lag gsum gyi mgon khang nyams: ye shes 'jig rten srung ma dbyings la gshegs: sprel mgo ra thod dmar po ri la chags: phyogs bzhir mun pa dkar nag khra gsum 'char: me yi bya sprel shing kha'i 'bras bu btsong :

lcags kyi byi glang sa bzhi'i so nam rtsod: chu yi stag ra yos phung thal snog gtong : shing gi 'brug sbrul dpag bsam lo mar 'khril: me yi rta lug dur bya'i g.yab mo 'debs: sa yi sprel byar dur khrod bco brgyad chags: lcags kyi khyi phag srin po'i dmag sgar rgyag: chu yi byi glang sa steng rgya mtshos g.yo: shing gi stag mor kha yan stong khams nyul: bzlog thabs byas na tsam: sa rtags dus kyi 'byung gyur de ltar la: de yang nye ring gnyis kyi dus su 'byung : nye dus dam sri nag pos sna drangs nas: stod smad ru bzhis rtsod cing hab shar spyod: ring dus srin po mgo dgus sna drangs nas: bod khams glo bur rlung ltar skad cig 'joms: de dus sbas yul 'byed pa'i dus gcig go: sbas yul de ru mi bgrod mi gsum 'byung : nor 'dod longs spyod can la skal ba med: bsam ngan dad 'dun chung la skal ba med: bsod zad brtson 'grus zhan la skal ba med: gnas der sleb pa'i skal ldan skyes bu gsum: bya btang blo sna thung la las 'phro yod: skal ldan rten 'brel ldan la las 'phro yod: gnyis 'dzin phyi thag chod la las 'phro yod: las 'phro ldan rnams sbas yul rong bzhi zungs: skabs su de bde sdug bsngal 'bod pa'i brda: nam zla phyi mjug chad pa'i ston kha 'dra: rdzing gi yur ba chad pa'i 'khyil chu bzhin: de ltar go bas yul la chags pa spongs: sbas yul rnams kyang de dus nges par 'byed: sbas yul bzhi yi chos bkod gter rnams ni: da lta dus la ma bab gsang rgya'o: de dag 'don pa'i dus dang sa rtags ni: lho nub srin yul khra tsha'i shar phyogs su: srin po rnga thug can gyi grong dag la: bud med lus la mgo bo gsum pa 'byung : laṅka pu ri'i ru lu'i grong dag la: dga' rab rdo rje'i skye ba ya mtshan can: sha yi gtsug phud yod pa'i khye'u 'byung : ru lag grong la khrag mtsho brdol ba'i dus:

sbas yul chos bka' 'don pa'i sa rtags yin: zhes gsungs so: sa ma ya: de nas phyi mor gu ru rin po che yab yum srin yul du byon nas: lo nyis brgya song ba'i tshe: sprel zla'i dus su tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bshams shing : mtsho rgyal gyis zhus pa: e ma gu ru rin po che lags: nyid mchims phu la bzhugs pa'i tshe: srin po'i yul 'dir gu rus lung bstan gsungs pa bzhin dus rtags shar 'dug pas: sbas yul rnams kyi chos tshan 'don pa'i dus la bab pas gu rus gnang bar stsol: zhes zhus so: gu rus kyang mtsho rgyal gyis zhus pa bzhin rten 'brel dus la bab par gzigs te: yab yum rdzu 'phrul gyis lam la zhugs te: me ri 'bar ba dang : gnam lcags can: bsil ba tshal: ma ru rtse rnams su byon te: rin po che'i sgrom bu rnams gdan drangs: slar yang zangs mdog dpal rir phebs te: tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor zhing : sgrom bu rnams zhal phyes: de yi tshe mkha' spyod o rgyan yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dngos su phebs shing : 'ja' 'od kyi gur chen po dang : me tog gi char babs: bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad byung : khyad par srin yul la rten 'brel che ba'i gnad bdun du gyur: de nas gu ru rin po che yab yum drag po'i sgrub pa mdzad cing zhag bdun bzhugs: de'i tshe rnga thug grong du srin mo mgo gsum ma skyes so: zhag gcig nas mi tshad lon par gyur: srin po'i grong khyer de yis phyed tsam bcom: de'i tshe dga' rab rdo rje'i sprul pa khye'u sha yi gtsug tor can dgung lo bcu gnyis su slebs pa yod: gu ru yab yum srin mo 'dul du byon: de'i tshe srin mo bros te bod yul du shor: bod la nad yams sna tshogs btang : dngos su yang mi mthong ba'i tshul la sems can dpag tu med pa bzas:

de'i tshe dga' rab rdo rje gdan drangs te gu ru'i rgyal tshab tu zangs mdog dpal ri la bskos: gu ru yab yum gyis drag po sgrub pa'i shog dril rnams dang : gzhan yang gter rdzas dpag tu med pa bsnams te: a tsa ra gnyis la sprul nas byon: bod yul du phebs pas srin mo byang phyogs be ta rdzong la bros: de'i tshe gu ru yab yum drag po gnam lcags 'khor lo can du sprul te rdzu 'phrul gyis byon: bai ta'i yul du srin mo ma chags pa yul der mtsho shin tu che ba gcig yod pa'i nang du zhugs pas: drag po yab yum mtsho'i khar byon te: thugs ka nas bya khyung nag po me gshog can grangs med spros: mtsho'i rmang tshun khyab par mdzad: de'i tshe drag po'i rngam sgra la: hūm̐: nga ni stobs ldan pad+ma drag po rtsal: gdug pa'i srin mo 'byung po sha za'i tshogs: dbang du sdud nas rdo rje'i mtshon char 'bebs: pho nya sprul pa'i bya khyung nag po'i tshogs: dam sri klu dang srin mo'i snying khrag 'thung : oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa kro ta kro ti ram̐ tsakra bh+yoḥ khroṃ kā la ga ru ḍa he khying he khying nā ga rak+sha ma tri rbad dun shag bh+yo bh+yoḥ dza thun shag tu ya kha tham dril nan dun bh+yoḥ de nas drag sngags rdo rje'i mtshon chas btab pas: klu ma rungs pa dang srin mo'i snying khrag dngos su bya khyung gis rol te ming yang med par mdzad: srin mo de brag ri dug sbrul 'dra ba'i 'og tu mnan te: nam yang mi ldang bar byas: de'i tshe drag po me yi 'khor lo can du grags: bya khyung yang pho nya khyung nag me yi spu gri can du grags: mtsho de byin gyis brlabs pas bdud rtsi 'od 'khyil du grags: de nas drag po rang rtsal la thim: gu ru yab yum sngar ltar a tsa rar gyur: bya khyung nag po'i sgrub thabs gu ru'i gsung bzhin mtsho rgyal gyis brda'i yi ger btab ste: bod yul du rjes 'jug gi gter ston rnams la gzigs su byon:

de'i tshe gter ston re zung yod pa rnams kyis gu ru yab yum la bsnyen bkur yang ma zhus shing ha ma go bar gyur: gu rus kyang thugs kyis rab tu khrel lo: mtsho rgyal gyis zhus pa: ma hā gu ru lags sngar gyi chos rgyal rnams kyang med par nges: rjes 'jug gter ston rnams kyang zang zing rgyu la chags te 'gro don mi nus par 'dug: 'di lta bur gyur na chos kyang nub pa 'dra bas: yul 'dir gter ston nam gang rung gcig tu brdzu nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor na gang lags zhus pas: gu ru'i zhal nas: legs par nyon dang ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: kho bo'i lung bstan sa rtags dus gnas dang : rten 'brel gang 'dul sna tshogs bzhag pa yin: mi ru brdzus kyang de las lhag pa med: da lta lnga brgya tha mar nye ba'i dus: las ngan spyod pa'i sems can grol bar dka': rnam g.yeng bag med rjes 'jug yid skyo yang : kho bo'i zab chos smon lam bden tshig gis: sa steng bton nas spel ba tsam gyis chog: nga yi rjes 'jug gter ston 'di rnams kyang : lan re 'khrul yang bag chags rim gyis 'dzad: kho bos dngos su 'gro don byed pa'i tshab: gter gsar sba zhing yang gter smon lam bya: zhes gsungs te: slob dpon gyis 'gro don dngos su ma bzhed do: de'i tshe yang gter sbas pa rnams smon lam dang rab gnas mdzad: gter gsar yang brgya la long pa sbas so: de nas rim bzhin pad+ma rong du byon: 'dong chu dpal gyi gtsug lag tu: ma 'ongs pa'i chos bka' sbas: yul srung ba'i zab gnad drag po gnam lcags 'khor lo khyung nag me yi spu gri la sogs mang du sbas: pad+ma rong gi rdzong gsum: mtsho brgyad la gter kha mang du sbas: rim bzhin sbas yul pad+ma bkod gyi dbu rtse dag pa dz+nyā na shrī sha la ad+no yar byon: sgrub phug mu ku ṭa kum pa la bzhugs shing : rten 'brel gyi shog dril chos bka' dpag tu med pa sbas: gnas de'i ming yang :

ka ma la bho ti bī shwa bha tra zhes grags: mtsho rgyal sbas yul gsum la byon te: chos bka' dpag tu med pa sbas: slar log nas gu ru yab yum rdzu 'phrul gyis lam la zhugs te srin yul du byon: bod du zla ba bcu la zhag bdun ma long tsam 'gor: srin yul du dga' rab rdo rje dang rig 'dzin 'dus pa nyi ma rtsal gyis khrid gnang ba dang rten 'brel 'grigs so: sa ma ya: e maḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs sbas yul gangs can 'dzin pa rnams: bstan pa'i bya ra snying thig drag po'i chos: yang gsang snying po chig dril sgrub thabs bzhag: ma 'ongs nga yi rjes 'jug sprul sku yis: 'di nyid 'don dang spel ba'i chos bdag dang : rten 'brel smon lam grogs kyi rnam dbye bshad: sa rtags mtha' bzhis dbus 'joms gtsug lag 'jig: bod khams rgya hor khrims kyis sngangs byed dus: ma nges rlung ltar 'gyu ba'i brtul zhugs spyod: shar nub yid 'gyu lta bu'i bya btang gis: ki kang gza' dang rgyal po rab tu mchod: 'di nyid 'don dang spel ba'i dus dag la: bya sprel byi glang lo pa smon lam ldan: 'bum dang lha tshe bsod nams gnas dang skyid: rten 'brel brda ltar 'byung ste grogs kyi mchog: bar chad zhi zhing zab chos brda ltar pheb: srod 'phros sha za mkha' 'gro 'gyu dus thon: de nyid spel ba'i skal ldan las 'phro can: bsod nams dbang dang bstan skyong nam mkha'i ming : rgyud 'dzin pad+ma'i ming dang bkra shis ldan: lhun grub o rgyan ming dang dge legs grub: dpal dang tshe chos mgon po rdo rje'i ming : 'phel dang grags rgyal phrin las yon tan rgyal: gsang sngags bstan pa 'dzin pa'i ming can 'byung : skal ldan dang po spel ba'i chos bdag zungs: smon lam tshul bzhin rten 'brel 'grigs gyur na: sbas yul gangs can bkra shis dge legs 'byung : dus 'khrug mu ge zhi zhing bsod nams ldan:

dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa'i go dang 'dra: de phyir phyi nang rten 'brel kho na gtso: rten 'brel ma 'grigs yid gnyis za gyur na: rong chen bzhi nas gri btsan sha mgo langs: byang gi ru yam rdo yi pha wang log: snang srid ma mos nad kyi dal kha 'bebs: rlung dmar gsum gyis ri rong sil bur 'thor: de phyir rten 'brel gnad 'di shin tu zab: sbas yul mi rnams drag po 'di nyid zab: sa 'dzin srog gi phur pa lta bu'o: yang gsang bzlog bsgyur dmod pa mang du bya: sa rten gso zhing rten mkhar brtsigs par gyis: smon lam kho bo'i brda ltar yid la bcag: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: skal ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog:

gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas sbas tshal 'dong chu'i mkhar rgyal ba byams pa'i snyan nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas bsgyur/ ka ma la shrī badz+ra dha ra'i shog ser bu dpe// // kha) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po las: dbang mchog gnam lcags go khrab bzhugs so: yang gsang 'dus pa'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: dbang mchog gnam lcags go khrab bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dang po dbang rdzas kyi rim pa ni: bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings ldan pa: chu gtsang gis sum gnyis bkang : bhan+dha me long shel rdo: drag po'i lha lnga sgo ma khyung nag bcas kyi tsakli: bgrang phreng la sogs dbang rgyud nang ltar mchod rdzas tshang bar bsags: de nas sngon 'gro btang zhing slob mar khrus stsal gral du 'khod: maṇ+ḍal phul te 'di skad zhu: kyaiḥ dbang drag pad+ma rigs kyi bdag: che mchog drag po'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag yang dag 'jug par stsol: slob dpon gyis: kyaiḥ khyed rnams las sad skal bar ldan: bla med dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra dkon: deng nas bdag cag gsang sngags kyi: snod ldan lags na dbang bskur 'tshal: de nas bum chu thogs nas: hūm̐: 'di ni drag po'i dam tshig chu: dam bsrungs skal ldan dngos grub thob: nyams na pho nya lcags sdig gis: dbang po bsnub pas dam tshig srungs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: zhes dam chu sbyin: de nas rgyud ma dag pa rnams sbyong ba dang : dag pa yi dam lha skur ston phyir: bskyed rim 'bog pa ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis e mthing nag me ri 'bar ba'i dbus su: pad nyi bam gyi gdan la che mchog rdo rje drag po rtsal sku mdog smug nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa:

g.yas gsum gnam lcags 'khor lo rdo rje dang ral gri g.yon gsum me yi 'khor lo sdig pa dang phur bu bsnams pa: dur khrod chas kyis brgyan cing : yum mchog rdo rje bskul byed mas gri thod 'dzin cing 'khyud de: me ri 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: spyi bor bya khyung nag po: phyogs bzhir drag po rigs bzhi: sgo ma bcas gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: thod phreng yang gsang 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kha ba bu yug 'thibs pa ltar byon te khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbyer med par gyur: oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ: slob mas: kyai: dpal chen gsang ba gsum gyi bdag: che mchog gu ru drag po yi: dbang bskur dngos grub stsal du gsol: lan gsum zhu: de nas maṇ+ḍal phul: dang po bum pa thogs te ngo sprad do: hūm̐: bum pa skye med chos kyi dbyings: bum chu drag po'i lha tshogs nyid: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor bskur: drag po'i sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bhan+dha mgrin par bzhag la: hūm̐: bhan+dha ma 'gag gsang ba'i snod: bdud rtsi'i ngo bo drag po'i gsung : skal ldan khyod kyi mgrin par bskur: drag po'i gsung gi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: me long snying khar gtad la: hūm̐: ka dag rang byung ngo bo nyid: me long drag po'i thugs kyi ngang : skal ldan khyod kyi snying khar gtad: yang dag ye shes dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gtor ma lte bar gtad de: hūm̐: bha liṃ drag po'i dngos grub mchog: yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i phyir: skal ldan khyod kyi lte bar btad: lhun grub brda yi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rdo rje phur pa gtad de: hūm̐: phrin las sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rdzas:

rdo rje phur pa thabs shes te: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: phrin las yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sku 'bag thogs la: hūm̐: khro rgyal stobs 'dus thod phreng rtsal: mi bzad 'bar ba'i gzi brjid can: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: yongs rdzogs gsang ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā gu ru tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal thogs nas: hūm̐: bla ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: yab yum mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag gis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: bla med rig 'dzin dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra pad+ma thod phreng rtsal ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bya khyung thogs la: hūm̐: khroṃ mthing nag bya khyung ga ru ḍaḥ krang kring sgra sgrogs klu gnyan 'joms: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: bgegs srin tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ḍa kā la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rdo rje thod phreng drag po rtsal thogs nas: hūm̐: sku mchog rdo rje drag po rtsal: yab yum sku yi lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: zhe sdang rnam dag dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: pad+ma drag po thogs la: hūm̐: gsung mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: yab yum gsung gi lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: 'dod chags rnam dag dbang thob shog: oṃ pad+ma tsaṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: srog yig thogs la: hūm̐: che mchog bud+dha drag po rtsal: yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam par bzhugs: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: gti mug rnam dag dbang thob shog: oṃ bud+dha tsaṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ rat+na drag po thogs la: hūm̐: yon tan rat+na drag po rtsal: yab yum yon tan lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: nga rgyal rnam dag dbang thob shog: oṃ rat+na tsaṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: karma drag po thogs la: hūm̐: phrin las karma drag po rtsal:

yab yum phrin las lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: phrag dog rnam dag dbang thob shog: oṃ karma tsaṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sgo ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : las kyi rigs sogs sgo ma bzhis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: tshad med bzhi ldan dbang thob shog: oṃ su kha tsa tur a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dur khrod chas brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: prog zhu cod pan rin chen rgyan: seng glang zhing lpags khrag zhag tshom: thod phreng stag sham rus rgyan sbrul: rnam thar brgyad dag dbang thob shog: oṃ bo dhi aṣ+ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sngags phreng gtad la: hūm̐: rang byung grags stong snying po'i sgra: bzlas brjod bsnyen sgrub brtson par gyis: shes rab phreng ba'i dbang bskur ro: gsung rab yan lag dbang thob shog: oṃ aṣ+ṭa ma l+ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas srung 'khor thogs te: hūm̐: phyi nang mi shigs rdo rje'i gur: bdag gzhan srung ba'i cho ga nyid: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bzlog bsad mnan sreg 'khor lo lag tu gtad la: hūm̐: drag po las kyi mtha' sdud pa: bzlog rbad 'gugs bsgral bsad dang mnan: 'phang ba zor bcas khyod la gtad: drag po'i las mtha' thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra du tri ya zlog: bh+yo ma ra ram̐ dz+wa la a mu ka nan: du khying rbad do shag lo zor zor: de nas gnas lngar bzhag cing : hūm̐: snang stong grags stong bde stong ngang : rang byung skye med rtsal mdangs kyis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin dbang thob shog: oṃ swa bhā dharma nirmā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ shel rdo 'di snang la ngo bo bral ba: sprul sku bum pa'i dbang gsal zhing ma 'gag pa sgrib pa med pa: longs sku shes rab gsang ba'i dbang : rang bzhin ma skyes mi 'gag mtha' dbus bral zhing :

khyab bdal du gnas pa 'di: chos sku tshig dbang rin po che thob pa yin pas: deng phyin chad bskyed rdzogs bzlas bsgrub phyi nang phrin las rung ba'i skal ldan yin no: zhes maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gtang rag bzang po bya: bkra shis brjod cing bsngo smon gdab: rab gnas bya zhing brtan par bya: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang gsang dbang gi rim pa bzhag: gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya can: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags byi'i lor mdong chu gtsug lag byams pa'i snyan nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas bsgyur ro// // ga) yang gsang dregs 'dul gnam lcags me 'khor las: rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub bzhugs so: pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: yang gsang pad+ma drag po gnam lcags 'khor lo'i cha lag: rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub ni: thog mar zla gam dmar po'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: de'i steng maṇ+ḍal khar dpal gtor zur gsum rta mgos mtshan pa me ri bcas 'khor bzhis bskor: mdun du dkar gtor sman raka gtor ma mchod rdzas ri ltar spungs nas rang nyid drag po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gzi byin bskyed: hrīḥ zla gam dmar nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: snang srid 'khor 'das kun khengs yangs pa'i nang : pad+ma nyi zla baṃ ro'i steng du hrīḥ dmar gsal 'phro 'du'i 'od zer spro bsdu las: rang nyid dbang chen h+ya ghṛ wa'i sku: dmar gsal me 'od 'phros shing gtum pa'i gzugs: nyi zla brjid pa'i spyan gsum 'od du 'bar: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal: rab 'jigs gtum rngam drag tu 'bar ba'i skus: skra brdzes thod phreng dar dpyang snyan chas brgyan: phyag g.yas thod dbyug nam mkha'i mthongs su phyar:

g.yon pas me yi zhags pa bgegs la gzir: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad klu brgyad brgyan: gar gyi nyams dgu ldan zhing gsal bar gyur: dbu gtsug khro rgyal bya khyung ga ru ḍaḥ dmar nag me yi spu gri'i gshog rtsal 'phyo: g.yas su rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can: khro rngam khro chas khro bo'i cha lugs rdzogs: dar nag ber gsol ral gri lcags kyu 'dzin: g.yon du rdo rje phag mo dmar nag mdog: khro mo'i chas rdzogs gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs lam lam rtse: kun kyang dbu la rta zhal phag gdong mtshan: rgyab tu phyag na rdo rje mthing nag 'bar: rdo rje rtse lnga zhags pa 'dzin cing 'debs: mdun du yak+sha me dbal dmar nag khro: tho ba dgra satwa 'dzin cing bgegs tshogs 'dul: de yi mdun du lcags sdig nag po ni: mgo dgu'i rwa gzengs kha dgus rgyal bsen za: kun kyang sku la khro chas rdzogs par gsal: de ltar lha tshogs rnams las 'od 'phros pas: dbang drag zla gam rol pa'i dur khrod nas: rta phag yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad skar mda' shugs kyis 'phang ba ltar: spyan 'dren pa'i gnas 'dir ma hā kro ta badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de ltar spyan drangs nas gdan 'bul mchod bstod bzlas pa ni: hrīḥ zla gam dmar nag dbang drag gzhal yas nas: rta phag yab yum 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: sngon tshe ru tra pho mo btul ba ltar: da lta sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag la: gnod cing 'tshe ba'i rgyal 'gong dam sri rnams: thal bar brlag phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: 'dir gshegs 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: khyed la phyag 'tshal dus kun skyabs su mchi: dam tshig phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: yon chab khrus chab me tog bdug spos dang : mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo sogs: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di: rta phag yab yum 'khor dang bcas la 'bul:

khyed rnams thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi rgya mtsho dang : sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang : nyams gyur bshags la dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol: dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rdo rje: bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo che: rta phag yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal lo: sngon tshe ma traṃ ru tra stobs po che: dus mtshan nag po la sogs bdud dmag 'bum: thal bar brlag byed rta phag yab yum gyi: lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: de ltar mchod pa rgyas par byas nas bzlas pa bya ba ni: rang nyid dbang chen yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du spyan ras gzigs: de'i thugs kar pad+ma 'byung gnas: pad 'byung thugs kar hrī yig la sngags phreng 'khor bar bsgom pa'o: hrīḥpad+ma ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ de ltar 'bum phrag drug tu bzla: grub rtags phyi nang gsang ba ni: rab dngos: 'bring nyams: tha ma rmi lam du: sku 'bag ras bris rta phag gsal ba dang : gsang ba'i grub rtags 'ja' 'od du sku dngos mjal bar the tshom med: rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub 'di: rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud kyi bcud bsdus snying khrag thigs pa sa ma ya: gu h+ya brda thim: rang nyid dbang chen gsal ba yi: bdag dang me dbal thugs ka nas: sngags kyi 'od zer spu gri 'phros: 'dre rgod gnod byed thams cad kyi: srog rtsa rbad rbad bcad par gyur: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na 'dre rgod rgyal 'gong 'byung po'i srog la hab: snying la rbad: lus ngag yid gsum mā ra ya ching nan: zhes spu gri mtshon cha'i drag sngags dmigs pa'i gnad dang ldan par bzla zhing : sdig pa snying 'dzin gyi man ngag ni: bdag nyid hūm̐ las lcags sdig ni: mgo dgu bco brgyad rwa ldan pa: kha dgu gdangs shing mig dgu bgrad: shin tu gtum rngam 'jigs rung gyur: oṃ badz+ra yak+sha trig nan e hur thuṃ dzaḥ

gzer nad rgyal 'gong dam sri ka waka tsi rbad: brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ rang nyid sdig pa'i nga rgyal gyi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las dza dmar nag: 'phros pa yongs su gyur pa las: pho nya rang 'dra dpag med pas: 'jig rten thams cad yongs su gang : rgyal 'gong dam sri thams cad kun: thar med skad ngan tser tser bsgom: sha la sbrang ma 'du ba ltar: lcags sdig pho nya bcas pa yis: de la btogs te snying nas zhugs: srog rtsa bcad cing snying khrag 'jib: phyi nang kun nas zos pa yi: lhag ma tsam yang med par gyur: ngar dang ldan pas/ dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad dang : 'dre rgod rgyal 'gong dam sri sogs: gnod byed kun la lcags sdig bh+yoḥ bar chod thal ba'i rdul du rlog: ces pas bskul: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pas sbas yul 'dong chu gtsug lag khang gi byams pa'i snyan nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus pa'o// // nga) gu ru drag po gnam lcags 'khor lo'i: gtum po klu 'dul gyi gsang sgrub bsdus pa bzhugs so: hūm̐: mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: pad+ma nyi ma sa bdag steng : bdag nyid gtum po sku mdog mthing : phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje dang : lcags kyu 'dzin cing steng gdon gzir: g.yon pa sbrul zhags klu gnyan 'ching : sdigs mdzub rtse la khyung khra 'gyed: dmangs rigs klu sbrul zhal du gsol: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan dmar 'khrugs: dbu skra kham nag thod skam brgyan: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs: spyi bor sku yi bya khyung dkar: rgyal rigs klu sbrul zhal du gsol: phyag g.yas gsung gi bya khyung dmar: bram ze klu sbrul zhal du gsol: phyag g.yon thugs kyi bya khyung sngo: rje rigs klu sbrul zhal du gsol: gdol pa nag po zhabs 'og mnan: ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ gi mthar: sngags phreng 'gal me g.yas su 'khor: 'od zer me dang thog ser 'phro:
gza' klu sde brgyad gnod byed kun: gzhob rgod thul thul tshig par

bsam : oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: khroṃ gha ru ḍa haṃ pa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma yengs rtse gcig bzlas par bya: rtsa gsum gling pas sbas yul 'dong chu gtsug lag khang gi byams pa'i snyan nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus pa'o// // ca) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang gi brgyud 'debs dbang chen dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs bzhugs so/ bde ldan zhing gi mgon po 'od mi 'gyur/ /bde mchog phyag rgya'i skur bzhengs mig mi 'dzum/ /bde chen rdo rje'i gar bsgyur pad+mar skyes/ /sku gsum bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam gsum yo ga'i shing rta gnubs chen rje/ /zab gter 'khor lo bsgyur ba rtsa gsum gling*/ /chos bdag las can chos rgyal khu dbon sogs/ /rtsa brgyud drin can bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /chos nyid zhi ba'i dbyings las ma g.yos shing*/ /snying rje'i rlabs kyis gdul dka' 'dul ba'i gshed/ /'bar ba'i gar rol pad+ma he ru ka /dpal chen drag po rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbyings ye gnyis med ye shes rol pa'i rtsal/ /yongs shar yum chen rdo rje bskul byed ma/ /phrin las lhun grub drag po rigs bzhi sogs/ /dbang drag dkyil 'khor lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshad med rnam bzhi'i rang bzhin sgo skyong dang*/ /a haṃ zung 'jug ngo bo ma gza' rdor/ /zab gter bka' dang zab mo gter gyi rgya/ /gnyer 'dzin chos srung rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /snod bcud dag mnyam yongs grub dkyil 'khor du/ /ye yin nges pa gsal ba'i bskyed rim dang*/ /mi 'gyur bde stong rang bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim/ /zung 'jug rang rig bla ma'i sku 'grub shog /bsrung ba mi shigs rdo rje'i gur dang ldan/ /bzlog pa'i 'khrul 'khor phas kyi rgol ba 'jaums/ /bsad pas log 'dren ldang med brlag pa yis/ /las gsum phrin las tshul bzhin 'grub par shog /dgra dpung 'chi bdag gre hom ldang med mnan/

/ye shes zhugs kyis byad phur gzhob tu bsreg /rno dbal zor gyi bstan dgra rmang med brlag /mnan bsreg 'phang ba'i las mthar byang chub shog /dug gsum rang gdangs rgyal bsen dam sri'i tshogs/ /gnad dbab shi sa bstan dang ar la gtad/ /bka' 'og dam bzhag bsad dang gso ba sogs/ /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin mngon spyod mthar phyin shog /snang gzugs drag po'i dal dang sku ru shar/ /'byin 'jug sgra rnams grags stong sngags kyi gdangs/ /rig stong 'od gsal pad+ma drag po yi/ /thugs mchog mngon gyur 'gro kun smin grol shog / ces ma hā gu ru pad+ma drag pos brgyud 'debs 'di bzhin/ dgos zhes 'phan sprul pas bskul ngor lung zin ār+ya dh+wa dza'i skyes mthar khas 'cha' ba rmong brtul ngag dbang klu sgrub tu 'bod pas smras pa bzhin bskul ba po'i bris pa dge'o// // cha) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po las: las byang gnam lcags me yi 'khor lo bzhugs so: yang gsang 'dus pa'i lha la bstod: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: nga nyid yang gsang sgrub thabs bstan: ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i tha ma la: sbas yul rnams kyang rim gyis dbul: phyi nang mi mthun phan tshun 'thab: de dus sbas yul srung ma khro: char chu mi snyoms lo thog skam: lo re bzhin du 'ur skad ldir: bod khams rnams su rgya khrims 'cha': dus kyi sa rtags thams cad 'char: sa yi me btsa' rim gyis 'jigs: chos rgyal dmangs kyi khol bur 'bebs: gtsug lag gnas gzhi had por lus: thams cad sbas yul rong bzhi snyeg: bde ba'i go skabs yud tsam med: chos tshul tho rangs skar ma tsam: srid skyong sprin bar nyi ma tsam: rmongs khyus mu stegs kha la phyogs: yi dam lha la yid gnyis za: bstan 'dzin skyes bur the tshom 'cha': blo gtad the'u rang rgyal 'gong bsten: zas su mna' dang dkor la za: las su srog gcod sdig la spyod: dug sbyor mi dge'i rdzas ngan 'chang :

bka' drang rgyud 'thad dkon par zad: lnga brgya tha ma de yi dus: rkyen bzlog bar chad bsal ba dang : nang 'khrug lo nyes zhi ba dang : dge legs bkra shis 'byung ba'i phyir: yang gsang sgrub pa 'di nyid zab: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: pad+ma'i ming dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po bsgrub pa'i lag len ni: 'jam pa'i sa la stegs bu bya: gzhung bzhin dkyil 'khor cha tshang gdab: rnam rgyal bum pa rgyan gyis spras: bsgrubs pa'i sman dang ril bu btab: bhan+dha'i nang du sman rdzas dang : drag po bsgrub pa'i 'khor lo bzhag: dar dmar kha bcad me long rten: rdo rje phur bu srog rten bzhag: phyi nang mchod rdzas legs par bshams: rang nyid skye med ting 'dzin ngang : dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: hoḥ kun gzhi ma bcos dang po'i sangs rgyas nyid: gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal snying po can: thog ma'i mgon po dran rig chos sku la: 'khor 'das bral ba bzo med ngang du skyabs: sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ rang byung lhun grub ka dag ngang nyid las: rol pa'i rtsal rdzogs snying rje'i 'od zer 'phro: 'khor 'das mar gyur byang chub 'thob bya'i phyir: klong yangs ye nas snying rjer sems bskyed do: de nas sngon 'gro chu gtsang gis bran la: hūm̐: gdod nas rnam dag dbang drag he ru ka'iḥ skye med thugs las snying rje'i pho nya 'phros: ma rig 'khrul pa'i ru tra bgegs kyi tshogs: mchod sbyin byang chub lam ston myur du 'dus: oṃ dharma dz+nyā na badz+ra he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐: ru tra 'byung po a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: bdag ni gtum chen khro rgyal thod phreng rtsal: 'byung po'i tshogs rnams bka' las ma 'da' bar: gtor mas tshims shing byang chub lam la dengs: 'tshe ba'i gdon dang ma rungs tshar chod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐: log lta 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ srung 'khor ni: hūm̐:

'byung ba lnga nyid ye shes gzhal yas khang : mi dmigs srung 'khor ye nas rdo rje'i gur: stong nyid me dpung skye med mtshon cha yis: nyon mongs bgrod 'gyu med par mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: de nas mchod pa byin brlab ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod 'dod yon tshogs drug mnyes pa'i rdzas: nang mchod sman gtor skye med chos sku'i klong : bsgral mchod sha khrag dbang po dug lnga grol: dam tshig mchod rdzas ye nas gtsang sme bral: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs: de nas 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings stong gsal blo 'das de bzhin ngang : āḥ ma 'gags rang rtsal zang thal lam gyis shar: oṃ: sna tshogs rgyu yi sa bon so sor grub: hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐ yig las: kun gzhi ma bcos rang rig e yi mkha': yam̐ las phrag dog rlung gi rgya gram brtsegs: ram̐ las nga rgyal me ri dmar nag 'bar: kham̐ las 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil: sum̐ las gti mug ma rig sa gzhir khyab: keṃ las dug lnga rnam dag ri rab 'arjid: bh+rūm̐ las rang byung pho brang lhun gyis grub: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: drag po'i gzhal yas pho brang 'bar ba ni: bhan+dha skam rlon brtsegs pa thod pa'i mkhar: gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang me ri 'bar: ka gdung gral lcam sde brgyad sha ra ra: dur khrod pho brang thod tog khro lo lo: g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan don snying spungs se spung : phyi rol dur khrod srung 'khor kyi li li: nang du rak+ta'i rba klong phyu ru ru: de dbus chos 'byung bsnol ba'i lte ba ru: mi rta bam ros mdzes pa'i gdan steng du: khro rgyal che btsan 'jigs byed he ru kaḥ smug nag zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku:

g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal gdang mche ba gtsigs: shangs nas rlung g.yo spyan dgu phyogs bcur 'khyil: sma ra dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar: thod phreng dug sbrul dkar nag cod pan 'phur: g.yas gsum gnam lcags 'khor lo rdo rje gri: g.yon gsum me yi 'khor lo sdig pa phur: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas brgyad dang : dpal chas bcus brgyan zhabs gnyis dor thabs 'gying : gsang yum bde chen rdo rje bskul byed ma: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: gri gug thod khrag yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum khro bo'i sked par 'khril: yab yum me ri smug nag klong du 'gying : spyi bor bla ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: mthing nag khro 'dzum longs sku'i cha byad can: rdo rje bhan+dha 'dzin cing phyed skyil bzhugs: lha lcam dmar mo gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs bzhi sked 'khril bde stong lha mor gsal: phyogs bzhi'i phyi rim pad+ma bam ro'i gdan: drag po rigs bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang khro: g.yas gsum gnam lcags rdo rje 'khor lo gri: g.yon gsum me ri'i 'khor lo sdig pa phur: thams cad dur khrod chas ldan rngam zhing 'jigs: zhabs bzhi dor stabs me dpung klong du bzhugs: rang mdog khro mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khril: hūm̐: sgo bzhir mkha' 'gro rang rtags rgyan ldan gar: gzhan yang phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: rang shar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: che mchog drag po'i lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri pad+ma 'od: laṅka mgrin bcu srin po'i yul gling nas: 'jigs byed khro rgyal dbang drag lha tshogs rnams: deng 'dir drag po'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir:

khrag zhag pad+ma bam gyi gdan steng du: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: mi g.yo dgyes pa'i tshul gyis rab tu bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal kun gyi mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa: che btsan dbang drag rdo rje srin po la: phyi nang drag po'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor: gzi brjid me ltar 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: snang srid bhan+dha yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du: bcud kyi sems can sha khrag gtor mar bshams: brda gar phyi nang gsang mchod sbyor sgrol rdzas: khrag 'thung drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings ka dag ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: mthing nag gru gsum me ri 'bar ba'i klong : khrag 'thung khro rgyal rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: zhal gsum phyag drug gzi brjid me ltar 'bar: g.yas dkar dgyes la g.yon dmar rngam zhing gshe: dbus zhal smug nag srid gsum zil gyis gnon: zhal gdang mche gtsigs ljags dmar glog ltar 'khyugs: shangs nas rlung 'tshubs spyan dgu sdang mig 'khyil: sma ra 'bar zhing dbu skra sprin ltar gtibs: thod phreng cod pan srid gsum lha min sngangs: phyag drug mtshon gyis ma rungs mgo snying phral: dur khrod chas brgyad dregs pa dbang du sdud: dpal gyi chas bcus pho rgyud mo rgyud 'dul: spu gri'i sgro gshog bgegs dpung sa la bsgyel: zhabs bzhi dor thabs bdud dpung zil gyis gnon: khro rgyal stobs 'dus sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje skul byed ma: pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan gzi brjid 'bar: khro mo'i zhal rngam 'dre rgod snying khrag rol:

phyag g.yas gri gug bdud dpung rtsad nas gcod: g.yon pa'i bhan+dhas sgrub la dngos grub ster: dur khrod chas ldan mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril 'khor los mnga' dbang bsgyur: gsang ba'i khro mo dpal 'bar sku la bstod: hūm̐: spyi gtsug 'ja' 'od nyi zla'i khri steng du: rdo rje thod phreng mthing nag longs spyod rdzogs: g.yas pa'i rdo rjes dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: g.yon pa'i bdud rtsis 'chi med rig 'dzin bsgrub: zhal 'dzum mdzes ldan thugs rjes phyogs bcur khyab: phyed skyil pang du lha lcam gzi brjid 'bar: gri gug thod khrag thabs shes dbye ba med: yab la 'khril mdzad bde stong ya la la: rdo rje thod phreng sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: drag po rigs bzhi khrag 'thung khro bo'i rgyal: mthu stobs shugs kyis snang srid dbang du sdud: g.yas g.yon mtshon chas ma rungs bstan dgra 'joms: dur khrod chas brgyad rgyal bsen dam sri 'dul: me 'od mdangs ldan 'byung po thul gyis sreg: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ma rungs 'dre rgod gnon: khro mo rigs bzhir mthu stobs dpal dang ldan: gri thod 'dzin pas dgra bgegs klad khrag gsol: yab la 'khril mdzad sprul pa'i khro chung 'gyed: drag po rigs bzhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phyi rim sgo skyong mkha' 'gro las byed ma: sna tshogs gar bsgyur bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad: rang rtags phyag mtshan tshad med bzhi ldan ma: sgo ma rigs bzhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bstod cing phrin las drag po bcol ba'i mthus: sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas shing rgyud 'dzin dar: dus 'khrug mtshon bskal zhi zhing yul gru bde: dam sri tshar gcod phrin las glog ltar myur: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i skal ldan byin gyis rlobs: de nas dzap bskul bya ba ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs:

drag po'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: gzi brjid me 'od chi li li: drag sngags glog dmar khyug se khyugs: phyi nang bar chad dbyings su sgrol: nyams rtogs ting 'dzin yar la spel: gzi brjid mthu stobs nus pa bskyed: sngags phreng mgal me 'khor ba ltar: yab kyi zhal nas yum la brgyud: lte ba'i gnas nas mas yar drangs: hūm̐ mthar 'khor zhing lus kun khyab: snod bcud thams cad hūm̐ bh+yo'i sgra: ba spu'i bu gar khro chung gtams: bya khyung me 'od 'tshub ma 'khyil: glags lta'i 'byung po thul gyis bsregs: snang srid thams cad drag po'i zhing : gzugs rnams thams cad khro bo'i sku: rang byung dzap dbyangs 'u ru ru: deng sang thugs dam gnad nas bskul: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bsgrub: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: dam tshig gnyan po stsal du gsol: ces bskul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: yab kyi sngags ni: oṃ pad+ma he ru ka tsaṇ+ḍa ro ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ yum gyi sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra kro dhi ra tri ta tsar+ya hūm̐ bh+yoḥ drag po rigs bzhi'i sngags ni: oṃ kro ta tsaṇ+ḍa tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sngags ni: oṃ sarba ḍāk+ki ma tri bi shwa hūm̐ bh+yoḥ

srung 'khor gyi sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra he ru ka kro dhi ro ṣa na ma ma dā hri pra warta dha ra tsakra rak+ṣa: bzlog pa'i sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra kha ra ga ka ra ti ka a yu dha dz+wa la ram̐ ru tra mā ra ya a mu ka rbad bh+yo zlog zlog: ces sngags rnams gang 'os skabs dang bstun: sgrub sngags gzhung la 'bum tsho: las mtha' rnams la bcu tsho re ste: dam sri 'byung po ar gtad ni: oṃ ya ma dam sri trig nan gzer thum myog myog: rgyal bsen ar gtad ni: oṃ she la du shing rā dza rbad thum tsit+ta gzer nan big thum trag thum: zhes sham bu gang dgos skabs dang sbyar: drag sngags me yi spu gri'o: dus min bzla bar mi rigs so: shin tu gnyan pas 'os 'tshams bya: rgyal 'gong 'byung pos 'khu ba dang : byad ltas dus su bzla bar bya: de nas thun gtor 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: drag po thod phreng dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: mi mngon chos sku'i klong nas skur bzhengs shig: che btsan mthu yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: dam rdzas rgyan gyis gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam tshig nyams shing 'gal ba bshags su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes thun gtor 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: de ltar bsgrubs pa'i skal ldan la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'byung : bar chod bdud bzhi 'byung po zhi: phyi nang 'khon dang nyams grib bsal: yul gru bkra shis lo legs shing : sbas yul rnams kyang byin chen pheb: dus 'khrug mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi: 'byung po dam sri'i gdug sems nyams: de phyir zab pa'i mthar thug nyid: sa ma ya: de nas tshogs bya ba ni: chu gtsang gis bran la: hūm̐: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gi 'phro 'du las: tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin bag chags gtor: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sbyangs spel bsgyur: 'dod yon tshogs rdzas rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐:

'og min chos dbyings ka dag pho brang nas: che mchog dbang drag khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren tshogs la gshegs su gsol: dkyil 'khor rdzas dang 'dir tshogs byin gyis rlobs: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbang drag pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes shing bzhes la thugs dam bskang gyur cig: nyams chag bskangs la dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: na moḥ mchog gsum rtsa gsum phyag rgya sngags dang ni: dbang drag 'bar ba'i lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: bstan dgra sgos dgra gdug cing sdang ba rnams: gru gsum snod kyi liṅga 'di la khug: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ byad ma nṛ tri dza dzaḥ phur bu thogs shing bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: che mchog khro rgyal dbang drag pad+ma yi: thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog kī la yas: g.yas g.yon phyag bar 'debs pa'i phur bu bsgril: thob cig ru tra'i snying du kī la ya: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya 'byung po byad ma trig thum shag rbad bh+yoḥ zhes gtub cing zhal du 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbang drag 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes shig: gnam sa'i zhal phyes gangs ri'i mche ba gtsigs: glog dmar ljags rkyongs dgra sha khrag mchod 'bul: rngam yangs chos nyid bde stong lto bar skyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: de nas tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma bya ba ni: hūm̐: phyi rim gnas nyul bka' yi las byed ma: g.yang gzhi'i gos gyon bhan+dha phyag na bsnams: dur khrod 'grim zhing rnal 'byor tshogs khang nyul: lhag ma bzhes la bstan pa'i mel tshe mdzod: oṃ yo gi ni ma tri bhi ra ki ta kha kha khā hi: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni:

hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: che btsan kun gyis 'gran bral thod phreng rtsal: dbang drag 'bar ba'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar bas: mthu chen khyed kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: drag po mthu yi gzi byin dus 'dir skyed: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po dang : bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba byad ma'i tshogs: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs dam dus la bab: mthu rtsal phyungs shig badz+ra sa ma ya: de nas zor thogs te: hūm̐: nga ni che mchog dbang drag khrag 'thung sku: snang srid stong khams bshig pa'i zor chen 'di: me char mtshon gyi tshwa tshwa si li li: de ring dam nyams dgra bo'i snying du ya: oṃ tri ta tri lo shag thun bh+yoḥ thun bh+yo ma tri dgra la rbad rbad: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: de nas chad mdo bya ba ni: rnga brdung dung 'bud rak+tas bran la: hūm̐: sngon tshe che mchog dpal chen he ru kas: 'og min lhun grub gsang ba'i pho brang du: khrag 'thung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ma mo mkha' 'gro ging gis khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig dran par mdzod: de 'og me ri 'bar dang ma la yar: khro bo'i rgyal po pad+ma thod phreng gis: yang gsang 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dregs pa gnas nyul rnams kyis khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig dran par mdzod: de 'og stag tshang mchims phu'i gnas mchog tu: dbang drag 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rgyal po la sogs lha 'dres khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig dran par mdzod: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: yang 'dul chen po 'dong chu'i gtsug lag tu: gter bdag gling pas zab gter bston pa'i tshe: gza' dang rgyal pos shog dril dngos gtad bzhin:

gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig dran par mdzod: oṃ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya mā ra ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: sbas yul bstan pa'i bya ra ma sring tshogs: sman mo gnod sbyin sha za bye ba 'bum: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dmag 'khrug zhi zhing lo phyugs rgyas par mdzod: oṃ ḍā ka ḍāk+ki ma mo ma tri in+t+ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas gtor gzhong 'og tu dgra sri bkug la: rta bro ni: hūm̐: ru tra bsgral ba'i zhing gdan du: che btsan khro bos bro brdungs pas: dgra dang dam sri thal bar rlog: nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ ru tra ma tha ma tha nan: tshin+dha tshin+dha nan: ru tra nan: 'byung po rbad thum nan: zhes rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan: de nas kha yar bzed la me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis brjod: dngos grub 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: yang gsang 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa'i gter chen nyid: deng 'dir bsgrubs pa'i rig 'dzin bdag la stsol: 'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: longs spyod srid kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: snyan grags chos kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: mnga' thang stobs bcu'i srid chen yar la spel: 'dod rgu 'bad med mchog thun myur thob shog: oṃ badz+ra ma ṇi dha ra pad+ma ta tri su khaṃ puṇ+ye a yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes dngos grub blang zhing bkra shis brjod pa ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis ka dag snang mtha' yas: longs sku'i bkra shis dbyings rig spyan ras gzigs: sprul sku'i bkra shis lhun grub pad+ma 'byung : rten 'brel bkra shis ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: brgyud 'dzin bkra shis rje 'bangs gter gyi bdag: zab chos yar zla ltar 'phel bkra shis shog: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung lhun grub e yi dal: mi dmigs ngang las mtha' nas dbus su yal:

yab yum hūm̐ bsdu hūm̐ yang skye med ngang : ma bcos ka dag lhun grub ngang la bzhag: hūm̐ a a āḥ de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing ma bcos ngang du bzhag: bsngo ba ni: hoḥ bsngo ba mi dmigs sems can sangs rgyas zhing : gdod nas rnam dag bsngo yul ma grub ste: ye grol thig le ro gcig ngang la rdzogs: de dag rang rig rgya yan chen por bsngo: smon lam ni: hoḥ rang byung rang shar thod phreng dkyil 'khor lha: rtse gcig bsgrubs pa'i rten 'brel bslu med mthus: rang rig rtogs pa'i rgyal sa zin gyur cig: tshe rabs lhar gyur gzhan phan mtha' yas shog: ces bsngo smon spros bcas spros med rgyas par bya: sgrub pa grol nas dbang bzhi blangs shing rgyun du yi dam 'chang : sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang zab snying thig gsang sgrub bka' rgya can: tshig nyung don 'dus byin rlabs nus pa'i dpal: gcig dril man ngag gdams pa khyad par can: sbas yul gangs can lung gi chos skal nyid: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: pad+ma gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags byi'i lor sbas yul pad+ma'i rong tshal 'dong chu dpal gyi gtsug lag byams pa'i snyan g.yon pa nas 7ka gnam sde pha bsod nams rab mdzes dang yon mchod lhan zung gis gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas bsgyur/ dge'o// // ja) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang gi byin 'bebs ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam ḍāk+ki dang*/ /gtum chen dmar nag me phreng gi /dkyil 'khor dam can chos skyong rnams/ /mi mngon dag pa'i klong nas bzhengs/ gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la/ /sgrub mchog rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ sgrub rdzas ye shes rol par bsgyur/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/

/mchog dang dngos grub deng stsol cig /oṃ ma hā gu ru ḍāk+ki dz+nyā na sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ spos btul rol mo brdung zhing byin dbab par bya'o/ zhes pa'ang gnam lcags gu h+yas so// // nya) mtshan med srung bzlog bsad pa'i ngag 'don zhal shes ni/ dang po bsrung ba ni/ bdag gi thugs ka'i cha smad du: gser gyi sku gdung 'od 'bar ba'i: bum nang rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐: de dbus bsrung bya gang yin rnams: dkar dmar 'od kyi rwa bas bskor: de las 'od 'phros zhing kun khyab: rgyal ba'i mthu byin thams cad bsdus: bdag thim rdo rje'i go khrab ni: sra brtan bar mtshams lcags sdig khyung : go mtshams med par gtams pa dang : phyi rol srung ba'i 'khor lo bcas: cis kyang mi chod mi shigs gyur: oṃ badz+ra he ru ka kro dhi ro ṣa na ma ma dā hri pra warta dha ra tsakra rak+ṣa: ces bzla/ bzlog pa ni/ phyi rol srung ba'i 'khor lo dang : bdag nyid sku yi cha kun nas: sprul pa'i khro bo khro mo dang : lcags sdig khyung nag dpag med 'phros: byad ma lha srung der bstan kun: sbur ma me lces tshig bzhin bcom: rdul phran tsam yang med par gyur: oṃ badz+ra kha ra ga ka ra ti ka a yu dha dz+wa la ram̐ ru tra mā ra ya a mu ka rbad bh+yo zlog zlog: srung bzlog skabs dang bstun nas bzla/ bsad pa ni/ bdag dang me dbal thugs ka nas: sngags kyi 'od zer spu gri 'phros: 'dre rgod gnod byed thams cad kyi: srog rtsa rbad rbad bcad par gyur: dam sri 'byung po la/ oṃ ya ma dam sri trig nan gzer thum myog myog: rgyal bsen ar gtad ni: oṃ she la du shing rā dza rbad thum tsit+ta gzer nan big thum trag thum: rjes dzap bstod thun gtor la 'jug /bzlog sngags kyi sham bu la/ oṃ hūm̐ trig khroṃ bh+yoḥ ma ṇi ma rā ṇi bh+yoḥ mā ra du na bh+yoḥ rak+mo rak+shan bh+yoḥ ting ya rak+sha bh+yoḥ mā ra ya: ya ma rā dzaḥ kī la ya bh+yoḥ bzlas la mjug tu/

na mo/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste/ /dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi byin rlabs/ ting 'dzin 'phro 'du sngags rgod rdzas kyi sbyor ba'i nus mthu/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i bden pa dang*/ bdag dang rgyu 'byor 'khor dang bcas par/ sngon gyi las 'phro/ 'phral gyi rkyen/ pha rol gyi rbod gtong*/ sbyor bas mnan sreg gtad cing gzir ba/ bsam ngan sbyor rtsub/ chag che nyams nga ba/ rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad/ byad ma'i rang gshed du dbab nas/ phyir zlog par gyur cig /med par gyur cig /zhi bar gyur cig / lan gsum/ lok+t+ri'i sngags rgod ni/ om̐ lok+t+ri pā la nan: sa ga pā sha nan: nā ga du du nan: ma maṃ ma maṃ: tsir tsa ra tsir tsa ra: bam̐ ru lu bam̐ ru lu: rbad tra ko sha ya rbad tra ko sha ya: ho ra ho ra: tsi du sod tsi du sod: shig lhur gtub: ha la pa ti nan: 'khor ba thul: gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po kā wa tsi brlag brlag: gnod byed sarba sha truṃ mā ra rbad rbad: ces dang*/ bka' ltar mi byed cing dam la mi gnas pa'i rigs thams cad: 'di ru ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig: srid pa spyi nas shig cig: srid gsum rmang nas sgyel cig: 'khor ba gting nas phyungs shig: bskal pa'i mes sregs shig: dam tshig dmod pas sdigs shig: bka'i chad pa chod cig: gnam lcags thog gi ral gris spyi bo'i gtsug nas khos shig: sum+bha nis non cig: srid gsum gar skyes kyang sdig can dgra bgegs kyi steng du gnam lcags kyi rdo rje'i char drag po phob cig: gnod byed sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭḥ sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad 'dis thul cig: bka' bsgo 'di yi nus pa yis: thal phye rlung gis gtor ba ltar: gnod byed de ru gnas mi 'gyur: byad phur rbod gtong rang gshed 'bebs: rtsa sngags sham bur/ oṃ pad+ma he ru ka tsaṇ+ḍa ro ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ e ka ya du mā ra ya a sha ru tri tsa na sde brgyad yongs kyi byad kha dang za kha zug pa thams cad e thum khroṃ ya zlog zlog:

sde brgyad 'tshe ba thams cad grol lo/ rtsa sngags sham bur/ oṃ pra sod: chu sod: dur rta sod: dur mi sod: snying mgo la chod: snying mgo la rbad: ka la dzaḥ kaṃ shaṃ tri rbad phaṭ swā hā: des shi ba'i gshed kha dang*/ dur sgo bye ba thams cad nges par thub bo// // ta) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po las: cha lag gter srung mchod thabs bzhugs so: dbang drag yang gsang rol pa'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra rgya gar pad 'byung ngas: las kyi bstan srung mchod thabs zab mo bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: zangs lcags snod du bshos bu snying gzugs la: dpal gtor bzhi dang mtheb skyu brgyad kyi grangs: dmar rgyan dang ni gsang phyi bzhi yis bskor: rang nyid dbang drag pad+ma'i nga rgyal gyis: rol mo 'ur brdung dbyangs bcas 'di skad do: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum brjod: rang nyid dbang drag pad+ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bka' srung gnod sbyin mched lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐ dzaḥ dam tshig gsang ba mchog gi dur khrod nas: 'jigs byed mi srun 'bar ba'i skur bstan pa: ma gza' rdor legs rgyal po klu yi tshogs: gtsug lag gnas mchog dam pa gar bzhugs kyang : rdzu 'phrul mthu yis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ ma tri e ka tsa ti rā hu la badz+ra sā dhu ging ka ra nā ga rak+sha badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

gnyis pa bzhugs gsol mchod 'bul ni: hūm̐: dur khrod chos 'byung 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: dgra bgegs ti ra bam gyi gdan steng du: las byed drag po sde lnga bzhugs su gsol: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa'i mchod pa dang : mthun pa'i dam rdzas sna tshogs bzhes su gsol: dgyes shing bzhes nas bstan pa bsrung ba dang : gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ma tri e ka tsa ti rā hu la badz+ra sā dhu ging ka ra nā ga rak+sha badz+ra sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gsum pa bstod bskul bya ba ni: hūm̐: rak+ta khrag mtsho khol ma'i dbus: bh+yo las byung ba'i re ma ti: e ka dzā ṭi ral gcig ma: dmar nag gtum mos g.yu spyang bzhon: mi bzad ral gri nad rkyal thogs: bka' sdod srid pa ma mo'i tshogs: dgra srog gcod pa'i las byed mas: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i byad ma thal bar rlog: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: dug mtsho khol ma'i klong dkyil nas: ha las ki kang rā hu la: dud ka ha ra mi gzan sku: chu srin mgo can sbrul mjug can: phyag gnyis nyi zla cha lang brdeb: gza' rgod sde brgyad tshogs kyis bskor: nyams pa'i log 'dren srog dbugs sdud: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: zhing bcu tshang ba'i bstan dgra sgrol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: 'o yug lcags mkhar pho brang nas: ra las dmag dpon rdo rje legs: las byed mgar ba nag po'i skus: dar nag phod gsol ra skyes bzhon: tho chen stag gi sbud pa thogs: yang 'khor btsan dmag 'bum gyis bskor: ka cha dkor nor srung mdzad pas: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'tshe ba'i dgra rkun jag pa chom: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: gnas dang gtsug lag gnyan po nas: ru las skyes bu shel ging ni: dmar smug srog bdag rgyal po ches: phod kha dmar po bswe thebs gsol: phyag gnyis rdo rje lhung bzed 'dzin:

seṅge bzhon cing dgra lhas bskor: yum dgon dben gnas skyong mdzad pas: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngags la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs sgrol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: ri rab khong seng rgya mtsho'i dbus: na las skyes pa'i klu bdud ni: mthing nag sbrul gyi gdengs ka can: klu rta bzhon nas ber sngon gsol: phyag gnyis gter sgrom ne'u le 'dzin: sa bdag klu yi 'khor gyis bskor: rin chen gter gnas skyong mdzad pas: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: zab chos skyongs la dngos grub stsol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: rin chen gter gyi srung ma che: dregs pa sde dpon mched lnga'i tshogs: sngags 'chang bdag gis bos pa'i tshe: dben ri yul gnas gar bzhugs kyang : mngon rdzogs rtags bzhin chos la byon: sdang ba'i dgra la rbad pa'i tshe: shan pa las la bskul ba bzhin: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang ba dang : rig 'dzin bdag la 'tshe ba'i dgra: steng 'og phyogs bcu gar gnas kyang : srog rtsa chod la snying khrag 'thung : shan pa sde lnga'i dus la bab: sprul pa yang sprul dus la bab: mthu rtsal myur mgyogs dus la bab: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nyes can dgra bo sgrol la shog: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma tri e ka tsa ti ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ hring ki kang mu kha na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra sā dhu shu la tsa tri kā la sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ ma hā she la ki kang rā dza si ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ nā ga ra tsa ni la ti pa ra tsa rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad tsit+ta bhan+dha pa tsa a mu ka tshin+dha trig thum da ha da ha ru tra hu lu hu lu bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces drag sngags bzlas shing gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang : shin tu bka' gnyan pas dus ma yin par mi gtong : khyad par rtags myur zhing dgra la rbad pas phye mar brlag par the tshom med:

'di nyid bsam yas mchims phur slob dpon gyis dregs pa sde lnga zhes bya ba thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skyong du bkod pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags glang lor gnam dbye dpon tshang du sdod skabs lung bstan ltar srod 'phros ḍāk+ki rgyu dus gdong phrom brag nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so/ /bkra shis// // tha) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po las: smad las me yi spu gri dmar po bzhugs so: yang gsang 'dus pa'i lha la bstod: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang bzlog me yi spu gri bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phros can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po bca' gzhi'i lag len ni: drag po'i dal thig nag po gdab: ma traṃ dbus su gnam lcags rtsibs: de steng chos 'byung bsnol ma bya: gtor ma dag ni lha grangs la: phyag rtsang phyi rtsang nyi shu re: thun rdzas la sogs gzhung bzhin bshams: rang nyid drag po'i bskyed rim ngang : gtor mdos chu gtsang bran byas te: bzlog bskul mdun bskyed bya ba ni: hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ suṃ keṃ bh+rūm̐ gyi mkhar: 'byung ba yongs gyur drag po e yi mkhar: me rlung khrag mtsho khol zhing 'khrugs pa yi: rang byung dur khrod 'bar ba'i pho brang ni: mtshan nyid tshang la rngam zhing rab tu 'jigs: bam ro skam rlon lhu dum rdza ltar bsnyil: dmar chen rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chi li li: zhag gi rba klong sngo dmar 'khrugs pa'i dbus: ti ra bam chen brtsegs pa'i khri steng du: khro rgyal che btsan 'jigs byed he ru kaḥ sogs nas sngags la bskyal: de nas bskang ba ni: hūm̐ ha ho hrī phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings drag po e yi klong : snang srid lha srin 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dbang drag 'bar ba'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig:

thugs dam bskangs shing rkyen ngan bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: gling bzhi bhan+dha yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: dbang po'i me tog sha chen bsregs pa'i spos: tshil chen zhun mar mkhris pa'i dri chab gtams: sha rus zhal zas rol mo sna tshogs 'dis: rdo rje thod phreng yab yum thugs dam bskang : dbang drag 'bar ba yab yum thugs dam bskang : khrag 'thung yab yum rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : khyung chen 'bar ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : sgo ma rigs bzhi 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: mi lpags rta lpags bla bre mkha' la bres: mtshon cha sna tshogs spyan gzigs sgrub pa'i rdzas: lang ling gar ldan mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs: gzugs 'gros 'phur 'phyo mdzes ldan sna tshogs 'dis: rdo rje thod phreng yab yum thugs dam bskang : dbang drag 'bar ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : khrag 'thung yab yum rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : khyung nag 'bar ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : sgo ma rigs bzhi 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: bhan+dha'i snod du bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil: dung dmar rak+ta dmar chen chi li li: bha ling gtor ma ri ltar spungs se spung : ga ṇa tshogs kyi longs spyod me re re: mchod sprin lha mos brda 'gros khyugs se khyug: yid 'ong mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med kyis: rdo rje thod phreng yab yum thugs dam bskang : dbang drag 'bar ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : khrag 'thung yab yum rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : khyung nag 'bar ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : sgo ma rigs bzhi 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas nyams chag sor chud de: deng 'dir sgrub la 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: bshags pa bya ba ni:

hoḥ bdag cag bag med rkyen dbang 'khrul ba'i tshogs: mchod rdzas ma tshang ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang : phyi nang bzlas brjod chad lhag nyes pa'i tshogs: drag po thod phreng dkyil 'khor lha la bshags: mthol bshags byang nas mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: badz+ra sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa: su toṣ+yo me bha wa: su po ṣ+yo me bha wa: a nu rak+to me bha wa: sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha: sarba karma su tsa me: tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐: ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān: sarba ta thā ga ta: badz+ra mā me muñtsa: badz+rī bha wa: ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes yig brgya bzlas shing lhag chad kha bkang : de nas bskul bya ba ni: gtor ma bshams shing rol mo drag tu bya: bzlog mdos rak+tas bran la: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang e yi klong : gru gsum me ri 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dbang drag 'bar ba'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: khrag zhag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: snang srid khro tshogs bran du bkol zhing bzhengs: dregs pa mthu rtsal bskyed pa'i dus la bab: hūm̐: dbu skra'i gseb nas khro chung skar ltar 'khrugs: sku las me dpung tshwa tshwa 'u ru ru: snang srid stong khams mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshubs: ba spu'i bu gar rang 'dra'i khro chung 'gyed: las byed khro rgyal dmag tshogs thibs se thib: khrag 'thung ma mo bu yug chi li li: sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i dmag tshogs 'bum: nyi khri bdun stong go khrab si li li: rno dbal gdug pa'i mtshon cha zengs se zeng : dar nag ru mtshon g.yab mo lhabs se lhab: gnam lcags gdug pa'i thog mda' sha ra ra: mgyogs pa'i rta rgyugs 'dur lding chems se chem: sprul pa'i bya gcan sha za tshubs se tshub: bshan pa 'bum gyis gri brdar yugs se yug: ma mo'i nad yams bu yug thu lu lu: ma bdud ging sman srog len khyugs se khyug: me yi ser sprin dmar nag 'u ru ru:

zor thun drag po'i tshwa tshwa khrugs se khrug: dam nyams dgra bo'i yul du dmag 'dren no: pha rol byad ma gdug pa'i g.yul ngo chom: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs gdug pa'i log 'dren 'byung po'i rigs: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang zhing gdug pa dang : rnal 'byor bdag la sgos su 'tshe ba'i dgra: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i byad ma rnams: srog rtsa chod la snying khrag zhal du bzhes: gnam sa gling bzhi'i 'gyu srang gar gnas kyang : da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra hūm̐: rak+sha hūm̐: yak+sha hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: skabs 'dir gser skyems btang : zhes gtor ma 'bul zhing dmag dpung bskyed nas bzlog pa'i las mdzad par bsam: sa ma ya: de nas liṅga 'gugs cing bsgral ba ni: thun rdzas sna tshogs bsags la: hom du liṅga bzhag la: phaṭḥ mdun du gnam lcags nag po'i dbus: nṛ dang tri las dam nyams dgra bo ni: sngo la ham pa mya ngan can gyi gzugs: bug pa dgu nas nad rlangs khrag char 'bebs: nyams thag lcags sgrog 'bar bas bsdam par gyur: oṃ badz+ra kha du bam byad ma mā ra ya nan: de nas lan gsum 'gugs gzhug gang rung bya: pho nya 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: yi ge nag po dzaḥzhig 'phros: dzaḥlas 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu mas: stong gsum ru tra'i yul zhing gang : dgra bo'i snying nas lcags kyus zungs: bstan dgra sgos dgra khug la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya byad ma nṛ tri dza dzaḥ hūm̐: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: yi ge sngon po hūm̐ zhig 'phros: hūm̐ las 'ching byed zhags pa mas: stong gsum ru tra'i yul zhing gang : dgra bo'i mgul nas zhags pas chings: bstan dgra sgos dgra khug la shog:

dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐ byad ma nṛ tri dza dzaḥ hūm̐: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: yi ge dmar po bam̐ zhig 'phros: bam̐ las sdom pa'i lcags sgrog mas: stong gsum dgra bo'i yul zhing gang : dgra bo'i yan lag lcags sgrog sdoms: bstan dgra sgos dgra khug la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐ byad ma nṛ tri dza dzaḥ hūm̐: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: yi ge ljang khu hoḥzhig 'phros: hoḥlas myos pa'i dril bu mas: stong gsum ru tra'i yul zhing gang : dgra bo myos shing 'bog par gyis: bstan dgra sgos dgra khug la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ho byad ma nṛ tri dza dzaḥ de nas lha dbye ni: bya rog 'ug sgro thogs la: hūm̐: za byed kha khā hu lu ma: phyag na me rlung 'khor lo 'dzin: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: srung skyob lha dang da phyes shig: me yis bsregs shing rlung gis gtor: dug chu nag pos bshal bzhin thongs: bya spu rlung gis bskyod bzhin gtor: oṃ kha khā mu kha dgra bo ha la shag phyes dza dun shag phyes rbad tri shag phyes: zhes gu gul bdug cing thun drag pos brdegs shing lha dang dbye: de nas dgra bo bdud dang sprad pa ni: hūm̐: 'joms byed hu lu mu kha mas: phyag na mun nag spu gri 'dzin: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: mun pa nag pos mdun nas bsus: spu gri 'bar bas rgyab nas ded: srog gcod bshan pa bdud dang sprod: bla srog snying gi dkyil nas drongs: byad du bcug cing khrims la thob: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyis: oṃ hu lu mu kha ya dgra bo 'du pra ma rak+sha kha la yam 'ub thun satwaṃ bha ya nan: de nas phur bu thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa kī la ya: sangs rgyas yongs rdzogs phrin las sku: rgya mdud me ri wa la la: 'chang bzung glog dmar chi li li: chu srin tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: zur gsum thog rgod sha ra ra:
