dgra bo byad ma sdig can gyi: dkar nag snying la kī la ya: srog gcod dbugs sdud rnam shes phrol: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya byad ma trag thum rbad myog ha la ya gtub gtub mā ra ya rbad rbad: de nas thun brdeg pa ni: hūm̐: yungs dkar khro bo dmod pa'i thun: rdo thun drag po sha ra ra: nad thun na bun tshubs se tshubs: me thun tshwa tshwa spungs se spung : dug thun mnan sreg wa la la: thun rdzas rlung dmar chi li li: khrag thun nad rlangs thibs se thib: mtshon thun me dpung 'u ru ru: ral gri drag po skar ltar 'khrugs: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: thun gyi char phob dum bur gtubs: drag sngags khro mo'i gtun khung du: rab 'jigs rdo rjes brdung byas te: rdul phran bzhin du phye mar bshig: oṃ ma tsa du ti na sa la ya byad ma thum ril rbad bh+yo gtums shig kha la du na yam yam: de nas gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hoḥ khro rgyal 'dus pa'i lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: klong yangs bde chen dgyes pa'i mgrin par drongs: ldog med chos dbyings drag po'i lto bar bskyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi:

de nas dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag phul bar dgyes te rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad bzlog par bsams la: rtsang phur rak+tas bran te: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang e yi klong dkyil nas: che btsan khros pa'i las byed pho nya'i tshogs: drag po gtsang gi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: rno dbal dur khrod rtsang gi gdan la bzhugs: khrag mchod dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rno dbal zengs se zang : rtse mor bskal pa'i me dpung 'u ru ru: sked pa rgya mdud khrag zhag chi li li: rtsa bar bskal pa'i mun nag thibs se thib: khrag mchod dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: pha rol gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtse mor khro tshogs gad mo lhangs se lhang : sked par ma mo sha za chems se chem: rtsa bar bshan pa dgra 'dzin khyugs se khyug: khrag mchod dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: phyi nang bar chod rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: hūm̐: rtse mor chos skyong dmag tshogs spungs se spung : rgya mdud pho nyas srog len zhungs se zhung : rtsa bar dgra bgegs bla skad tse re re: khrag mchod dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: ban bon sngags pa'i byad kha bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang la gnas pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams: bskul lo bzhengs shig bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: pha tshogs yab kyi drag sngags dgra la zlog: ma tshogs yum gyi drag sngags dgra la zlog: 'khor tshogs sprul pa'i byad kha dgra la zlog: ban bon sngags pa'i phur kha dgra la zlog: yul 'dre 'byung po'i 'thab 'khon dgra la zlog: dus 'khrug yams nad mu ge dgra la zlog: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs dgra la zlog: gri sri phung sri chung sri dgra la zlog: god sri btsan sri dbul sri dgra la zlog: khram kha sho kha rtsis 'debs dgra la zlog: ye 'drogs glo bur bgegs rigs dgra la zlog: ltas ngan 'tsher rtsub mi kha dgra la zlog:

mi rung ngan sbyor sna tshogs dgra la zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: oṃ thun bh+yo rbad bh+yo ram̐ bh+yo trig khroṃ du tsa nag po dgra la zlog zlog: ces zlog sngags kyang mang du bzla: sa ma ya: de nas bzlog pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil dbus: dregs pa dam sri bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas: dbang drag khros pa'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur drag po'i dus la bab: hūm̐: zhal gsum phyag drug bskal pa'i me ri 'bar: srid gsum dbang sdud che btsan 'gran zla bral: drag po rigs bzhir dregs pa 'bum gyis bskor: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phyi nang bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: khro bo khro mo'i drag sngags kyang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: lha yi bka' chad 'bebs pa yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: lha min mtshon cha 'khrug pa yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: srid pa'i g.yo 'khrugs thams cad kyang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: dri zas rgyang glu len pa yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: grul bum mkha' la 'gyu ba yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: gshin rjes 'khor lo bskor ba yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: me lhas hoṃ sbar bsregs pa yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: srin pos dal kha g.yos pa yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: ma mos nad yams btang ba yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog:

bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: rlung lhas g.yer shing phyar ba yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: bgegs srin bar du gcod pa yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: 'byung pos thog ser 'bebs pa yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: dmu yis brda than btang ba yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: klu bdud nag po'i gtad khram yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: sa bdag mdze dang zha grum yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: phra men sha zas bar chod kyang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: shi 'dre bse rag za kha yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: god sri phung sbyor dgra sna yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: mo ltas bkra ltas ngan pa yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: gshin rta dur kha phye ba yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: gri sri rgyal 'gong smyo 'bog yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: dus 'khrug mtshon cha g.yo ba yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: lha srin sde brgyad dal kha yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: ban bon ngan sngags gtad khram yang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs kyang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur:

mi mthun gnod pa'i tshogs rnams kun: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo rbad tri sha ya bzlog: du ru sha ya bzlog: thun dza rbad ya bzlog: byad ma 'byung po thams cad bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces drag po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi go mtshon dang ldan zhing zhal nas bh+yo bzlog gi sngags di ri ri sgrogs par bsam: sa ma ya: khyung nag gi bzlog pa ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal sprul pa bya khyung ga ru ḍaḥ gnam lcags rwa gzengs spu gri'i gshog pa can: bswe mig zangs rwa khro chu'i sder mo can: chu gri'i sgro thur krang kring sgra sgrogs che: 'khor ni rang 'dra'i bya khyung bzhi yis bskor: drag po'i bzlog bsgyur phrin las bcol phyir bzhengs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gnam lcags rdo rje'i rwa co gzengs pa yis: steng phyogs lha yi chad pa bzlog tu gsol: rwa bar nyi zla nor bus brgyan pa yis: yi dam lha yi bka' chad bzlog tu gsol: bswe mig tshwa tshwa drag tu khol ba yis: bar snang lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol: rngam byed zangs kyi sgro mchu ldan pa yis: lha srin sde brgyad byad kha bzlog tu gsol: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la brgyangs pa yis: khro bo khro mo'i zil gnon bzlog tu gsol: chu gri'i sgro thur me zer 'phro ba yis: nad rims dal yams 'byung po bzlog tu gsol: g.yas g.yon rdo rje sdig pa 'dzin pa yis: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol: dug sbrul pho mo zhal du gsol ba yis: sa bdag klu yis gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: khro sder klu bdud pho mo 'dzin pa yis: mdze nad lhog yams dmar po bzlog tu gsol: rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba yis: ma sring mkha' 'gros sun ma bzlog tu gsol: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: snang srid yongs kyi byad kha bzlog tu gsol:

hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bzlog tu gsol: ye 'drogs sum brgya drug cu bzlog tu gsol: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog tu gsol: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad bzlog tu gsol: rbad 'dre rbod gtong phur kha bzlog tu gsol: mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams bzlog tu gsol: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma ṇi khyung khyung thum thum kā la pa k+ṣiṃ raṃ raṃ byad ma rbod gtong zlog zlog: ces zlog sngags bzla: sa ma ya: de nas bsrung 'khor dmigs pa ni: hūm̐: skad cig bdag nyid drag por gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng dmar po me yi rang bzhin 'khor zhing : lus kyi nang thams cad gang : ba spu dang bu ga thams cad bya khyung nag pos gang : bsrung bya thams cad pho g.yas mo g.yon: mdun du nor rdzas rgyab tu zhing khang thams cad tshud de bskal pa'i rlung yang mi thar bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba ro ṣa na kro ta kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig rak+sha rak+ṣa: zhes sngags gang mang du bzla zhing srung 'khor bsgom mo: mdun du khro bo rnams kyi gdan: gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo: 'og zangs kyi 'khor lo gnyis g.yas g.yon du 'khor ba'i bar thams cad dgra bgegs 'byung po mngon sum du gsal zhing : sngags phreng bzlas pas sha khrag dmar nyil nyil du gtubs par bsam: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ byad ma gnod byed thams cad myog thum trig bh+yoḥ rbad chum byad ma kha la shig shig: bam ril rbad bh+yoḥ zhes bsad sngags rnams yang yang bzlas shing liṅga thengs gsum 'gugs: dmigs pa gsal zhing sha khrag rnams las mkhan pho nya rnams kyis rol bar bsam: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas gser skyems btang ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs klong nas bzhengs:

deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: drag po mthu yi gzi byin bskyed du gsol: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir ma nyes gzu dang dpang po mdzod: bstan pa'i srog shing rdo rje theg pa la: mu stegs log lta bdud kyis brnyas btsugs so: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rgyud grags bka' btsan man ngag don ma chung : phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gzu dang dpang po mdzod: rgya bod mkha' grub rig 'dzin pad 'byung la: bdud blon bsam ngan rnams kyis brnyas btsugs so: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: 'ja' lus skye 'chi bral ba don ma chung : dgongs brda slob dpon gzu dang dpang po mdzod: mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag rdzogs chen a ti la: nyan thos grub mtha' can gyis brnyas btsugs so: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: chos nyid mngon sum ston pa don ma chung : ma sring mkha' 'gro kun gyis gzu dpang mdzod: rig 'dzin rjes 'jug rgyal tshab rnal 'byor la: bdud rigs dam sri ngan pas brnyas btsugs so: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: bskyed rdzogs sngags bzlas bsgrub pa don ma chung : chos skyong dam can gzu dang dpang po mdzod: ma nyes snod ldan bdag cag sgrub pa por: dam nyams dgra bo 'di yis brnyas btsugs so: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rbad bskul pho nyar mngags pa don ma chung : gter srung las mkhan gzu dang dpang po mdzod: hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: steng 'og phyogs bcur 'phros srid na: phyogs skyong sde brgyad grogs mdzod cig: phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs thal bar rlog: gza' klu lha srin sde brgyad dang : khyad par de ring rgyu ba yi: gdong la gnas pa'i dregs can rnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: kun kyang bdag gi grogs mdzad de: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod:

de nas nang gi phyogs bzhir gser skyems btang zhing sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: pho brang shar phyogs sgo skyong ma: lcags kyu dkar mo bye ba 'bum: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sgo phyes 'phrang sgrol dmag dpung skyed: drag po'i lha tshogs bzhengs su gsol: de nas lho ru gser skyems btang zhing : hūm̐: pho brang lho phyogs sgo skyong ma: zhags pa ser mo bye ba 'bum: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sgo phyes phrang sgrol dmag dpung skyed: drag po'i lha tshogs bzhengs su gsol: nub tu mchod cing : hūm̐: pho brang nub phyogs sgo skyong ma: lcags sgrog dmar mo bye ba 'bum: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sgo phyes 'phrang sgrol dmag dpung skyed: drag po'i lha tshogs bzhengs su gsol: byang du mchod cing : hūm̐: pho brang byang phyogs sgo skyong ma: dril bu ljang mo bye ba 'bum: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sgo phyes 'phrang sgrol dmag dpung skyed: drag po'i lha tshogs bzhengs su gsol: hūm̐: pho brang 'bar ba'i lha tshogs rnams: dmag dpung bskyed cing zor sna drangs: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ces gser skyems btang zhing sgo dbye: de nas zor bskul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon rang bzhin phyogs bcu rab 'byams na: bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin dang : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams: rdzu 'phrul klong nas thugs rje skur bzhengs la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: mthu ldan dmag gi dpung chen deng 'dir skyed: drag shul stobs kyis pho nya deng 'dir rbad: bshan pa ging chen pho mos zor sna drongs: sde brgyad khrag 'thung 'bum gyis zor dpung skyed: srog bdag 'bum gyis dgra srog chod la shog: phrin las dus la bab bo sa ma ya:

de nas thod phreng rigs bzhi'i gtor zor thogs nas: hūm̐: nga ni rdo rje drag po rtsal: thugs las sprul pa'i las mkhan ni: lha dang rgyal po las la chos: de ring drag po'i zor sna drongs: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: myur du sgrol cig mā ra ya: oṃ dhe wa she la ging dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: ces rim pa bzhin du: hūm̐: nga ni rat+na drag po rtsal: thugs las sprul pa'i las mkhan ni: gshin rje btsan rgod dgra la chos: de ring drag po'i zor sna drongs: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: myur du sgrol cig mā ra ya: oṃ ya ma shu la dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: rim bzhin: hūm̐: nga ni pad+ma drag po rtsal: thugs las sprul pa'i las mkhan ni: bdud dang ma mo dgra la chos: de ring drag po'i zor sna drongs: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: myur du sgrol cig mā ra ya: oṃ ma tri du pra ma dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: rim bzhin: hūm̐: nga ni karma drag po rtsal: thugs las sprul pa'i las mkhan ni: klu dang gnod sbyin dgra la chos: de ring drag po'i zor sna drongs: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: myur du sgrol cig mā ra ya: oṃ yak+sha nā ga dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: de nas zor chen thogs la:

hūm̐: nga ni che mchog thod phreng rtsal: nga ni khro bo kun gyi rje: nga ni ma mo kun gyi yab: nga las che ba su yang med: snang srid thams cad nga yi bran: mthu chen drag rtsal zil gyis gnon: hūm̐: nga yi sprul pa'i las mkhan ni: dam can ma mo rā hu la: myur mgyogs rgyug pa'i drag rtsal can: mi srun khrag 'thung bye ba 'bum: dgra bo'i srog len sha ra ra: de ring drag po'i zor sna drongs: rbad pa'i pho nya mthu ma chung : mngags pa'i las mkhan rtsal ma zhan: nyams pa'i byad ma da sgrol cig: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ ra tri e ka tsa ti ki kang rā hu la: badz+ra sā dhu mā ra ya rbad shag thun bh+yoḥ trig bh+yoḥ zor bh+yoḥ bzlog bh+yo ya rbad ya: zhes zor 'phang zhing dmod bcol bya: de nas gtor chen thogs la: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: gsan du gsol lo: gzigs su gsol lo: spros pa med pa'i dbyings chen po nas: dpal 'jigs byed drag po dmar nag me yi phreng ba can: drag po rigs bzhi: sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol: deng 'dir phrin las bcol ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan dgra: sgos rnal 'byor la sdang ba'i dgra: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: bstan pa'i chos skyong la phod btsugs pa: ngo log rgyab ston byed pa'i dgra bo: dmag sna dgra sna ston pa'i byad ma: rkun sna jag sna ston pa'i gdug can: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i 'byung po: nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: bar chod kyi rkyen: 'tshe byed ma rungs pa'i dgra dang byad ma rnams bka' yi gtor chen 'di dang mnyam por bzhes shig: ces 'phang ngo : oṃ du ru bh+yoḥ ma ru bh+yoḥ tri tri bh+yoḥ log tri bh+yoḥ rbad du bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: thal mo brdab cing dar nag g.yab: de nas gtor gzhong 'og tu dgra bo bkug cing rta bro brdung :

khyung nag gis rgab 'dre bcad: de nas nang du log ste tshe 'gugs bya ba ni: mda' dar thogs la: hūm̐: pho brang 'bar ba'i sgo skyong ma: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: phyi nang snod bcud tshe bsdus la: skye 'chi med pa'i tshe dbang stsol: bgres rgud med pa'i 'ja' lus brtan: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: oṃ ma hā gu ru ha ri ni sa a yurdzā na sa mā ya dza dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes dbang blang zhing dngos grub rol: bkra shis bsngo smon bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma bdag 'dra kho bo pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: yang bzlog zab mo rdo rje pha lam bzhag: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: rgyal 'gong dmag khrims chu ltar khol ba'i tshe: sa srung yul brtan rten 'brel du ma'i ched: gangs can sbas yul 'dzin rnams 'di nyid bsgrub: kho bo bdag gis smon lam bka' rgya can: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: pad+ma'i ming can de dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags byi'i lor 'dong chu gtsug lag byams pa'i snyan nas gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ gza' dang rgyal pos shog dril dngos su phul ba bzhin gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu bsgyur to/ /dge'o// // da) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po las: khyung nag me yi spu gri'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so: bya khyung mthing nag me gshog can la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: khyung nag spu gri'i sgrub thabs bstan: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: mthing nag gru gsum e dal bri: dbus su bhan+dha mtshan ldan nang : nag po dgu sman khyung lnga dang : gza' brgyad ldum bu brgya rtsa dang : bya rigs rnams kyi sder mchu dang :

gcan gzan rnams kyi mche ba dang : rus sbal sbrul dang nya yi sha: sdig srin byang nga skyer pa'i shing : seng ldeng shug raka khaṇ+ḍa rnams: zhib 'thag gcig bsgril ril bu ni: nas 'bru tsam gyi tshad tsam bya: dmar nag dar gtums thod par bzhag: ba liṃ rgyan ldan khyung yang gzugs: mda' dar khyung sngags srog yig btags: phyi nang mchod pa legs par bshams: rang nyid bya khyung nag por bsgom: klu dang rgyal bsen sa bdag rigs: hab hab ljib ljib za bar bsgom: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gyis: chu mig nang du phu mi bya: sngags kyang rang nyid go tsam bzla: rgyun du dam tshig legs par bsrung : sa ma ya: dang po dran rdzogs lha bskyed ni: oṃ hūm̐ khroṃ bh+yo badz+ra bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las mthing nag e yi klong : gru gsum dug mtsho khol ma'i me dpung dbus: klu bdud pho mo dug gi ri rab steng : khroṃ yig nag po gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: bya khyung nag po spu gri'i gshog pa can: gnam lcags rwa ldan zangs mchu krang kring sgrog: spyi bo'i skra dmar nyi zla nor bus brgyan: gser mig 'khyil zhing chu gri'i sgro thur gzengs: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas sdig pa 'dzin: dug sbrul pho mo dkar nag zhal du gsol: rus pa'i rgyan ldan khro chu'i sder mo yis: klu bdud pho mo brdzis shing me zer 'phro: klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsal: de ltar gnas gsum sa bon 'od zer gyis: srid pa'i ri rab me ri 'bar ba nas: bya khyung nag po'i lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa kā la pa k+ṣing badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: gling bzhi ri rab 'bar ba'i yang steng nas: khro rgyal thugs kyi sprul pa ga ru ḍaḥ bya khyung nag po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum e yi dbus nyid du:

klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul ba'i khri steng du: bya khyung nag po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: deng 'dir bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: khroṃ: klu gnyan sa bdag 'joms pa'i drag rtsal can: bya khyung nag po'i rdo rje'i mchu sder rngam: nag po 'byung 'dul dregs pa'i mnga' bdag la: lus ngag yid gsum dwang bas rab tu bstod: oṃ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa ni: khroṃ: klu gnyan sa bdag bsgral ba'i dbang po lnga: sbal sbrul nya dang sdig pa ri ltar spungs: 'byung po'i snying khrag mtsho ltar 'khyil ba 'di: bya khyung 'bar ba'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra nā ga bhu mi pa ti'i māṃ sa go ro tsa na bha su ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bstod pa ni: hūm̐ khroṃ: khro rgyal thugs kyi sprul pa ga ru ḍas: krang kring sgra sgrogs klu gnyan sa bdag 'joms: gnam lcags rwa la ser ba chi li chi: zangs mchu dmar por thog rgod sha ra ra: bswe mig tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs se 'khrug: dbu skra dmar por me zer ya la la: nyi zla nor bur 'od dpung thibs se thib: klu bdud khrag 'thung rkan sgra thags se thag: phyag g.yas rdo rjes ma rungs 'byung po 'dul: g.yon pas lcags sdig rgyal bsen snying khrag 'jibs: spu gri'i sgro gshog bgegs dpung sa la bsgyel: chu gri'i sgro thul dmangs rigs gdol pa 'dul: khro chu'i sder mos sa bdag snying rtsa 'dren: rus pa'i rgyan ldan bya khyung dmag tshogs 'gyed: me dpung klong bzhugs ma rungs thul gyis sreg: khro rgyal khyung gi lha la bdag bstod do: khyed la bstod cing phrin las bcol ba ni: steng phyogs gza' dang bar snang gnyan gyi gdon: 'og phyogs klu dang sa bdag rgyal bsen bgegs: 'byung po'i gdon tshogs zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ khroṃ ram̐ gha ru ḍa kā la pa k+ṣing hūm̐ phaṭḥ las sngags ni: oṃ ma ṇi khyung khyung thum thum rbad rbad swā hā:

sham bu ni: nag po kā la rak+sha rbad: khyung khyung spu gri zing zing : lcags kyi sder mos klu gnyan sa bdag snying rtsa drongs shig: thum shig myog thum gzer dril nan: lhang lhang 'ub 'ub rbad ching ram̐ bh+yo shig shig: mdze nad nag po gcod pa'i sngags ni: oṃ pa k+ṣiṃ trig khroṃ bh+yoḥ kha la dun tse bh+yoḥ shag du shag ya bh+yoḥ oṃ khroṃ khro ta gri khroṃ mā ra ya: sa bdag klu gnyan gyi snying la rbad rbad: nā ga ra tsa 'ub 'ub chum chum: bhu mi pa ti ka la shig shig dung dung myog myog: khroṃ bh+yo ga ru ḍa nā ga sha la ljib rus la rbad rbad: dbugs la sdud sdud: khroṃ ga ru ḍa kā la pa k+ṣ-iṃ sa bdag gi snying 'gas 'gas ya ya bh+yo bh+yo shig shig myog myog: oṃ bhu mi pa ti ma hā+o ra ge shig shig rbad rbad: oṃ pa k+ṣiṃ kā la dun dun mdze sri'i sha la rbad rbad: snying la chum chum: srog la rngub rngub: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ḍa tri ta ta ka ka la klu gnyan sa bdag gi nad la thum thum shig shig: nā ga ra tsa kā la wāk+ka tsit+ta rlag rlag dun bh+yoḥ zhes sngags rnams chad lhag med par bzla: 'bum phrag gsum gyis grub rtags nges par thon: dmigs pa ni: rang nyid bya khyung nag po'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng me yi spu gri ltar 'phros pas: snod bcud thams cad me'i rang bzhin 'bar nas klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad tshar bcad par bsam: tshur me 'od thams cad 'dus te drag po'i rdzas rgod rnams la thim pas me ri'i rang bzhin du 'bar bar bsam: de nas sgrub pa grol tshe rang nyid kyis dbang blang ba ni: gtor ma bum pa gnas lngar bzhag la: khroṃ: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs sprul ga ru ḍaḥ mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs shig: gzi byin drag po'i mthu stobs bskyed du gsol: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bzhi deng 'dir bskur: steng gdon gza' gnyan rgyal po'i gnod pa dang : 'og phyogs klu srin 'byung po'i 'tshe ba rnams:

skad cig nyid la tshar gcod dbang bskur stsol: skal ldan lus la khyung gi go khrab gyur: khroṃ yig 'od zhu spyi bo nas zhugs te: snying khar thim pas dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ khroṃ bam̐ ram̐ ga ru ḍa kā la pa k+ṣiṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ghu na a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ: zhes gnas lngar bskur ro: dbang bzhi blang: ril bu rnams rgyun du re re 'chang : nad drag po gso ba la khong du btang zhing dud pa yang bdug: grib dang cham rims sogs la snga zhogs dud pa ma btang bar sngags lan mang du bzla zhing : sna bug spur bas bsrung bar 'gyur: ser ba bsrung na: sngags bzlas shing rdzas bdug cing rang nyid bya khyung nag por bsgoms te: nam mkha' sa gzhi thams cad khyung gis gang ste sde brgyad 'byung po ser ba'i sna 'dren thams cad mtha' yi rgya mtsho'i pha rol bskrad de 'phang bar bsgom: nad pa sri'u gso na: srung skud nag po la mdud pa dgu bya zhing : sngags khri yis byin gyis brlabs shing rdzas dang dril lam sngags rnams shog bur 'phreng gcig tu bris te: la chas dril nas btags na srung ba'i mchog go: zho chang bsrung na: shing gi byang bu la sngags bris te: khri yis rab tu gnas par bya: rdzas dang sbyar bas srung ba'i mchog go: lam 'dre bsrung ngam byad gtad dam gang rung la khyung gi sku 'khor bris nas lte bar chos 'byung bsnol ma bri: de'i dbus su khroṃ bri: phyi rol mu khyud la rtsa sngags bris shing gang dgos sham bur sbyar: rdzas dang sngags khri yis rab tu gnas pas srung ba'i mchog go: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: khyung nag me yi spu gri yi: gsang sgrub gcig bsgril gdams pa bzhag: 'di yi yon tan bsam mi khyab: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i skal ldan dang : rdzas sngags lus la 'chang ba rnams: lha srin sde brgyad gnod pa zhi:

klu dang sa bdag gdon las grol: 'go nad yams rims rnams kyang 'joms: ma 'ongs yang mthar 'di nyid zab: drag sngags me ri dmar po'i rgyud: las tshogs khyung gi sgrub thabs nyid: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: pad+ma'i ming dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi'i lor sbas tshal nas 'dong chu'i gtsug lag khang byams pa'i snyan nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ /yi ge pa ni o rgyan pra dz+nyā'o// // na) gu ru gnam lcags me 'khor gyi smad las zur 'geb kha gsab/ gzu dpang gser skyems ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs klong nas bzhengs: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: drag po mthu yi gzi byin bskyed du gsol: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir ma nyes gzu dang dpang po mdzod: bstan pa'i srog shing rdo rje theg pa la: mu stegs log lta bdud kyis brnyas btsugs so: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rgyud grags bka' btsan man ngag don ma chung : phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gzu dang dpang po mdzod: rgya bod mkha' grub rig 'dzin pad 'byung la: bdud blon bsam ngan rnams kyis brnyas btsugs so: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: 'ja' lus skye 'chi bral ba don ma chung : dgongs brda slob dpon gzu dang dpang po mdzod: mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag rdzogs chen a ti la: nyan thos grub mtha' can gyis brnyas btsugs so: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: chos nyid mngon sum ston pa don ma chung : ma sring mkha' 'gro kun gyis gzu dpang mdzod: rig 'dzin rjes 'jug rgyal tshab rnal 'byor la: bdud rigs dam sri ngan pas brnyas btsugs so:

rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: bskyed rdzogs sngags bzlas bsgrub pa don ma chung : chos skyong dam can gzu dang dpang po mdzod: ma nyes snod ldan bdag cag sgrub pa por: dam nyams dgra bo 'di yis brnyas btsugs so: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rbad bskul pho nyar mngags pa don ma chung : gter srung mthu ldan gzu dang dpang po mdzod: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol: ma nyes ma lan gzu dpang dkon mchog bzhugs: drangs shan phye ba'i sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dam nyams logs 'dren byad ma 'di nyid kyi: drag sngags rdo rje phur pa'i thun 'bebs pa'i: ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: mngon spyod bka' yi chad pa drag po ni: de ring dam nyams logs 'dren 'di la phob: las mkhan dus la bab bo sa ma ya: gser skyems mchod cing phur bu thogs la/ hūm̐: bdag ni khro rgyal pad+ma he ru kaḥ dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug mthu stobs dbang : rtsal chen bdud dpung 'joms pa'i ngo bor gsal: thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog kī la ya: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug phur bu bsgril: byad ma 'byung po bsgral ba'i rang bzhin gsal: oṃ pad+ma he ru ka tsaṇ+ḍa ro ṣa na badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ces gsal zhing hom bskyed pa ni/ phaṭḥ mdun du gnam lcags sogs 'gugs gzhug bya ba ni/ na mo/ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bka'? khyad par du'ang rig 'dzin thod phreng yab yum mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i? dpal 'jigs byed drag po dmar nag me phreng yab yum/ drag po rigs bzhi/ sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa go cha'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka'? yang sprul rta phyag khyung gsum/ gnyen po rigs bzhi dang*/ phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bka'? gter srung gnod sbyin mched lnga dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams kyi? bden pa chen po la brten nas/ spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra/ mi min mi ru brdzu ba/ lha min lha ru brdzu ba/ mi nga la lha med zer ba/ lha khyed la mthu med zer ba/ bsam ngan dug sbyor byed pa'i byad ma/ bar chad byed pa'i bdud bgegs dam sri/ khyad par du'ang bdag cag dpon slob mi nor rta phyugs dang bcas pa'i/ tshe la rku ba/ srog la 'jab pa/ bla la 'khyer ba/ yid la rlom pa/ god kha dang cho 'phrul gtong ba/ dang po nad kyi sna 'dren pa/ bar du nad kyi tshang bca' ba/ tha ma nad kyi srog 'phrog par byed pa'i/ nad 'dre gcong sri/ za 'dre shi gshed/ god 'dre god sri/ che sri/ chung sri/ dar sri/ pho sri/ mo sri/ na sri/ dur sri/ sgos sri/ phung sri/ rgyal sri/ gdon sri/ rgas sri/ gzhon sri/ lo zla zhag dus kyi sri rigs thams cad/ srog gcod dbugs len/ tshe len bdud gcod/ sgab 'dre/ gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa gang yin pa thams cad kyi bla srog rnam par shes pa/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla srid pa gsum gar gnas kyang rang dbang med par skad cig yud tsam la dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig

/oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ rat+na pā sha hūm̐: pad+ma s+pho ṭa bam̐: karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ lan gsum bkug nas pho nya 'gyed pa ni gzhung du 'jug /༈ bzlog sngags mthar rtsa sngags sham bur/ e tri ma tri sha tri 'byung po kha kha ru ni kha kha hu ni: tri pre phe sha tur ṇa trig ya ma ya yul gyi 'dre chags dang 'khrugs rtsod gri sri thams cad bzlog bzlog: ༈ oṃ dhu ru dhu ru tsakra/ dza ya dza ya tsakra/ ha na ha na tsakra/ bhu ru bhu ru tsakra/ bh+ra ma ra bh+ra ma ra tsakra/ bhe du ma ni tsakra/ dz+wa la dz+wa la tsakra/ sam+bha be ga na ya sā ra tsakra/ sa la ya sa la ya tsakra/ na sha ya na sha ya tsakra/ bam̐ bam̐ tsakra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ sa man+ta ka ra tsakra/ tip+ta tsakra hūm̐ phaṭaḥ lan gsum brjod/ bdag nyid drag po gsal ba yi: thugs kar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dbus: hūm̐ yig me yi mdog can gsal: de mthar drag po'i sngags phreng ni: lcags bsreg me yi mdog mtshungs pa: 'gal me lta bur 'khor ba las: 'od zer me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro: logs 'dren thams cad bsreg par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: yab kyi sngags ni: oṃ pad+ma he ru ka tsaṇ+ḍa ro ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ yum gyi sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra kro dhi ra tri ta tsar+ya hūm̐ bh+yoḥ drag po rigs bzhi'i sngags ni: oṃ kro ta tsaṇ+ḍa tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sngags ni: oṃ sarba ḍāk+ki ma tri bi shwa hūm̐ bh+yoḥ sham bu gang dgos skabs dang bstun/ pa) dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po las/ rgyun gyi nyams len rnal 'byor srog tig bzhugs so/ bdag rtog chags sdang las byung rgyal 'gong dang/ /dam sri'i kha rlangs nad gdon bar chad kun/ /'joms mdzad bdag med pad+ma drag po rtsal/ /dbyer med rang rig bla ma des skyongs shig / de yang dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying po'i/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la rang rig bla ma dbyer med du shes pa'i/ rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa dag la/

nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du mun pa mi 'byung ba bzhin snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shar bas/ gnyis snang gdon gyi ming yang med pas phan gnod kyi go skabs ma mchis kyang*/ da dung lta dgongs kyi rtsal ma rdzogs pa'i gang zag rnams la bskyed rdzogs kyi lam gyi bogs 'don 'di bzhin gal che'o/ /de la sngon dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po bla ma dang rang rig dbyer med du shes pa'i don gyi skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ hoḥ kun gzhi ma bcos dang po'i sangs rgyas nyid: gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal snying po can: thog ma'i mgon po dran rig chos sku la: 'khor 'das bral ba bzo med ngang du skyabs: gnyis pa de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la brtse ba'i snying rje 'bar zhing snying rje'i ngo bo stong nyid las logs su med pa'i zung 'jug gnyug ma'i don la sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ rang byung lhun grub ka dag ngang nyid las: rol pa'i rtsal rdzogs snying rje'i 'od zer 'phro: 'khor 'das mar gyur byang chub 'thob bya'i phyir: klong yangs ye grol gnyug mar sems bskyed do: gsum pa rnam rtog 'khrul ba'i gdon tshogs la dran shes gyi gtor ma byin zhing*/ 'khrul pa byang chub gyi lam du bsgyur la 'gyu bdud mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag ni gtum chen khro rgyal thod phreng rtsal: 'byung po'i tshogs rnams bka' las ma 'da' bar: gtor mas tshims shing byang chub lam la dengs: 'tshe ba'i gdon dang ma rungs tshar chod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐: log lta 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ snod bcud ye dag rang byung srung ba'i 'khor lo sgom pa ni/ hūm̐: 'byung ba lnga nyid ye shes gzhal yas khang : mi dmigs srung 'khor ye nas rdo rje'i gur: stong nyid me dpung skye med mtshon cha yis: nyon mongs bgrod 'gyu med par mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐:

de nas 'dod yon ma spang mchod pa'i rgyan du byin gyisabarlabs pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod 'dod yon tshogs drug mnyes pa'i rdzas: nang mchod sman gtor skye med chos sku'i klong : bsgral mchod sha khrag dbang po dug lnga grol: dam tshig mchod rdzas ye nas gtsang sme bral: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas dngos gzhi la/ dang po chos thams cad ye nas stong zhing bdag med pa blo 'das ka dag de kho na nyid du la bzla zhing stong nyid kyi rtsal snang ma 'gag pa lha yi dkyil 'khor la bslab pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings stong gsal blo 'das de bzhin ngang : āḥ ma 'gags rang rtsal zang thal lam gyis shar: oṃ: sna tshogs rgyu yi sa bon so sor grub: hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub drag po'i gzhal yas dbus/ /brag chen chos 'byung nyi zla bam ro'i steng*/ /hūm̐ las bdag nyid pad+ma he ru kaḥ smug nag zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i skus: g.yas gsum gnam lcags 'khor lo rdo rje gri: g.yon gsum me yi 'khor lo sdig pa phur: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas brgyad dang : dpal chas bcus brgyan zhabs gnyis dor thabs 'gying : gsang yum bde chen rdo rje bskul byed ma: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: gri gug thod khrag yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum khro bo'i sked par 'khril: yab yum me ri smug nag klong du 'gying : spyi bor bla ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: phyogs bzhir drag po rigs bzhi yab dang yum/ /sgo bzhir tshad med bzhi rdzogs mkha' 'gro bzhi/ /gzhan yang phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs/ /du mar shar yang ngo bo'i ngang du gcig /de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis:

che mchog drag po'i lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ de nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri pad+ma 'od: laṅka mgrin bcu srin po'i yul gling nas: 'jigs byed khro rgyal dbang drag lha tshogs rnams: deng 'dir drag po'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dam ye dbyer med du bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: khrag zhag pad+ma bam gyi gdan steng du: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: mi g.yo dgyes pa'i tshul gyis rab tu bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: gnyis med kyi dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal kun gyi mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa: che btsan dbang drag rdo rje srin po la: phyi nang drag po'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor: gzi brjid me ltar 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ de nas cir snang blang dor bral ba bla med mchod pa'i rol par 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gling bzhi bhan+dha yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: dbang po'i me tog sha chen bsregs pa'i spos: tshil chen zhun mar mkhris pa'i dri chab gtams: sha rus zhal zas rol mo sna tshogs dang*/ /sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas/ khrag 'thung drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: che ba'i gzi byin bskyed cing bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos nyid rang bzhin dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /snying rje'i thabs kyis gdug pa kun 'dul phyir/ /'bar ba'i cho 'phrul gar dgu'i rab brjid pa/ /dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la bstod/ /de nas dzap dmigs ni/ rang nyid gu ru drag po'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar nag tha mar sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba mchod/

byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pa tshur 'dus/ slar 'od zer me dpung tshwa tshwa dang bcas mkha' khyab tu spros pas srid gsum gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad/ rgyal 'gong dam sri rnams thal ba bun gyis bsregs shing snang grags snod bcud thams cad dbang drag pad+ma drag po'i lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: de ltar bsnyen sgrub gcig dril du nyams su len par bya'o/ /rab rang rig g.yo med ngang shugs 'byung tshul du bzla ba ni/ gnyug ma'i bzla ba dang*/ 'byin 'jug rlung gi bzla ba'am/ 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzla ba rnams rlung 'byin 'jug gnas gsum la brten nas bzla ba dang*/ bar rlung 'dzin bzhin du bzla ba bcas so/ rgyal 'gong 'byung pos 'khu ba dang byad ltas byung na rgyal bsen ar gtad ni/ oṃ she la du shing rā dza rbad thum tsit+ta gzer nan big thum trag thum: zhes sham bu skabs dang sbyar ba drag sngags me'i spu gri'o/ dus min bzla bar mi rigs so/ shin tu gnyan pas 'os 'tshams bya/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying bya/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos nyid rang bzhin dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /snying rje'i thabs kyis gdug pa kun 'dul phyir/ /'bar ba'i cho 'phrul gar dgu'i rab brjid pa/ /dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la bstod/ /yig brgya dang bshags pa bya/ mthar dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung lhun grub e yi dal: mi dmigs ngang las mtha' nas dbus su yal: yab yum hūm̐ bsdu hūm̐ yang skye med ngang : ma bcos ka dag lhun grub ngang la bzhag: hūm̐ a a āḥ de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing ma bcos pa'i ngang du bzhag

/bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ bsngo ba mi dmigs sems can sangs rgyas zhing : gdod nas rnam dag bsngo yul ma grub ste: ye grol thig le ro gcig ngang la rdzogs: de dag rang rig rgya yan chen por bsngo: smon lam ni/ hoḥ rang byung rang shar thod phreng dkyil 'khor lha: rtse gcig bsgrubs pa'i rten 'brel bslu med mthus: rang rig rtogs pa'i rgyal sa zin gyur cig: tshe rabs lhar gyur gzhan phan mtha' yas shog: ces bsngo smon bya'o/ /bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis ka dag snang mtha' yas: longs sku'i bkra shis dbyings rig spyan ras gzigs: sprul sku'i bkra shis lhun grub pad+ma 'byung : rten 'brel bkra shis ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: brgyud 'dzin bkra shis rje 'bangs gter gyi bdag: zab chos yar zla ltar 'phel bkra shis shog: ces pa'ang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos 'dong chu dpal gyi gtsug lag byams pa'i snyan g.yon nas/ bzhes pa'i dbang drag pad+ma yang gsang snying pos zab gter gyi bcud bsdus nas/ rgyun gyi nyams len rnal 'byor srog tig ces bya ba 'di'ang lam 'di spel ba'i byed por bsngags pa'i/ sngags 'chang gnam lcags bstan 'dzin 'bod pas rab gnas rab byung 17 shing sprel lo'i khrum zla'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum par the pe ru sbyar ba 'dis kyang dam sri gdug pa'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // pha) rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ e ma ho/ snang ba mtha' yas 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter/ /pad 'byung yab yum gnubs ban dz+nyā na'i mtshan/ /sprul pa'i gter 'byin rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs char rgyun stsol/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpal/ /gcig bsdus bdag nyid dbang chen yab yum dang*/ /thugs mchog gsang bdag las mdzad rnam gnyis la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/

/nyon mongs rang rgyud 'khrul pa'i dug gsum bdud/ /gnyis med ye shes sku gsum dbyings su dag /sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rol par sad/ /dbang chen he ru ka par mngon gyur shog / ces pa'ang man+t+ra'i ngor gu h+yas so// // ba) ༈ rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub 'don khrigs su bkod pa rngam pa'i rta skad ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgyal kun sor sor rtogs pa'i ye shes ni/ /gsung gi rdo rje ma chags pad+ma'i rigs/ /bde stong gar gyi dbang phyug 'khor lo'i mgon/ /dbyer med rta phag yab yum rgyal gyur cig / de la bla ma yang gsang pad+ma drag po gnam lcags 'khor lo'i cha lag /rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub nyams su len pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba ni/ thog mar nub phyogs su zla gam dmar po dbang g-i dkyil 'khor bzhengs la de'i steng maṇ+ḍal khar dpal gtor zur gsum rta mgos mtshan pa me ri'i rgyan ldan 'khor bzhis bskor ba/ mdun du sman raka gtor ma/ mchod pa bcas ma tshang ba med par 'du bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thog mar skyabs sems ni/

na mo/ bla ma mchog gsum dbang chen he ru kar/ /gus pas skyabs mchi bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob bya'i phyir/ /dbang chen rta phag yab yum bsgrub par bgyi/ /lan gsum dang/ de nas bgegs gtor chu gtsang gis bran zhing*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ḥ oṃ aḥhūm̐/ gi byin gyis brlab/ sarba bhu ta ar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dgug hūm̐: nga ni khrag 'thung dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal: rang bzhin thugs las khro chung mtshon char 'bebs: 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gtor mas tshim zhing dengs: deng 'dir 'tshe na thal ba'i rdul du rlog: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po shag tshal pa mā ra ya rbad rbad: bh+yo bh+yo thun bh+yoḥ de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: steng 'og me dang mtshon cha'i gur: drwa mig lcags sdig khyung gis gtams: spu gri khro chung pha lam sbrel: cis kyang mi tshugs 'khor lo'i gur: om̐ badz+ra ram̐ ā yur dha tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐: de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod 'dod yon spyan gzigs rgyan: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dang : gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dkyil 'khor rdzas: 'dod yon mnyes mchod dpag med spel: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: de nas 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/ hūm̐: ngo bo chos nyid de bzhin dbyings: rang rtsal ma 'gags stong par shar: kun rgyu sprul pa'i sa bon hūm̐: dran rdzogs gnam lcags rdo rjer bsgom: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: hrīḥ zla gam dmar nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang: snang srid 'khor 'das kun khyab yangs pa'i nang : pad+ma nyi zla baṃ ro'i steng du hrīḥ dmar gsal 'phro 'du 'od zer spro bsdu las: rang nyid dbang chen h+ya ghṛ wa'i sku: dmar gsal me 'od 'phros shing gtum pa'i gzugs: nyi zla brjid pa'i spyan gsum 'od du 'bar:

zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal: rab 'jigs gtum rngam drag tu 'bar ba'i skus: skra brdzes thod phreng dar dpyang snyan chas brgyan: phyag g.yas thod dbyug nam mkha'i mthongs su phyar: g.yon pas me yi zhags pa bgegs la gzir: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad klu brgyad brgyan: gar gyi nyams dgu ldan zhing gsal bar gyur: dbu gtsug khro rgyal bya khyung ga ru ḍaḥ dmar nag me yi spu gri'i gshog rtsal 'phyo: g.yas su rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can: khro rngam khro chas khro bo'i cha lugs rdzogs: dar nag ber gsol ral gri lcags kyu 'dzin: g.yon du rdo rje phag mo dmar nag mdog: khro mo'i chas rdzogs gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs lam lam rtse: kun kyang dbu la rta zhal phag gdong mtshan: rgyab tu phyag na rdo rje mthing nag 'bar: rdo rje rtse lnga zhags pa 'dzin cing 'debs: mdun du yak+sha me dbal dmar nag khro: tho ba dgra satwa 'dzin cing bgegs tshogs 'dul: de yi mdun du lcags sdig nag po ni: mgo dgu'i rwa gzengs kha dgus rgyal bsen za: kun kyang sku la khro chas rdzogs par gsal: de ltar lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum las 'od 'phros pas: dbang drag zla gam rol pa'i dur khrod nas: rta phag yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad skar mda' shugs kyis 'phang ba ltar spyan drangs par gyur/ de ltar spyan drangs bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal dkyus gcig tu bya ba ni/ hrīḥ zla gam dmar nag dbang drag gzhal yas nas: rta phag yab yum 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: sngon tshe ru tra pho mo btul ba ltar: da lta sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag la: gnod cing 'tshe ba'i rgyal 'gong dam sri rnams: thal bar brlag phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: 'dir gshegs 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: khyed la phyag 'tshal dus kun skyabs su mchi: ma hā kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dam tshig phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: mchod yon khrus chab me tog bdug spos dang : mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo sogs: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di: rta phag yab yum 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: khyed rnams thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi rgya mtsho dang : sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang : nyams gyur bshags la dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta sarba pū dza khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ḥ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rdo rje: bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo che: rta phag yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sngon tshe ma traṃ ru tra stobs po che: dus mtshan nag po la sogs bdud dmag 'bum: thal bar brlag byed rta phag yab yum gyi: lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang nyid dbang chen yab yum gyi/ /thugs kar pad+ma zla ba'i steng*/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dkar gsal 'tsher/ /thugs klong 'od kyi thig le'i dbus/ /pad 'byung thugs kar hrīḥdamar nag /de mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ /'od zer spro bsdu don gnyis byas/ khyad par gza' klu rgyal gdon dang*/ /dug gsum rgyu bcas rjes med bsreg /snod bcud khro bo'i zhing du gyur/ hrīḥpad+ma ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ de ltar bsnyen sgrub chig sgril 'bum phrag drug tu bzla'o/ /las sbyor bya bar spro na/ rang nyid dbang chen sku ru gsal: bdag dang me dbal thugs ka nas: sngags kyi 'od zer spu gri 'phros: 'dre rgod gnod byed thams cad kyi: srog rtsa rbad rbad bcad par gyur: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na 'dre rgod rgyal 'gong 'byung po'i srog la hab: snying la rbad:

lus ngag yid gsum mā ra ya chings nan: zhes spu gri mtshon cha'i drag sngags dmigs pa'i gnad dang ldan par bzla'o/ de nas sdig pa snying 'dzin gyi man ngag ni/ bdag nyid hūm̐ las lcags sdig ni: mgo dgu bco brgyad rwa ldan pa: kha dgu gdangs shing mig dgu bgrad: shin tu gtum rngam 'jigs rung gyur: oṃ badz+ra yak+sha trig nan e hur thuṃ dzaḥ gzer nad rgyal 'gong dam sri ka waka tsi rbad: brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ rang nyid sdig pa'i nga rgyal gyi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las dza dmar nag: 'phros pa yongs su gyur pa las: pho nya rang 'dra dpag med pas: 'jig rten thams cad yongs su gang : rgyal 'gong dam sri thams cad kun: thar med skad ngan tser tser bsgom: sha la sbrang ma 'du ba ltar: lcags sdig pho nya bcas pa yis: de la btogs te snying nas zhugs: srog rtsa bcad cing snying khrag 'jib: phyi nang kun nas zos pa yi: lhag ma tsam yang med par gyur: ces sngags bzla zhing*/ dam sri rgyal 'gong hab hab ljib ljib tu zos shing lhag ma med par bsams la mthar dmigs med kyi ngang du bzhag par bya'o/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig bcas bya'o/ /gzhung las/ grub rtags phyi nang gsang ba ni: rab dngos: 'bring nyams: tha ma rmi lam du: sku 'bag ras bris rta phag gsal ba dang : gsang ba'i grub rtags 'ja' 'od du sku dngos mjal ba the tshom med: ces dang*/ rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub 'di: rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud kyi bcud bsdus snying khrag thigs pa sa ma ya: gu h+ya brda thim: zhes gsungs pa bzhin zab par snang ngo*/ /gnyis pa tshogs mchod bya ba la bdun las/ dang po tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bdud rtsis bran la/ hūm̐: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis me rlung chu'i: bag chags 'khrud phyir tshogs la phog: bzang ngan sme bar 'dzin pa rnams: sbyangs bkrus gtor ba'i bdud rtsir bsgyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/

hūm̐/ gsang chen dbang drag rol pa'i pho brang nas: dbang chen rta phag yab yum rtsa gsum lha/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir byin phob mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ gsum pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang : chos skyong gter srung dkyil 'khor skyong mdzad pa: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas mchod pa'i sprin: dngos su bshams shing blo yis sprul pa'i tshogs: stong gsum khyon ltar khengs pa'i yid 'phrog rdzas: khyad par dur khrod drag po'i nyer spyod sogs/ /sna tshogs mchod sprin kun tshang rgya mtsho 'dis/ /dbang chen rta phag yab yum thugs dam bskang*/ khro rgyal ga ru ḍa yi thugs dam bskang*/ /rta mgrin nag po lcags ral thugs dam bskang*/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dpal chen yak+sha me dbal thugs dam bskang*/ /las byed lcags sdig nag po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs yongs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hoḥ tshogs kyi nyes skyon ma rig blang dor rnams: ro gcig lta ba zag med ting 'dzin gyis: gzung 'dzin dgag sgrub nyams chag skyon gyi tshogs: bdag gzhan gnyis med ye grol ngang la bshags: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ drug pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : dmigs bya dgra bgegs myur du khug: gnod byed srog la kī la ya: gtub cing khro rgyal zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā rak+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na khā hi: zhes bstab cing tshogs la rol/

bdun pa lhag ma gtong ba ni/ hoḥ lhag la dbang ba'i gnas nyul ma: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong mdzad rnams: lhag ma'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: om̐ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha ling+ta la khā hi: brgyad pa bskul pa ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon dby-ings nas khro rgyal lha tshogs bzhengs: deng 'dir bdag gi rgyab rten phrin las bskul: sangs rgyas bstan dgra sgos dgra dam nyams la: dmar nag drag po'i zor thun snying la ya: bsad cing rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ kro ti kā li na byad ma 'byung po 'dre rgod rnams la zor bh+yo bh+yoḥ rbad bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlogaḥ ces dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ skabs 'dir chos skyong gtor 'bul bya/ dgu pa chad mdo ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min dbang chen pho brang du: dregs 'dul zhal phye khro mos khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo dam ma g.yel: de 'og dur khrod me ri 'bar ba ru: klu 'dul zhal phye bya khyung khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo dam ma g.yel: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: 'byung 'dul zhal phye gter srung khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo dam ma g.yel: gdug pa'i 'byung po dam sri 'dul bar mdzod: om̐ kro ta kro ti khrom̐ ga ru ṭa he bha ling+ta khā hi: bcu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma sman: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas rnams: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa skyongs: khas blangs bzhin du phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma ma hriṃ hriṃ dza dza bha ling+ta khā hi: bcu gcig pa rta bro ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dbang chen he ru kas: dam sri bsgral nas rta bro rdung : chem chem mnan mnan ma ldang zhig: mchod rten nag po'i 'og tu brub: om̐ nan: a nan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: de nas gtor gzhong kha yar bzed nas 'bru 'thor/ dbang blang ba ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med rang byung pho brang nas:

bskyed cing drang ba'i zlos gar dkyil 'khor lhas: don gnyis las bzhi'i phrin las shugs phyung nas: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pas dbang blang*/ rjes chog mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta sarba pū dza khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ḥ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rdo rje: bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo che: rta phag yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs nas bstod par bgyi/ bar bstod/ nongs bshags ni/ hūm̐: bla med theg chen rgyud sde'i sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba yan lag phyag rgya ting 'dzin sogs/ khas blangs dam tshig nyams 'gal ci mchis pa/ /mthol bshags bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang*/ de nas brtan bzhugs bya/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs nas om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐: snang stong 'ja' tshon chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: mi dmigs lha tshogs dbyings rig klong la thim: dran rig chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: ma bcos spros bral ngang la ā ru ldang : a a āḥ bsngo smon bya ba ni/ hrīḥ bdag gi bsnyen sgrub dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams kyi don du bsngo: kun kyang sa bcu lam lnga mthar phyin nas: gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / bkra shis bya ba ni/ hūm̐: gar gyi dbang phyug khro rgyal kun gyi rje: gdug pa'i g.yul bcom dbang chen h+ya ghṛ: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog: rjes su bsngo smon ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan la mthar stong nyid 'od gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas yul 'dong chu gtsug lag khang gi

/byams pa'i snyan nas zab gter du gdan drangs pa'i rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub 'di bzhin/ rta mgrin nyams len la mos pa dag la phan pa'i blos tshogs mchod sogs zhal skong dgos rigs/ rang lugs rta mchog nyi ma'i snying po sogs rigs mthun gzhan nas blangs te/ ngag 'don khrigs chags su bkod pa 'di'ang rta mchog grub pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi/ ye shes sgyu 'phrul o rgyan dri med gling pa'i skyes mthar 'bod pa khyung yul du skyes shing*/ rgyal khams phyogs med nyul ba'i sprang po ngag dbang klu sgrub dpal bzang pos shing bya lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes bdun la g.yu lo bkod rje btsun gling du bgyis pa'o// // ma) ༈ gu ru drag po gnam lcags 'khor lo'i gtum po klu 'dul gyi gsang sgrub rgyun khyer bzhugs so/ phyag rdor gtum po klu 'dul gyi rgyun khyer nyams su len pa la/ thog mar skyabs sems ni/ na mo: dpal chen kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: sgo gsum rtsol bral ngang gis skyabs su mchi: ma gyur 'gro ba srid bsdus kun gyi ched: bdag gis dpal chen bsgrubs nas go 'phang dgod:

lan gsum/ hūm̐: mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: pad+ma nyi ma sa bdag steng : bdag nyid gtum po sku mdog mthing : phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje dang : lcags kyu 'dzin cing steng gdon gzir: g.yon pa sbrul zhags klu gnyan 'ching : sdigs mdzub rtse la khyung khra 'gyed: dmangs rigs klu sbrul zhal du gsol: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan dmar 'khrugs: dbu skra kham nag thod skam brgyan: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs: spyi bor sku yi bya khyung dkar: rgyal rigs klu sbrul zhal du gsol: phyag g.yas gsung gi bya khyung dmar: bram ze klu sbrul zhal du gsol: phyag g.yon thugs kyi bya khyung sngo: rje rigs klu sbrul zhal du gsol: gdol pa nag po zhabs 'og mnan: ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ gi mthar: sngags phreng 'gal me g.yas su 'khor: 'od zer me dang thog ser 'phro: gza' klu sde brgyad gnod byed kun: gzhob rgod thul thul tshig par bsam : rtsa ba'i sngags ni/ om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci 'grub bzla/ khyung sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: khroṃ gha ru ḍa haṃ sa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces ci nus su bzla zhing dmigs med ka dag gi ngang du mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor ye shes dbyings su mu/ /sgo gsum mi shigs rdo rje'i go dang ldan/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bdag gzhan 'gro la bsngo/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog / rjes shes bsngo ba dang smon lam sogs spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ zhes pa'ang rang slob au ḍī'i bzhed skong slad gter gzhung rgyun khyer la sngon rjes cung zad spros pa po ni gu h+yas so// // ka) dbang chen rta mchog rol pa nā ga klu 'dul gyi sngon 'gro skyabs yul gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ /e ma ho/ chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas/ /rigs bdag snang mtha'i sku la skyabs su mchi/ /ma 'gags longs spyod lnga ldan pho brang nas/

/ston pa rdor sems sku la skyabs su mchi/ /sna tshogs gang 'dul der ston pho brang nas/ /sprul sku pad 'byung sku la skyabs su mchi/ /man ngag gsang mdzod snying po'i pho brang nas/ /ḍāk+ki mtsho rgyal sku la skyabs su mchi/ /bka' bab rgyud lung zab mo'i pho brang nas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes sku la skyabs su mchi/ /dbang drag rol pa'i gnas mchog pho brang nas/ /rta mchog klu 'dul sku la skyabs su mchi/ /phrin las rnam bzhi 'gro 'dul pho brang nas/ /ḍāk+ki rigs bzhi'i sku la skyabs su mchi/ /myur mgyogs dpal 'bar rol pa'i pho brang nas/ /bka' gter srung ma bcas la skyabs su mchi/ /de ltar gsol btab dkyil 'khor bsgrubs pa'i lha/ /sku gsum 'od zer rnam pa rang la thim/ /dbang bzhi'i don rtogs mchog thun 'bras bu rnams/ /skad cig thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i skyabs yul bsdus pa 'di rig 'dzin mchog sprul rgyal sras dam pas bskul ngor/ 7sngags 'chang gnam lcags rdo rjes bris pa'o// // kha) rta mchog rol pa nyi ma'i snying po las: las byang yang gsang snying po bzhugs so: khro rgyal chen po'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: skal ldan las 'phro ldan pa'i don: yang gsang zab pa'i mthar thug las: khro rgyal nā ga klu 'dul gyi: snying po sgrub pa'i las byang bstan: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: klu srin sa bdag 'byung po 'khrugs: mi rung sna dgu rims yams dar: rgya nad bdun drug 'tshubs pa'i tshe: de dag 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru: khro rgyal nā ga klu 'dul gyi: tshig nyung don 'brel byin rlabs che: drag sngags kun gyi mthar thug nyid: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs nyi shu la nye dus: gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: 'di dag sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: drag po dur khrod shing gcig drung :

yang na bkra shis dben pa'i yul: rten 'brel che zhing smon lam gdab: yid du 'ong ba'i gnas mchog tu: dkyil 'khor dag ni gzhung bzhin las: dbus su chos 'byung bsnol ma la: lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan par bri: sgo bzhir tshom bu re re bkod: bhan+dha mtshan ldan nang du ni: gtor ma rta mchog lugs ltar bzhag: dkar dmar rgyan gyis legs par spras: khro bo'i tsakli dag kyang 'dzugs: 'khor ni lha gzhung lta bu bya: dbus su bum pa mgul chings dang : kha rgyan ldan par bum rdzas gtams: me long dkyil 'khor tshang bar bzhag: g.yon du gri lcags zangs sam la: ga pur rdzas rgod byug par bya: de dag dar nag nang du dril: phyi rol mchod rdzas gzhung bzhin bsham: 'di nyid drag po gcig dril phyir: spros bcas spros med gang dgos bya: sa ma ya: dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: hūm̐: skyabs yul 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rtsa ba gsum: sku gsum lhun grub ngang nas skyabs su mchi: gdod nas dag pa 'khor 'das sangs rgyas zhing : de don rtogs phyir bdag gis sems bskyed do: de nas bgegs gtor chu gtsang gis bran zhing : hūm̐: bdag nyid thugs las 'od zer mtshon cha 'phros: 'gugs pa'i rang bzhin las byed bye ba 'bum: bar chad log 'dren gtor ma len phyir khug: om̐ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza na gnod byed 'byung po khug dzaḥ de nas kha phyir bstan la drag po'i thun gyis gzir zhing : hūm̐: nga ni khrag 'thung dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal: rang bzhin thugs las khro chung mtshon char 'bebs: 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gtor mas tshim zh-ing dengs: deng 'dir 'tshe na thal ba'i rdul du rlog: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po shag tshal pa mā ra ya rbad rbad: bh+yo bh+yo thun bh+yoḥ de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: steng 'og me dang mtshon cha'i gur: drwa mig lcags sdig khyung gis gtams: spu gri khro chung pha lam sbar:

cis kyang mi tshugs 'khor lo'i gur: om̐ badz+ra ram̐ ā yur dha tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐: de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod 'dod yon spyan gzigs rgyan: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dang : gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dkyil 'khor rdzas: 'dod yon mnyes mchod dpag med spel: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: de nas 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: hūm̐: ngo bo chos nyid de bzhin dbyings: rang rtsal ma 'gags stong par shar: kun rgyu sprul pa'i sa bon hūm̐: dran rdzogs gnam lcags rdo rjer bsgom: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: e las nam mkha' mthing nag 'bar: yam̐ las drag po'i rlung nag g.yo: kham̐ las rak+ta'i rba rlabs 'phyur: sum̐ las lbu ba sa gzhir 'khrigs: keṃ las dur khrod ri rab brtsegs: bh+rūm̐ las drag po'i pho brang nang : rdo rje thigs pa dmar chen 'khyil: gru bzhi sgo khyud ka gdung dang : rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gus brjid: drwa ba drwa phyed shar bu bskyod: thod pa skam rlon mda' yab brgyan: rta babs bang rim chos tog mtho: g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan tsit+tas brgyan: dur khrod la sogs srung 'khor rdzogs: nang du g.yang gzhi'i bla bre bkram: dmar chen khrag zhag pad+ma nyi: bam ro smug po'i snying kha ru: lcags bsregs las grub rdo rje ni: rtse dgu lte ba hūm̐ sgra can: dran rdzogs gnas gyur khro rgyal skus: nā ga klu 'dul mthing nag 'bar: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing khro: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khyil: rta dbu rigs gsum rta skad 'tsher: dbu skra dmar ser thod skam brgyan: dar nag cod pan dug sbrul 'khyugs: g.yas gsum ral gri dbyug to khyung : g.yon gsum lcags kyu thod khrag sbrul: glang ko zhing lpags khyung gshog ldan:

thod phreng rus rgyan stag gi sham: sgeg cing sbal sbrul lhu tshigs brgyan: klu gnyan sa bdag khri 'bum gdan: yum mchog phag mo klu 'dul ma: g.yas pas gri gug sbrul zhags 'dzin: g.yon pas bhan dmar sdig pa bsnams: khro mo'i spyi bor phag zhal ngur: rus rgyan gcer mo yab la 'khril: ba spu'i bu gar khyung gis gtams: me ri smug nag klong du gsal: spyi bor gnam lcags ga ru ṭaḥ me gshog krang kring klu gnyan za: phyogs bzhir khro mo sha za bzhi: gri thod 'dzin cing dur khrod chas: brkyang bskum me dpung klong du gsal: mdun du sprul pa'i lcags sdig 'khyugs: rgyab tu dug gi phag rgod ngur: sgo bzhir bya khyung sde lnga gsal: yang sprul phag sdig bya khyung 'bum: klu srin rgyal 'gong 'dre rgod dang : dam sri 'byung po 'joms par gsal: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ baṃ badz+ra wā rā hī nā ga ma tha hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ kro ti ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas: 'og min dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas: khro rgyal klu 'dul 'khor bcas spyan drangs: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med drag po e yi klong : rngam brjid dur khrod 'bar bar klong dkyil nas: dbang chen khro rgyal lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: dam sri klu gnyan 'dul ba'i dus la bab: om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa sa pa ri wā ra dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klu bdud gdan: dam sri 'byung po 'dre rgod bsnol ba'i steng : mthu rtsal gzi byin stobs kyis sa gsum gnon: smyo 'bog snying gzer klu srin 'dul phyir bzhugs: oṃ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: don dam chos nyid longs sku khro tshul can:

ma rungs log 'dren zil gnon g.yul las rgyal: che btsan rta mchog dbang gi rgyal po yi: lhun grub sku la brda rtags phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: stong gsum chos dbyings snod mchog bhan+dha ru: phyi nang mchod pa spyan gzigs blo yis khengs: sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol mchod pa'i sprin: dug lnga rnam dag rol pa mchod pa'i tshogs: khrag 'thung khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kro ti shwa rī khroṃ ga ru ṭa ya badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na la khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i chos dbyings klong : snang srid lha srin 'dul ba'i bdag nyid can: sku mdog mthing nag chos dbyings skye med gzugs: g.yas g.yon dkar dmar pho rgyud mo rgyud 'dul: rta dbu gsum ldan rta skad phyogs bcur 'tsher: dmar nag ral pas stong khams me 'od 'khrug: thod skam sbrul rgyan ye shes 'jig rten sngangs: ral gri dbyug tos 'dre rgod snying rtsa gcod: bya khyung nag pos klu gnyan sa bdag 'joms: lcags kyus ma rungs snying 'dzin thod khrag rol: sbrul nag zhags pas log 'dren 'byung po 'ching : khyung gshog brgyangs shing snod bcud tshwa tshwa 'khrug: dur khrod chas ldan dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: zhabs bzhi dor stabs klu gnyan sa bdag brdzis: sku la 'khril ba'i khro mo klu 'dul rngam: gri thod mgul 'khyud dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: sbrul dang lcags sdig ma rungs klu gnyan 'joms: phag zhal phaiṃ sgras ma rungs las la bskul: rus rgyan yab 'khril bde stong dbye ba med: me ri'i dbus bzhugs 'byung po bdud tshogs sreg: dbang chen klu 'dul yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: sprul pa'i bya khyung gnam lcags mchu sder can:

me gshog rdeb cing krang kring rngam sgra sgrog: ma rungs gdug pa'i klu gnyan snying khrag 'jib: sprul pa'i bya khyung sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: khro mo rnam bzhi mi bzad dgra sha za: gri thod 'dzin cing dam nyams srog dbugs phral: gar thabs bsgyur zhing stong gsum glog ltar myur: sha za mkha' 'gro bzhi yi sku la bstod: hūm̐: sprul pa'i lcags sdig rgyal bsen snying khrag 'jib: dug gi phag rgod klu gnyan sa bdag 'joms: bya khyung rigs bzhis rgya nad bdun drug sreg: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i 'byung po dam sri'i snying nas drongs: nag po klu dang sa bdag ming nas sdud: rgya nad bdun drug smyo 'bog rtsad nas chod: ma rungs rgyal bsen dam sri rdul du rlog: mdze shu gnyan 'bum lhog rgod gting nas skem: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dzap dmigs ni/ bdag nyid drag po'i snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag la rtsa ba'i sngags phreng 'khor bas/ lus kyi nang thams cad bya khyung dang khro bos gang ste ba spu'i bu ga nas phar 'phros pas/ snang srid snod bcud thams cad bya khyung dmar nag sdig pa dug gi phag rgod/ sgrol ba'i ma mo'i tshogs kyis gang nas kun gyi zhal nas sngags sgra sgrog cing*/ sku las me dpung 'bar bzhin rgyal bsen dam sri 'byung po/ 'dre rgod klu dang sa bdag thams cad hab hab ljib ljib tu zos shing 'bar ba'i shugs kyis/ shul med du bsregs shing med par byas/ sngags phreng dang me lce thams cad tshur 'dus pas/ srung ba'i gur khang dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams khyung dang lcags sdig gis gtams pas/ bskal pa'i rlung yang mi zhugs pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ yab kyi sngags ni/ om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ yum gyi sngags ni/ om̐ baṃ badz+ra wā rā hī nā ga ma tha hūm̐ phaṭḥ khyung sngags ni/

oṃ khrom̐ ga ru ṭa tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ khro mo bzhi'i sngags ni/ om̐ kro ti ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ bya khyung rigs bzhi'i sngags ni/ om̐ khrom̐ ga ru ṭa tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas las sngags klu dang sa bdag 'dul byed ni: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa bhu mi ya tsit+ta rbad rbad: om̐ khroṃ nā ga ra tsa tsit+ta yaṃ yaṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha rbad rbad: ces dang klu dang sa bdag gi nad kyis gdon na sham bur zab/ rgyal bsen gyis gdon na/ om̐ badz+ra kro ta kro ti tsaṇ+ḍa na h+ya ghṛ wa ma hā kā la shā+e la du ging rā dza rak+ṣi na tsit+ta rbad rbad: ṭa ṭa tshin+dha pa tsa ma tha nan: rgyal bsen dam sri 'byung po'i snying hur hur shig shig mā ra ya rbad rbad: rgyal bsen gyis gdon na 'di gang mang bya/ gdon gyi rigs la/ oṃ khyoṃ pa khyoṃ ma hā na a mu ka tsit+ta tshin+dha ma tha ma tha rbad rbad: 'dre rgod dam sri 'byung po kā wa tsig shig shig 'ur 'ur: snying rtsa 'gas 'gas myog myog thum thum rbad rbad: ces 'di ci mang bzla: 'di nyid yi ge dbu can du bris nas khyim du 'chang na gnod pa thams cad thub par 'gyur ro: rdzas ni gri khrag ke tshe nyungs dkar dur byed bong nga dkar gla rtsi gu gul shing kun shu dag mu zi ru rta: rta bon btsan dug rgya snag rma bya'i mdangs stag gi sder mo gcan gzan sna tshogs kyi mche ba: dug shing sher shing sdig srin sbal sbrul gi sha khyung gi sder mo spre'u'i snying lcung ka'i snying phag rgod kyi mche ba bcas khrol bur bsgrub bam: ril bu sran ma tsam du dril te lus la 'chang na: lha srin sde brgyad kyi gnod pas mi tshugs shing srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro: dus tshab che na du ba bdug cing rung*/ khong du btang na nas tsam las mi rung : 'go nad thams cad thub c-ing srung skud dam shog bu la rtsa sngags bris te mgul du 'chang na: klu dang sa bdag gi mdze shu'am lhog yams sogs la srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur:

rdzas kyi thum dmar nag bya yang na lcags kyi gwa'ur 'chang rtsa sngags la sogs khri las mi nyung bar bzlas pas grub rtags 'byung ngo : grib dang mi gtsang sogs la 'dzem par bya: sgrub pa'i tshe sha dang chang ni spang bar bya: rdzas la bud med kyis ma reg par bya dgos: sa ma ya:

de nas tshogs bya ba ni: chu gtsang gis bran la: hūm̐: bdag nyid khro rgyal thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge 'phros: bag chags nyes skyon bsregs gtor bkrus: aum̐ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min dbang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas: khro bo'i rgyal po klu rgyal he ru kaḥ dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams: rang bzhin gnas nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: thugs rjes rtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas tshogs mchod ni: hūm̐: dbang chen khro rgyal 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyis: zhal zas tshogs mchod rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag bshags gyur nas: dbang dang dngos grub deng 'dir stsal du gsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi: de nas bskang ba ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥphaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥdzaḥ hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub e yi pho brang nas: rta mchog rol pa klu 'dul he ru kaḥ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong nas bzhengs: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol: dug gsum sman raka gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam bskang zhing bar chad bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba yi: mig rna sna lce don snying ri ltar spungs: mi rta khyi sogs sha chen bsregs pa'i spos: klad rus khu ba rkang mar sgron pa'i me: zhag g.yo bcud ldan 'khyil ba'i dri chab gtams: 'bru nag ngar btang dug khrag sbags pa'i bshos: thod rnga rkang gling rol mo sgra ldan gyis: khro rgyal klu 'dul yab yum thugs dam bskang : khrag 'thung khro mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : 'joms byed bya khyung sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : yang sprul phag dang sdig rgod thugs dam bskang : dbang chen dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskangs gyur nas:

klu srin rgyal 'gong sa bdag gnod pa zlog: hūm̐: bhan+dha lcang lo bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil: bha ling gtor mar sha rus khrag gis brgyan: dung dmar snod du rak+ta'i rba rlabs 'phyo: sbyor sgrol mchod pa phyi nang sprin ltar gtibs: mkha' la g.yang gzhi bya khyung sna tshogs gdeng : dpal chen dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyis: khro rgyal klu 'dul yab yum thugs dam bskang : khrag 'thung khro mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : 'joms byed bya khyung sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : yang sprul phag dang sdig rgod thugs dam bskang : dbang chen dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: klu srin rgyal 'gong sa bdag gnod pa zlog: hūm̐: ga ṇa tshogs kyi mchod pa bcud dang ldan: 'bras rgun bu ram tshogs chang sman dang spos: 'bru bcud 'bras bu bam tshogs sha chen dang : glu ma gar ma ging mo sgeg mo dang : yid 'phrog dbang ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs kyis: khro rgyal klu 'dul yab yum thugs dam bskang : khrag 'thung khro mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : 'joms byed bya khyung sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : yang sprul phag dang sdig rgod thugs dam bskang : dbang chen dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: de nas bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dbang chen khro rgyal lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag bag med le lo'i dbang gyur te: bskyed rdzogs ma gsal bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba dang : dus kyi tshogs gtor bskang ba chad cing nyams: mchod rdzas ma tshang phud lhag 'dres pa dang : ma rig rmongs gyur las sgrib ci mchis pa: mthol bshags bzod la tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa sa twa hūm̐: de nas yig brgyas lhag chad kha bkang sa ma ya: de nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: mdun du tha ma'i tshogs ling la: dmigs bya dgra bgegs myur du khug: sras mchog badz+ra kī la yas: bsgral zhing gtub pa'i dus la bab:

om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces gtub cing zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: lhag med 'bul zhing dgyes par rol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta khā hi: de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams tshogs la rol: hoḥ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: gnyis 'dzin bral zhing tshogs la rol: a la la hoḥ zhes rol: lhag ma gtong ba ni: hoḥ lhag la dbang ba'i gnas nyul ma: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong mdzad rnams: lhag ma'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: om̐ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha ling+ta la khā hi: de nas bskul zhing zor 'phang ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon dby-ings nas khro rgyal lha tshogs bzhengs: deng 'dir bdag gis rgyal bstan phṛn las bskul: sangs rgyas bstan dgra sgos dgra dam nyams la: drag po'i dmar nag zor thun snying la ya: bsad cing rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ kro ti kā li na byad ma 'byung po 'dre rgod rnams la zor bh+yo bh+yoḥ rbad bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlogaḥ ces dgra phyogs su 'phang : sa ma ya: de nas chad mdo ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min dbang chen pho brang du: dregs 'dul zhal phye khro mos khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo dam ma g.yel: de 'og dur khrod me ri 'bar ba ru: klu 'dul zhal phye bya khyung khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo dam ma g.yel: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: 'byung 'dul zhal phye gter srung khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo dam ma g.yel: gdug pa'i 'byung po dam sri 'dul bar mdzod: om̐ kro ta kro ti khrom̐ ga ru ṭa he bha ling+ta khā hi: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma sman: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas rnams:

gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa skyongs: khas blangs bzhin du phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma ma hriṃ hriṃ dza dza bha ling+ta khā hi: rta bro ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal dbang chen klu 'dul gyis: dam sri bsgral nas rta bro rdung : chem chem mnan mnan ma ldang zhig: mchod rten nag po'i 'og tu brub: om̐ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: de nas gtor gzhong kha yar bzed nas 'bru 'thor: de nas dbang blang ba dang tshe 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: dbang chen yab yum ngo bo nyid: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i skal ldan la: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs stsal du gsol: om̐ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: de nas dbang bzhi blang zhing dngos grub la rol/ tshe 'gugs ni: hūm̐: snang mtha' rig 'dzin 'chi med tshe dpag med: thugs las sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro mgyogs ma 'bum: phyag na mda' dar tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: yang sprul mgyogs ma stong khams kheng bar 'phros: phyi nang snang srid snod bcud thams cad kyi: lha klu mi yi tshe bsod bcud bsdus la: skal ldan rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la bstim: tshe yi ril bu 'dod yon srid kyi mchog: 'chi med bdud rtsi 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu la gtad: hrīḥyig dmar po 'od zer ldan par bsgom: snying gi dbus su tshe yi gwa'u la: thim pas 'chi med rig 'dzin myur 'grub shog: om̐ a mi dhe wa ā yur+dz+nyā na ha ri ni sa sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes mda' dar g.yab cing tshe yi dngos grub la rol/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod dang bzod gsol ni: hūm̐: stong gsum chos dbyings snod mchog bhan+dha ru: phyi nang mchod pa spyan gzigs blo yis khengs: sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol mchod pa'i sprin: dug lnga rnam dag rol pa mchod pa'i tshogs: khrag 'thung khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kro ti shwa rī khrom̐ ga ru ṭa ya badz+ra puṣ+pe

sogs nas shab+da 'i bar mchod/ de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: don dam chos nyid longs sku khro tshul can: ma rungs log 'dren zil gnon g.yul las rgyal: che btsan rta mchog dbang gi rgyal po yi: lhun grub sku la brda rtags phyag 'tshal bstod: bstod par 'os pa sogs nas bstod par bgyi: bar bstod/ de nas bzod gsol ni/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs nas bzod par gsol: bar nas yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po rnams brjod: de nas brtan bzhugs bya/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs nas om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ bar brjod/ de nas bsrung bzlog bya ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang chen klu 'dul gsal ba yi: thugs kar hūm̐ yig mthing ga'i klong dkyil du: bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad tshud nas kyang : sngags phreng 'khor bas phyi nang 'khor yug kun: bskal pa'i me dpung dum bu gcig tu gyur: su yang bgrod du med pa'i rang bzhin gyur: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ kro ta tsa tur baṃ bh+yoḥ oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ṇi ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: de nas srung ba'i gur du tshud par bsams la de nas bzlog pa ni: hūm̐: mdun du khro rgyal klu 'dul sku smad ldan: zhabs gnyis 'og tu gnam lcags 'khor lo 'khor: de 'og zangs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug: bar du dgra bgegs pho mo'i bla gzugs bkug: bzlog pa'i sngags phreng drag tu 'dren pa'i tshe: las kyi rlung gis bskyod pas g.yas g.yon 'khor: phye mar btags te sha khrag dum bur gtub: dregs pa rnams kyi hab hab ljib ljib gsol: lhag ma rdul phran tsam yang med par gyur: om̐ badz+ra kro ta kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya: dgra bo byad ma nṛ tri trig nan gzer thum myag thum e hur thum ma ra ma ra bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces bsad 'khor rnams drag tu 'khor bas dgra bo dmigs med du btang bar bsams la sa ma ya:

khro rgyal stobs 'dus las so/ /'di yan dpe tshan bzhi'i zur 'gebs yin/ de nas bkra shis bya ba ni/ hūm̐: gar gyi dbang phyug khro rgyal kun gyi rjes: gdug pa'i g.yul 'joms nā ga klu 'dul ba'i: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog: de nas bkra shis gang mos brjod mthar dkyil 'khor bsdu rim ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor mi dmigs mtha' nas gtso bor bsdu: gtso bor yum bsdu hūm̐ thim chos dbyings a: a āḥ zhes dmigs med ngo bo nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin du gnas so/ /sa ma ya: bsngo ba ni: hoḥ mtha' yas ma gyur sems can 'khrul gzugs dbang : tshogs gny-is mthar phyin byang chub dge bar bsngo: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dal bzung tshe rabs su: pad 'byung mjal dang yi dam mi 'bral shog: ces bsngo smon rgyas par bya/ sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang zab snying gi sgrub pa las: dbang chen nā ga klu 'dul gyi: gcig dril myur zab sgrub pa bzhag: 'di nyid yon tan chog mi shes: lha srin dbang bsdus dregs pa bran: rgyal bsen ar gtad klu bdud 'joms: 'go nad lhog yams mdze shu 'dul: byad dang mtshon cha'i gdug pa bzlog: bsgrub na blo la yod pas chog: mang du spel chos ma yin la: mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis yi ger thob: rin chen gsang ba'i gter du sbos: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: gza' dang lha bdud rgya 'di srungs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas/ lcags khyi'i lor pad+ma sbas pa'i tshal bdud ri nag po rngam 'dra'i lung gi mdar dar sna pha wang rta mgo nas khrom gter du bgyis te/ glang lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyer lnga nyin gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bsgyur ba'o/ /gwa grwa karma o rgyan gyis gter gzhung tshig rkang zur 'gebs cung tsam bgyis pa'i ngos shog lags/
