sarba maṅga laṃ// // ga) rta mchog rol pa'i snying po las: hūm̐ sgrub yang gsang bzhugs so: dbang chen khro rgyal sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: hūm̐ sgrub yang gsang snying po bstan: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: spros med hūm̐ gi sgrub pa nyid: yang zab phrin las myur ba'i phyir: bse ru lta bur sgrub pa ste: 'khor 'das chos nyid ngang tshul la: yi ge hūm̐ gis spro bsdu bya: dran rdzogs dkyil 'khor 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snod bcud e yi klong : gdod nas zang thal drag po'i pho brang rdzogs: gru gsum me ri 'tshubs pa'i dbus nyid du: pad+ma nyi zla bam gyi gdan steng du: gnam lcags rdo rje me zer tshwa tshwa can: lte bar hūm̐ mtshan gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: dbang chen nā ga klu 'dul he ru kaḥ mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug khro gtum brjid: g.yas gsum ral gri dbyug to khyung khra 'dzin: g.yon gsum lcags kyu thod khrag sbrul zhags 'khyugs: dur khrod chas rdzogs sgro gshog mkha' la brgyangs: phag mo klu 'dul mthing nag sku la 'khril: rta dbu phag zhal hūm̐ bh+yo phaiṃ sgra ldir: zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum bskal pa'i me dpung klong : ba spu'i bu gar lcags sdig bya khyung 'phro: snang srid snod bcud drag po'i rang bzhin lha: skye med hūm̐ gi rang sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: hūm̐ las me zer tshwa tshwa 'phros pa yis: pha rol byad zor phur kha sreg cing gzhom: rgyal bsen klu dang sa bdag 'byung po rnams: dbang sdud zil gnon tshar gcod las grub gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes pa'i sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs shing rgyun du bzla bar bya: hūm̐ gi dbang bzhi blang ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen nā ga klu 'dul gyi: sku lnga hūm̐ gi rang sgra yis: skal ldan bdag la dbang bskur cig: byin 'bebs lha dang gnyis su med: gnas lngar hūm̐ gi dbang thob shog:

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes pa'i sgra dang bcas nas rta mgrin gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las hūm̐ lnga ldan gyi rnam par gyur nas: rang gi gnas lngar thim pas lus phyi nang khyab cing zang thal ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin du gyur par bsgom: sa ma ya: e ma kho bo pad+ma 'byung gnas gyis: spros med hūm̐ gi sgrub pa bzhag: ma 'ongs rjes 'jug dad ldan rnams: skye med sgrub pa 'di nyid ni: nyams su blang zhing bsgrubs pa rnams: klu srin 'byung pos mi tshugs shing : phur thogs stong la 'gras gyur kyang : byad kha rbod gtong mi 'byung ngo : de bas 'di rnams nyams su longs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos spo bo dar sna pha wang rta mgo nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bsgyur ba'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // nga) ༈ zur 'gebs srung dmigs ni:

hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang chen klu 'dul gsal ba yi: thugs kar hūm̐ y-ig mthing ga'i klong dkyil du: bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad tshud par bsgom: sngags phreng 'khor bas phyi nang 'khor yug kun: bskal pa'i me dpung dum bu gcig tu gyur: su yang bgrod du med pa'i rang bzhin bsgom: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ kro ta tsa tur hūm̐ bh+yoḥ om̐ khrom̐ ga ru ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas la srungs shig: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ṇi ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: ci 'grub bzlas mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying sogs lan gsum bzla/ om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kro ti shwa rī khrom̐ ga ru ṭa puṣ+pe sogs nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: gar gyi dbang phyug khro rgyal kun gyi rjes: gdug pa'i g.yul 'joms nā ga klu 'dul pa: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung bar phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas thun gtor 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: nā ga klu 'dul yab yum dbyings nas bzhengs: phyi nang phrin las rnam bzhi'i thugs dam bskul: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dbang bzhi mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ badz+ra bha ling+ta pū dza ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: yang gzhung gi mtshon srung la rtsa sngags kyi sham bur sngags 'di sbyar la/ om̐ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ ma ma rak+ṣa: ru tra ā yu dha ma tha ma tha: da ha da ha: rbad rbad: om̐ he he dza dzaḥhūm̐ hūm̐: mtshon bzlog: om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa pha rol byad ma'-i mtshon cha chom rmug rmug: pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha swā hā: ma ma ku ru ṇa rak+ṣa: zhes rgya khab la khri bzlas shing dar dmar skud pas dkris te 'chang na mtshon cha'i gnod pa las srung bar 'gyur ro: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sarba maṅga laṃ//

// ca) ༈ de nas bka' srung shan pa spun gsum gyi gtor sgrub kyi cha lag ni: rin chen snod gtsang nang du dkar gtor pad 'dab can g.yas su bdud gtor g.yas gcus g.yon du btsan gtor g.yon gcus: mtshams su mtheb skyus bskor bar bshams la: hūm̐: lha yi dge bsnyen drag po rtsal: bka' skyong lha yi dmag dpon ni: zhi ba'i cha lugs shrī ṭaḥ las kyi sde dpon dar mdung bsnams: ngang dkar rna sngon chibs su chibs: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri bsnams: lha dmag bswo sgra di ri ri: dge bsnyen dmag tshogs nyi li li: ma g.yel las mdzad bka' skyong rjes: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sgrub mchog bka' dang bstan pa skyong : phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: du las skyes pa'i srog bdud ngom gyi rje: hu lu'i sgra sgrogs dregs pa'i yang bo rje: char sprin mdog 'dra dgra satwa lcags kyu bsnams: khrab rmog phab la rnga zhol nag pos brgyan: bdud rta rlung gshog 'dzam gling skad cig nyul: drag rtsal myur mgyogs bdud po skra dkar gyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdud pho srog bdag nag po'i dus la bab: ra tsa du ru ka lang sha la bh+yoḥ phrin las nam mkha' gzi brjid thog ltar phob: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: tsa tri las mkhan shan pa srog bdag ni: me dpung mdog can bswe khrab rmog zhu gsol: stag ral gzig shubs btsan mdung zhags pa 'khyugs: ma rungs snying 'byin mche bas ma mchu mnan: bdud rta dmar zhur skad cig las la nyul: hur thum srog bdag shan pa dmar po'i tshogs: tha ma'i srog bdag ma lus 'khor bcas kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: hur thum nad kyis mtha' dmag srog dbugs sdud: las byed dmar po ma g.yel dgra srog chod: drag rtsal dus la bab po sa ma ya: om̐ dhe wa a du tsa tri: mā ra ya: tri ka ra dmigs bya'i sha khrag rnam pa lnga la kha kha khā hi:

zhes gter gzhung nas so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // cha) ༈ rta mchog rol pa'i snying po las: smad las dug rlangs nag po bzhugs so: dbang chen khro rgyal sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kho bo bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang bzlog zab mo dug rlangs nag po bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal ma brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: dang po bca' gzhi'i lag len ni: drag po'i snod dam gang rung du: nag po'i dal bcag ma traṃ bri: de steng chos 'byung bsnol mar bya: steng du rta mgrin yab yum gzugs: 'khor rnams lha grangs ci bzhin bskor: phyag rtsang nyer gcig dmar gyis brgyan: phyi rtsang drug cu rtsa gnyis te: legs par brgyan cing bha sus bcing : rtse mor khyung dang dar nag dbub: bsrung bzlog 'khor lo dag kyang 'dzugs: gzhan yang dar nag spyan gzigs dang : mthun rdzas la sogs gzhung bzhin bsham: phyi nang mchod pa tshang bar bya: las byang sngags la bskyal nas su: mdun gyi gtor mdos 'di ltar bskyed: mchod pa byin rlabs gang rung bya: hūm̐: mdun du e las pho brang ni: dur khrod rab rdzogs drag po'i dbyings: gru bzhi phyi nang mtshan nyid rdzogs: dmar chen rak+ta mtsho ltar 'khyil: bam ro gsar rnying ri ltar spungs: me rlung rang sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: thog ser bu yug sprin ltar gtibs: de dbus gnam lcags 'khor lo dang : nyi zla pad+ma 'bar ba'i gdan: bam ro smug po'i lte ba ru: lcags bsregs las grub rdo rje ni: rtse dgu lte ba hūm̐ sgra can: sogs nas sngags la bskyal: de nas tshogs la 'jug par bya mchan/ bskang ba bshags pa yan 'don nas smad las la 'jug pa la/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ gtor mdos bran zhing gso rol mo drag tu bsgrags la: hūm̐: mthing nag me ri 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: khro rgyal nā ga klu 'dul skur bzhengs shig:

yum mchog khro mo mthing nag skur bzhengs shig: za byed ḍāk+ki rigs bzhi skur bzhengs shig: 'joms byed bya khyung dmag tshogs skur bzhengs shig: yang sprul phag dang sdig rgod skur bzhengs shig: bka' gter rgyud kyi srung ma skur bzhengs shig: zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i klong nas bzhengs: 'dod chags khrag mtsho 'khyil ba'i klong nas bzhengs: gti mug mun ltar 'thibs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: nga rgyal ri ltar nyil ba'i klong nas bzhengs: phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshubs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: hūm̐: mthing nag stobs ldan khro rgyal mthu bo che: rta skad drag po phyogs bcur lhangs se lhang : dbu skra dmar nag me ri wa la la: phyag drug mtshon gyis stong gsum ru tra bsgral: dur khrod chas rdzogs khro bcu'i dmag dpung sdud: zhabs bzhi gyad kyis gling bzhi'i 'byung po sngangs: stobs ldan pho rgyud khro tshogs dmag dpung 'gyed: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i klu srin rgyal 'gong bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: klu 'dul khro mo mthing nag rngam pa mo: spyi bor phag zhal phaiṃ sgra di ri ri: dbu skra dmar nag sprin ltar thibs se thib: phyag gnyis rno dbal mtshon cha dgra la ya: dur khrod chas rdzogs ma sring las la 'gyed: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril sras mchog khro chung spro: yum mchog ma rgyud khro mo'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs sa bdag 'byung po bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rigs bzhi'i khro mo khrag 'thung rngam stabs can: za gsod dbugs la rngam pa'i sha za mo: dmar ser ral g.yeng tshwa tshwa si li li: dur khrod chas ldan phra men sha ra ra: drag rtsal myur mgyogs gar sgyur lings se ling : srid gsum ma mo sha za'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: snang srid ban bon byad kha dgra la zlog: hūm̐: sprul pa'i mkha' lding bya khyung ga ru ṭas:

krang kring sgra sgrogs klu srin sa bdag 'joms: me gshog rdeb cing dam sri'i snying khrag 'thung : sder mchu bgrad cing dal yams rtsad nas gcod: 'joms byed nag po bya khyung dmag tshogs bskyed: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mdze nad zha grum lhog yams rims nad zlog: hūm̐: yang sprul za byed gnam lcags sdig pa ni: kha dgu mig dgu khro chung si li li: rgyal bsen dam sri'i snying khrag 'jib la shog: yan lag rnams ni lcags kyu springs se spring : klu gnyan sa bdag bla srog drongs la shog: klu 'dul lcags sd-ig sa gzhi bar snang gang : sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pho 'dre mo 'dre bla tshe phrol la shog: sa sri gdug pa'i dug mda' bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: yang sprul phag rgod ngar sgra di ri ri: dug gi mche ba sa bdag snying la thob: gnam lcags ngar sgras klu srin gting nas choms: kha rlangs dug zor dgra la brgyal ring thongs: dug gi phag rgod dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phung sri'i kha yog ngan sems bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: bka' yi bstan srung chen po mthu rtsal can: ki kang nag pos thog 'bebs ljang nag zhal: lha btsan 'bar ba dpa' bo seng zhal can: bdud rje nag po dge bsnyen lag brgyad pa: dam nyams dgra la rbad bskul rtsal ma zhan: yang sprul pho nya las mkhan bye ba 'bum: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad ma bdud rigs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig khro rgyal 'bar ba'i tshogs: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: drag po mthu yi gzi byin yar la bskyed: dam nyams dgra la las kyi dmag dpung drongs: dgra bo'i yul khang srung skyob rten dang phrol: rbad pa'i dam can srung ma mthu ma chung : deng 'dir bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: khro bo'i dmag tshogs bskul nas bzlog bsgyur gyi las mdzad par bsam:

sa ma ya: de nas liṅga bsgral ba ni: thun rdzas sogs tshang bar bsags la/ rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul gyi smad las zur 'gebs ni/ gser skyems gzu dpang gsal bar bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rig 'dzin lhas: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes brtse gzigs shig: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: yi dam che mchog phyi nang gsang ba'i lha: mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can srung ma rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: dam can gter srung las kyi rdzu 'phrul can: drag rtsal 'chang ba'i myur mgyogs pho nya rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: ma 'ongs mkhyen gsol dgra la bka' chad phob: sdang zhing gdug pa'i byad ma dgra bo 'di: yi dam lha yis mgon skyabs ma mdzad par: bka' yi chad pa le lan drag por phob: deng 'dir 'gugs nas bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ sarba pañtsa pū dza khā hi: de nas khro rgyal stobs kyi phur bu thogs nas: hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang bcas te: rang nyid ting 'dzin khros pa'i nga rgyal gyis: hūm̐: bdag nyid khro rgyal nā ga klu 'dul sku: srid pa kun tu che btsan 'gran zla bral: sku mdog mthing nag stong khams me 'od 'khrugs: zhal gsum khro bas ye shes 'jig rten sngangs: spyan dgu bgrad pas sa gsum 'dar zhing khol: phyag drug 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: dur khrod chas bcus bgegs dpung sa la 'gyel: mi bzad sgro gshog 'bar bas bdud dpung 'joms: zhabs bzhi gyad kyis gling bzhi dor thabs brdzis: phyag gi mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: gnam lcags thog dang ser ba char du 'bebs:

byad ma dgra bo bsgral ba'i rang bzhin gyur: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa baṃ bha ra hi: badz+ra kī li kī la ya a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sarba bigh+nān hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces nyer gcig gam bdun phrag tsam bzlas shing : dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad bsgral ba'i las la chas par bsams la: de nas mdun du hom̐ bskyed pa ni: phaṭḥ mdun du kaṃ dmar nag las gyur pa'i lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po kha dog la mthil yangs pa: zin na thar pa med pa'i nang du dam nyams dgra bo byad ma gnod byed skye mched rdzogs pa nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gyur: de nas 'gugs gzhug bya ba ni: na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par dbang chen nā ga klu 'dul yab yum gyi bka' bden pa dang : khro rgyal sprul pa'i khyung chen khrag 'thung sha za rigs bzhi bya khyung sprul pa'i dmag tshogs yang sprul phag sdig khyung gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang : gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi lha tshogs bka' srung dregs pa gter bdag las kyi pho nya bye ba 'bum gyi bka' bden pa dang : chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spy-i dgra: rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra: nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas: gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra: gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs: bar du gcod pa'i rkyen: khyad par ban bon sngags pa'i mthu zor byad kha khram kha rtsis rgyan shwa kha 'debs pa'i sde brgyad 'byung po: khyad par nad bdag yams bdag god sri dbul sri rkyen chag glo bur langs pa che sri chung sri dar sri rgan sri gzhon sri lo skag zla skag zhag skag dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad:

mi rung than ltas sna dgu: cho 'phrul rmi lam ngan pa: mi mthun dgra gshed: phung gyod la sogs pa mdor na gnod par byed pa gang yin pa thams cad skad cig rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga la khug cig: om̐ badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ rat+na pā sha hūm̐: pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyis 'gug cing bstim: gzhung gi pho nya 'gyed pa ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa'i sras: gza' rgod ki kang mthu bo che: lha bdud dge bsnyen shan pa'i tshogs: rang 'dra'i pho nya bye ba 'bum: rbad do dgra bgegs khug la shog: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang ba dang : rnal 'byor bdag la 'tshe ba yi: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gar gnas kyang : rang dbang med par khug la shog: ma btang ma btang shor ra re: da lta nyid du khug la shog: rbad pa'i pho nya mthu ma chung : om̐ hri rā hu la ki kang bh+yo bh+yo dhe wa kha ri pa tsa dgra bo dza dzaḥ zhes 'gugs/ dgra bo lha dang dbye ba ni: bya rog dang 'ug pa'i sgro thogs nas: hūm̐: khā kha mu kha bya rog gdong : phyag na spu gri dmar po bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo lha dang phyes: srung skyob mgon byed bral bar gyis: hūm̐: hu lu mu kha 'ug pa'i gdong : phyag na rlung gi 'khor lo 'dzin: dam nyams dgra bo bdud dang sprod: bcing zhing byad du bcug par gyis: hūm̐: khā kha mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: rbad chod rmug thum myog gtub thun bh+yoḥ om̐ hu lu mu kha dgra bo ching thum ril trig nan satwaṃ bha ya nan:

zhes thun gyis brdeg cing dgra bo lha dang dbye: de nas phur bu thogs la: hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa'i sras: gtum chen klu 'dul kā+-i la ya'i: phyag gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rgya mdud 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: bsrung phyir sked par lan gsum bskor: 'chang bzung glog dmar khyugs se khyug: bzlog phyir mdun du lan gsum bskor: chu srin ser ba chi li li: pho rgyud zil gnon g.yas su bsgril: zur gsum thog rgod sha ra ra: mo rgyud zil gnon g.yon du bsgril: rtse mo tshwa tshwa si li li: bsgral phyir dam nyams snying la ya: gdab bo badz+ra kī la ya: dkar nag snying gi rtsa chod la: myur du bsgral ba'-i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra kī la ya: gnod byed 'byung po tshal shag gtub mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces bsgral zhing rnam shes spar: bsgral ba'i rnam shes āḥyig dkar por gyur nas 'og min zhing du phaṭḥ ces 'og min zhing du 'phang : de nas thun rdzas btab cing gtub pa ni: hūm̐: khro bo'i nyungs thun shwa rī raṃ: dug thun bu yug chi li li: me thun dmar nag lhabs se lhab: khrag thun nad rlangs thibs se thib: rdzas thun tshwa tshwa si li li: rdo thun zi ra khyugs se khyug: mtshe thun las rlung 'u ru ru: rdo rje'i thog mda' sha ra ra: phur thun drag po hri li li: ral gri mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: dgra bgegs lnga phung 'dus byas shigs: gtub cing phye mar tshal par thongs: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po'i sha khrag rus pa la rbad rbad: phyags thum tshal pa tshal pa ya shig shig: de nas gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung dbang gi rgyal: nā ga klu 'dul lha tshogs kyi: zhal phyes dgra bo'i sha khrag 'bul: dug gsum skye med dbyings su rol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: zhes sman raka gis bran zhing sha khrag 'bul:

de nas rtsang phur rak+tas bran zhing : hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: pho nya rtsang gi lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: las mkhan shan pas bzlog bsgyur dus la bab: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: rno dbal zhe sdang drag po'i gtsang phur 'di: chos skyong dam can pho nya tshogs pa'i gling : che chung tshad ni ri rab 'bar ba tsam: mang nyung tshad ni bskal pa'i bye ma tsam: mtho dman tshad ni srid gsum dbyings dang mnyam: rno ngar tshad ni bdun 'gyur chu gri tsam: myur mgyogs tshad ni ki kang 'gyu ba'i shugs: nus rtsal tshad ni stong khams 'jig rten bshig: gtum drag tshad ni gsod byed gshin rje rngam: rtse mor hūm̐ las me ri wa la la: sked par bh+yo yig dam can tshogs pa'i gling : rtsa bar dza y-ig mun nag thibs se thib: las kyi pho nya rngam pa'i rtsang phur khyod: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: dam nyams gdug pa'i snying la da thob cig: pha rol byad kha rbod gtong rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: rtse mor bya khyung gshog sgra 'u ru ru: sked par lcags sdig skan sgra thags se thag: rtsa bar dug phag ngar sgra 'u ru ru: yang sprul pho nya dmod pa'i rtsang phur khyod: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: dam nyams gdug pa'i snying la da thob cig: sa bdag klu yi dug mda' bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtse mor ki kang khyab 'jug nag po rgyu: sked par lha btsan dmag tshogs thibs se thib: rtsa bar dge bsnyen dgra 'dzin khyugs se khyug: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: dam nyams gdug pa'i snying la da thob cig: log bsgyur mi kha gleng gzhi bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: lha srin 'khrugs pa'i cho 'phrul zlog: gza' dang rgyal byin bar chad zlog: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs zlog: phyi nang bar chad dgra la zlog: bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog rbad myog shag thum baṃ ril mā ra ya zlog zlog: ces bzlog pa bya zhing phrin las bcol: de nas gtor mdos sha khrag gis bran gso zhing khro tshogs rnams kyis bzlog pa'i las mdzad par bsam zhing : rol mo dang bcas nas: bzlog brgya bsog na zur 'gebs ni: hūm̐: mdun du tha ma'i liṅga la: dmigs bya dgra bgegs myur du khug: sras mchog badz+ra kī la yas: bsgral zhing gtub pa'i dus la bab: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya rbad rbad: gzhung gi bzlog pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i pho brang nas: snang srid dbang bsgyur nag po klu 'dul ba'i: 'jigs byed chen po'i lha tshogs dby-ings nas bzhengs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dmag gi dpung bskyed bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: khro rgyal stobs 'dus mth-ing nag he ru kaḥ rta dbu rigs gsum rta skad drag po yis: sku gsum sgrib pa'i nyon mongs dgra la zlog: dbu skra dmar ser sprin ltar gtibs pa yis: srid pa gsum gyi cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: thod skam 'bar ba'i prog zhus brgyan pa yis: yi dam lha yi bka' chad dgra la zlog: dmar nag dar gyi cod pan 'phur ba yis: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i sun ma dgra la zlog: dug sbrul nag pos dbu skra bcings pa yis: steng phyogs gza' nad sna dgu dgra la zlog: g.yas zhal dkar po khro la dgyes pa yis: khro bo'i drag sngags sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: g.yon zhal dmar nag rngam la gshe ba yis: khro mo'i gzungs sngags sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: dbus zhal mthing nag gtum la gshe ba yis: 'chi bdag las kyi pho nya dgra la zlog: spyan dgu sdang mig phyogs bcur 'khyil ba yis: mu stegs gdug pa'i g.yul ngo dgra la zlog: drag po'i shangs nas thal rlung 'bud pa yis: 'byung bzhi'i tshe yi bar chad dgra la zlog: snyan nas chos nyid 'brug sgra ldir ba yis:

pha rol gdug pa'i bsam sbyor dgra la zlog: mche ba dkar po zur gsum gtsigs pa yis: lo zla dus kyi chad pa dgra la zlog: zhal gdang ljags dmar 'dril zhing bskyod pa yis: sgrub la tshe yi bar chad dgra la zlog: sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar ba yis: snang srid las kyi g.yo 'khrug dgra la zlog: dpral bar thal chen tshom bus brgyan pa yis: rtsa rlung lam gyi bar chad dgra la zlog: phyag g.yas dang pos ral gri phyar ba yis: byad kha gdug pa'i dmag tshogs dgra la zlog: bar pas dbyug tho 'bar ba 'dzin pa yis: dam sri 'gong po'i bar chad dgra la zlog: tha mas bya khyung khra bo 'gyed pa yis: gdug pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag dgra la zlog: g.yon pa dang pos lcags kyu gdeng ba yis: mkha' la 'gyu ba'i yams rims dgra la zlog: bar pa'i bhan+dha dmar gyis bkang ba yis: khrag nad dmar yams rgyug 'gyel dgra la zlog: tha mas sbrul gyi zhags pa 'khyugs pa yis: gson 'dre nag mo'i bar chad dgra la zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la brgyangs pa yis: lha dang lha min bar chad dgra la zlog: glang ko zhing lpags seṅge'i stod g.yogs kyis: bdud dang gshin rje'i khram kha dgra la zlog: khrag zhag thig le tshom bus brgyan pa yis: btsan dang ma mo'i 'tshe ba dgra la zlog: sbrul rigs lnga yis yan lag brgyan pa yis: klu dang gshin rje'i bar chad dgra la zlog: rus pa'i rgyan ldan thod phreng ga shal gyis: gza' dang rgyal po'i bar chad dgra la zlog: nga rgyal stag gi sham thabs ldan pa yis: gnam thel bar thel sa thel dgra la zlog: zhabs bzhi gyad kyis bya khyung brdzis pa yis: snang srid yongs kyi zil gnon dgra la zlog: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog phag mo klu 'dul ma: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis mtshon cha bsnams: spyi bor phag zhal ngur sgra sgrog pa yis: byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad dgra la zlog: dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba yis: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad dgra la zlog:

thod skam rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa yis: phyi nang rten 'brel nyams pa dgra la zlog: sma ra 'bar zhing cod pan 'phyangs pa yis: srid pa ma mo'i cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: phyag g.yas gri gug sbrul zhags 'dzin pa yis: dri za grul bum bar chad dgra la zlog: phyag g.yon bhan dmar lcags sdig 'dzin pa yis: me lha gshin rje'i bar chad dgra la zlog: yan lag lhu tshigs sbrul gyis brgyan pa yis: srin po klu dang bar chad dgra la zlog: rus pa'i rgyan drug g.yer kha ldan pa yis: rlung lha dbang ldan bar chad dgra la zlog: sku smad gzi brjid sham thabs dkris pa yis: bgegs dang 'byung po'i bar chad dgra la zlog: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum yab la 'khril ba yis: rtsa rlung thig le'i bar chad dgra la zlog: yab yum me ri'i klong du bzhugs pa yis: phyi nang rkyen skag bar chad dgra la zlog: hūm̐: khro mo badz+ra bha ra hīs: mdze nad lhog rgod dgra la zlog: khro mo rat+na bha ra hīs: dmar bshal kre kre dgra la zlog: khro mo pad+ma bha ra hīs: 'brum bu dkar nag dgra la zlog: khro mo karma bha ra hīs: srin glang tar tar dgra la zlog: thams cad khro zhing rngam pa yis: khrag skyug sbos 'gas dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas dang ldan pa yis: zha grum gcong nad dgra la zlog: phyag na mtshon cha 'dzin pa yis: rims yams mgo nad dgra la zlog: gcer mo brkyang bskum ldan pa yis: sa bdag klu yi dug mda' zlog: me ri dmar nag 'bar ba yis: ban bon byad kha dgra la zlog: hūm̐: sprul pa'i lcags sdig mgo dgu yis: rgyal 'gong dam sri'i bar chad zlog: dug gi phag rgod nag po yis: 'og gi sa srin dgra la zlog: rngam byed bya khyung rigs lnga yis: nad rims dal yams dgra la zlog: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs rnams kyis: phyi nang rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ khroṃ kro ta tri khroṃ ga ru ṭaḥ

mā ra shag ya a mu ka tu ṭa nā ga ra tsa ya du bzlog bzlog bh+yo bh+yo rbad rbad: ces zlog sngags rnams bzlas shing dmigs pa bya: de nas khyung bzlog ni: hūm̐: srid pa'i ri rab 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas: khro rgyal sprul pa'i bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: hūm̐: rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la: gzhan gyis bsam sbyor gdug sems sdang ba dang : tshe zor nyungs zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: gnam nas dal kha 'bebs pa dgra la zlog: sa nas dug mda' langs pa dgra la zlog: bar nas gri btsan brgyugs pa dgra la zlog: phyogs nas ma mo'i nad yams dgra la zlog: bar snang 'byung po'i thod zor dgra la zlog: gling bzhi'i skye bo'i mtshon zor dgra la zlog: nag mo yugs sa'i thal zor dgra la zlog: ban bon sngags pa'i hom̐ sbar dgra la zlog: mnan bsad gtad cing gzir ba dgra la zlog: zhang zhung bon gyi mthu zor dgra la zlog: rigs ngan shan pa'i dmod pa dgra la zlog: rgyal po'i bka' yi chad pa dgra la zlog: yul mi'i nang tshan 'bu bshu dgra la zlog: brda than ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la zlog: 'dab chags sder chags ltas ngan dgra la zlog: god kha phung gyod kha mchu dgra la zlog: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs dgra la zlog: phyi nang bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ gri khroṃ ya bh+yoḥ dza gri ya bh+yoḥ nye lo thun ya bh+yoḥ ra mo sha ya bh+yoḥ ni lo sha ya bh+yoḥ rbad tri kha thun nag po dgra la bh+yoḥ zhes zlog sngags gang mang bzla: de nas srung sngags kyang skabs 'dir sbyar rung : sa ma ya: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badz+ra kro ti tsa tur bh+yoḥ om̐ ga ru ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ṇi ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes srung ba'i las rim ltar bsgoms pas 'thus:

sa ma ya: de nas gser skyems gtong ba ni: dang po phyi ru gser skyems sbrengs nas dar nag sogs gzengs shing mthu chas zhugs: khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis: hūm̐: phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: yi dam che mchog phyi nang gsang ba'i lha: mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong srung ma rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: dam can gter srung las kyi rdzu 'phrul can: drag rtsal 'chang ba'i myur mgyogs pho nya rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: lha srin sde brgyad gzhi bdag drag rtsal can: mkha' la 'gyu zhing gdong la gnas pa dang : lo zla zhag dus chu tshod dbang ba'i lha: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring drag po'i gtor ma'i zor lam phyes: gdong du ma sdod g.yas g.yon sku bzur cig: ma rungs dam nyams dgra la zor sna drongs: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas sgo ma bzhir mchod cing sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐ dzaḥ shar phyogs sgo ma lcags kyu ma: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang shar sgo phyes: dmag dpung bskyed cing bzhes su gsol: hūm̐ hūm̐: lho phyogs sgo ma zhags pa ma: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang lho sgo phyes: dmag dpung bskyed cing bzhes su gsol: hūm̐ baṃ: nub phyogs sgo ma lcags sgrog ma: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang nub sgo phyes:

dmag dpung bskyed cing bzhes su gsol: hūm̐ hoḥ byang phyogs sgo ma zhags pa ma: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang byang sgo phyes: dmag dpung bskyed cing bzhes su gsol: de nas sgo phye zhing btegs: de nas zor bskul ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba rig 'dzin srung ma rnams: mi mngon thugs rje'i klong nas bzhengs: dmag dpung bskyed phyir ru mtshon phyor: rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: zor sna sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: ma mo mched bzhi'i dus la bab: chos skyong dam can dus la bab: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces yi dam pho rgyud mo rgyud chos skyong dang bcas pas bdag gi grogs mdzad par bsam zhing : 'gugs gzhug byed nas 'dir 'jug: de nas khro mo rigs bzhi'i zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ u tsa la yi gnas srung ma: las kyi sha za ma mo bzhis: phyag na gdug pa'i zor mda' thogs: dam nyams dgra la rbad pa'i tshe: srin mo srog len 'bum gyis bskor: khrag gi ral pa sha ra ra: mi lpags g.yang gzhi shams se sham: nad yams bu yug chi li li: bzlog bsad 'khor lo chi li li: dgra bo'i srog len khyugs se khyug: zor thun dbal kha tshubs se tshub: zor zor dam nyams dgra la ya: bh+yo bh+yo ma mos zor sna drongs: chod cig dgra srog myur du chod: rbad do sha za mthu ma chung : thob cig mtshon zor dgra la ya: nad kyi zor mda' dgra la ya: myur du dgra srog chod la shog: om̐ tri tsa tur mu kha ma tri ya ma du ru dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog:

ces 'phang ngo : de nas mda' zor thogs la: hūm̐: gzhu mo lha btsan rdo rje 'bar: gzhu breng bdud sde nag po ste: mda' mo gnyis med rā hu la: ki kang mkha' la 'gyu ba ltar: dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya: om̐ dā+e wa du pra ma ki kang ha la dun+tsa dgra la bh+yo bh+yoḥ de nas zor chen thogs la: hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal he ru kaḥ rta mchog nā ga klu 'dul sku: nga las che ba su yang med: ye shes 'jig rten zil gyis gnon: bka' skyong srung ma las la rbad: dgra la zor kha rbad pa'i tshe: stong gsum g.yo 'gul shigs se shig: gnam lcags ser ba hri li l̥: nad kyi na bun thibs se thib: las kyi rlung dmar 'u ru ru: gshin rje'i khram kha tshubs se tshub: shan pa'i bla 'gugs khyugs se khyug: dgra la zor 'debs sha ra ra: ngan sngags 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: las mkhan mtshon thogs rongs se rong : rbad do bzlog med las kyi zor: dgra bo'i pho rgyud rtsad nas chod: mo rgyud rnams kyi mngal rnams skoms: chung rgyud byis pa'i sha la zo: dgra bo'i sgo nor phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i yul mkhar rlung la bskur: lo zla zhag dus ma 'gyang bar: za ma chu tshod da lta nyid: myur du sgrol zhing mgo snying phrol: srog rtsa dmar po chod la shog: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyis: dgra la zor gyi sna drongs shig: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: om̐ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ gardza rbad thun ya: dgra bo'i srog rtsa snying rtsa la rbad rbad: kham kham lam lam myog myog gtub gtub: bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces 'phang zhing zor dmigs drag po bya: de nas dgongs gsol ni: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: gzigs su gsol: 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: zhi khro 'dus pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: khro rgyal nā ga klu 'dul yab yum dgongs su gsol lo: bka' dang dam tshig las kyi pho brang chen po nas:

khrag 'thung sha za rigs bzhis gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo: sku gsum sprul pa'i gnas mchog chen po nas: bya khyung sprul pa'i dmag tshogs bka' gter gyi srung ma rnams dgongs su gsol lo: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi dkyil 'khor gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo: deng 'dir legs nyes gzu yi dpang po mdzod cig: hoḥ zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: mtho gong du brgal zhing dma' 'bebs par byed pa: rnal 'byor bdag la tshad btsugs shing ya bo 'dzin pa: snga dgra yid la bsam zhing : da dgra thad du langs pa: dmag sna jag sna ston pa: rku 'phrog bcom zhing sgug pa: ngo log rgyab ston byed pa: bka' dang dam las 'gal ba la sogs pa: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byed pa: brnag pa'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di: lo zla zhag las ma 'da' bar: drag po bka' yi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes shig: gsol zhig: rol cig lhag ma rjes shul tsam yang med pa'i phrin las mdzod c-ig: dam nyams dgra la bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog rbad rbad shag mā ra ya gum gum chings chings nan nan: zhes dar nag g.yab cing phrin las bcol: dgra bo byad ma rim dgu'i sa 'og tu mgo mjug ldog par bsams nas: gtor ma me hom du bsreg pa'am chu la bskur: de nas brtan ma skyong nas rta bro bya: gtor gzhong 'og tu dam sri lan gsum 'gugs phyag rgya bsnol ma lu gu rgyud kyis bro brdung : dmag dpon khyung nag 'dre rgod sgab 'dre gcod: de nas mda' dar tshe ril tshe chang sogs rgyas par bya zhing gral du 'khod nas: hūm̐: snang mtha' rig 'dzin 'chi med tshe yi bdag: thugs las sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro mgyogs ma 'bum: phyag na mda' dar tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: yang sprul mgyogs ma stong khams kheng bar 'phros: phyi nang snang srid snod bcud thams cad kyi: lha klu mi yi tshe bsod bcud bsdus la:

skal ldan rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: tshe yi ril bu 'dod yon srid kyi mchog: 'chi med bdud rtsi 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i rdzas: de ring skal ldan rigs kyi bu la gtad: hrīḥyig dmar po 'od zer ldan par bsgom: snying gi dbus su tshe yi gwa'u la: thim pas 'chi med rig 'dzin myur 'grub shog: om̐ a mi dhe wa ā yur+dz+nyā na ha ri ni sa sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes tshe yi dngos grub rol zhing bkra shis brjod par bya: hūm̐: gar gyi dbang phyug khro rgyal kun gyi rje: sogs bkra shis brjod: de nas bsngo smon bya zhing gtang rag sogs rgyas par bya: legs tshogs dge ba'i ngang la bzhag: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ kho bo bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang bzlog zab khyad dug rlangs nag po bzhag: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: steng 'og lha srin 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs las: 'go nad sna dgu sa bdag klu srin dang : rgyal bsen 'byung pos bar chad sdang ba'i tshe: las mtha' bzlog pa 'di nyid shin tu zab: 'di nyid bsnyen tshad grub rtags ma thon na: shin tu bka' gnyan gsang zhing spyod par gces: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas pad+ma sbas tshal bdud ri rngam 'dra'i lung g-i zhol dar sna pha wang rta mgo nas khrom gter du bgyis te gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bsgyur ba'o/ gwa grwa bla chung gis zur 'gebs kha skong cung zad bcas 'don chog tu bgyis pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ka) dpal chen dregs zil gyi gsol 'debs ni/ e ma ho/ gnas mchog lcang lo can gyi pho brang du/ /sangs rgyas thugs kyi sprul pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /dpal chen phyag na rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /steng 'og phyogs bzhir thugs kyis 'gro don mdzad/

/ye shes sprul pa'i bya khyung la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang 'dul der ston thog med rtsal shugs 'chang*/ 'jigs mdzad rā hu la la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyi/ /gnas skabs 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /mthar thug don gnyis 'bad med yid bzhin 'grub/ /gsang ba'i bdag po nyid dang dbyer med shog / ces gsang bdag dregs pa zil gnon gyi cha lag tu 'di bzhin dgos zhes 'phan bla'i ngor sgo blas so// // kha) ༈ dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las: las byang gnam lcags rdo rje'i go cha bzhugs so: bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang dpal chen gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po g.yul las rgyal byed sgrub par byed pa la: thog mar bsgrub pa'i dal du 'jug cing : nyams len thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bcas kyi phyi nang nyer spyod 'khod par bya: mchod pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi spyi mthun nyer mkho bsham: de nas bsgrub pa'i dal du 'jug pa ni: thog mar: na mo: dpal chen kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: sgo gsum rtsol bral ngang gis skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa: hoḥ ma gyur 'gro ba srid bsdus kun gyi ched: bdag gis dpal chen bsgrubs nas go 'phang dgod: gsum pa: hūm̐: bdag nyid gsang bdag 'bar ba'i pho nya y-i: bden pas gnod byed gtor ma len phyir khug: om̐ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ gnod byed bgegs tshogs aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ bzhi pa ni: hūm̐: bgegs rnams mchod sbyin gtor mas tshims shing bzhud: bar chod glags lta u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje'i gur khang bla bre phyi nang 'khrigs: log 'dren bgegs kyis rgyu ba mtshams chod cig: badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: drug pa ni: hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid kyi tshogs: sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs mchod pa bla med gyur:

om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta om̐ āḥhūm̐: dang po: hūm̐: dang por chos rnams dmigs su med: bar du 'gags med rtsal snang las: tha mar sna tshogs sprul skur sgrub: de las yig 'bru phun sum tshogs: om̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ suṃ keṃ bh+rūm̐: 'byung ba yongs gyur gzhal yas khang : sgo gru mu mtha' tshang ba'i dbus: lha srin sde brgyad khri steng du: pad+ma nyi zla'i steng dbus su: hūm̐ las skyes pa'i dpal chen sku: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo gri: g.yon gsum khyung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: gtum gshe rngam rgod tshul du gsal: spyi bor thugs kyi bya khyung lding : mdun du gza' mchog glog dmar 'khyugs: ye shes me dpung klong du gsal: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros 'og min phyogs bcu nas: dpal chen lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: gnyis pa: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang dang : lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: gtum chen khro rgyal gshegs su gsol: ri rab 'bar ba'i dbus nyid nas: mkha' lding 'bar ba gshegs su gsol: nam mkha'i dbyings kyi 'od klong nas: ki kang gza' mchog gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas pho brang dbus su bzhugs: sku gsum lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ gnyis pa mchod pa ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod gar ma lang ling tshogs kyis mchod: gsang mchod gzugs mdzes dpag med gtibs pas mchod: sbyor mchod zag med bde ba dgyes pas mchod: sman mchod dza gad gser skyems phud kyis mchod: gtor mchod ba liṃ rgyan rdzogs bcud kyis mchod: rak+ta dgyes pa chags med mdangs ldan mchod: bsgral mchod nyon mongs ye sgrol shes par mchod: mnyam bzhag rang bzhin rdzogs chen kho na'i mchod:

mchod yul sbyin mkhan bla med ngo bor mchod: gsang bdag gtum por kun gzhi 'gyur med mchod: bya khyung rgyal por gsal stong 'gags med mchod: gza' mchog rgyal por tshogs drug lhug bzhag mchod: kun kyang chos dbyings ye shes chen po yi: rtsol bral rin chen mchod pas dgyes gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na kha kha khā hi: om̐ sarba dharma dz+nyā na pañtsa om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsum pa bstod pa ni: hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos dpal chen zil gnon khro: bdud las rab rgyal dregs pa'i rje bo ni: sku mdog mthing nag chos sku 'gyur ba med: dkar dmar mthing bzhad dgyes pa'i khro bo yi: rab 'jigs zhal nas hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: spyan rtsa sdang mig 'khyil bas srid gsum sngangs: dbu skra gyen brdzes lha khams yom zhing 'gul: thod skam dbu rgyan rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs: cod pan spras pas zhing khams rgyan 'phyangs rdzogs: phyag g.yas rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo yis: snang srid lha srin zil gyis gnon par byed: phyag g.yon khyung khra kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul zhags kyis: srid gsum gdon bgegs 'byung po 'joms par byed: rdo rje'i sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs pa yis: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha zlog par byed: glang ko'i zhing lpags stag sham brjid pa yis: bdud srin dam sri 'gong po 'dul bar byed: rdo rje'i go ldan rus rgyan chu srin gyis: nyon mongs 'khrul 'dzin rtsad nas gcod par byed: sbrul gzugs rgyan phreng rin chen spras pa yis: 'khor 'das rtog pa zil gyis gnon par byed: zhabs bzhis lha srin steng du 'gyings pa yis: che btsan kun gyi nus pa zil gyis gnon: sku la dus mtha'i me dpung 'bar ba yis: stong khams g.yo zhing khyab pa'i gzi brjid mched:

bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon sku la bstod: hūm̐: spyi bor thugs kyi sprul pa ga ru ṭa'iḥ gnam lcags rwa la rdo rje'i mchu sder bgrad: ma rungs klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul bar byed: me gshog rdeb cing gser mig 'khyil ba yis: dregs pa yongs kyi cho 'phrul zlog par byed: dug sbrul gsol zhing gdol pa 'dzin pa yis: ma rungs bdud srin rtsad nas 'joms par byed: bya khyung 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dzaḥ snang srid dbu ma'i dbyings kyi las byed pa: stong khams 'di ru drag rtsal ldan pa yi: lho nub gnas pa'i ki kang dmar 'od can: pha ni srin po ma ni 'dod chags klu: klu bdud bshos pa rlung khams dud kha'i mdangs: dbu dgus theg pa rim dgu'i bstan pa srung : spyi bor bya rog bstan pa'i bya ra byed: phyag g.yas ral gri gnam lcags thog mda' yis: ma rungs gdug pa'i snying la 'debs par byed: phyag g.yon cod pan sbrul nag zhags pa yis: bdag la sdang ba'i byad ma 'ching bar byed: sku lus thams cad mig gis gang ba yis: dregs pa kun gyi gzi brjid 'phrog par byed: lto bar srid pa las kyi zhal gdangs pas: nyon mongs 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem par byed: sbrul mjug rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khyil ba yis: 'byung ba las kyi mnga' dbang bsgyur bar byed: rdzu 'phrul gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs pa yis: bdud sde'i tshogs la mtshon cha'i thog chen 'bebs: gsang sngags bstan pa'i srung mar bdag bstod do: bsnyen dmigs ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid gtum po'i thugs ka ru: gser gyi mchod rten ser po'i dbus: me long nyi zla 'khor lo'i steng : hūm̐ mthing tshwa tshwa 'phros pa'i mthar: rtsa sngags g.yas su 'khor ba yis: lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bsregs: yar 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mchod: mar 'phros stong gsum dgra bgegs bcom: tshur 'dus gzi byin 'bar bar gyur: gtum chen sngags phreng ni:

om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ khyung sngags ni: om̐ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ khyab 'jug sngags ni: om̐ ki kang hrī rā hu la ke sha ke ta hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ drag sngags bcu tsho re la: khyung sngags brgya phrag re khyab 'jug lnga bcu tsam bzla: gzhung gi bsnyen sgrub ji ltar bya rung : khyad par lha srin sde brgyad kyis 'khu na drag sngags rang bzlas kyang mthun: rgyun gyi thams cad spros med lugs ltar bsgrubs kyang rung : zhogs par las byang tshar gcig bskyed rim gsal gdab: nyin mo hūm̐ sgrub bcas ci lcogs bya: ༈ de nas tshogs gtong ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen thugs ka nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ dang om̐ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor bla med spel: tshogs mchod 'dod yon bdud rtsir gyur: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ dharma shud+dhe āḥhūm̐: dang po ni: hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod pho brang nas: dpal chen gsang bdag gtum po la: sprul pa bka' skyong srung mas bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gnyis pa mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi:

gsum pa skong bshags ni: hūm̐: phyi nang spyan gzigs mthun rdzas kyis: gsang bdag lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag sor chud nyes ltung bshags: phyin chad mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: sogs yig brgya brjod: bzhi pa bsgral mchod ni: hūm̐: lcags khang nang du ru tra mngon sum gsal: mchog gsum bden pas dgra bo gzugs la phob: phur thun mtshon cha 'bar bas bsgral gtubs nas: dpal chen gtum po'i lha tshogs zhal du mchod: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: lnga pa lhag ma ni: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan gnas nyul lhag sdud ma: mi sdug gzugs 'chang dur khrod tshogs khang 'grim: sha khrag la dgyes ging chen laṅka srin: lhag ma 'di bzhes gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: om̐ ma tri rak+sha ṇa yak+sha u tsi ta kha kha khā hi: dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen lha tshogs thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i phyi nang 'gal rkyen sol: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs byad zor bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ he ru ka kro ti shrī tsaṇ+ḍa a i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gnyis pa chad mdo gtong ba ni: hūm̐: 'og min gnas dang me ri 'bar ba nas: lha srin sde dpon dregs sdes khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la gsang sngags bstan pa skyongs: ma rungs dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog: om̐ kro ta kro ti he ru ka la yak+sha ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod khams skyong mdzad brtan ma skyong ba'i tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan spras gar sgyur gtor ma longs: 'dzam gling 'di ru bdag gnas yul gru'i tshogs: tshe chos zas nor longs spyod bkra shis spel: om̐ ma ma ting ting rak+mo rak+sha i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa rta bro brdung ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kas:

dam sri bsgral nas rta bro rdung : chem chem dgra bo'i mgo nas rdung : mnan mnan nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ bh+rūm̐ tsakra ya dgra bo nan: lnga pa dngos grub 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: lcang lo can gyi khyab bdag he ru kaḥ bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon dkyil 'khor gyi: dbang bskur sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: lha srin dbang du 'du ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ sa ma ya badz+ra dha ra sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: drug pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: stong nyid snying rjes 'gro ba'i klong la khyab: nges don ma rtogs rmongs gzugs nyon mongs tshogs: sku bzhi'i dbyings thim skye med a ru ldang : a a āḥ bdun pa bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐: nam mkha'i gos can srid gsum lto bar 'gengs: 'bar ba'i pho nya mkha' lding dbyings la 'gyed: rlung zhags 'gengs pa dbu ma'i pho nya rgyu: zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bkra shis shog: brgyad pa bsngo ba smon lam ni: hoḥ bsngo bya ye nas ma grub sbyin gtong bral: bsngo mkhan byed po ma dmigs gnyug ma'i gshis: bsngo 'bras 'khor gsum yongs dag dge ba bsngo: kun kyang sa bcu'i rtser son byang chub shog: ces mi dmigs 'khor gsum yongs dag dge ba bsngo: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug dregs 'dul dkyil 'khor gyi: sgrub pa'i go rim las gzhung don chen bzhag: yang gsang 'di nyid jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis: yi ger bgyis nas zab gsang gter du sbos: yang mtha'i snyigs dus rtsod ldan shar ba'i tshe: rig 'dzin rdo rje'i ming dang 'phrad nas kyang : skal ldan rdo rje las ldan de la sprod: rdo rje gsang bdag zab don-i atsha rgya: rdo rje dbyings kyi bdag pos rgya 'di srungs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kho bo gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes lha rtse brag nas lcags phag lor gdan drangs pa 'di kong po brag gsum rdo rje'i brag nas phyag na rdo rje dregs pa zil gnon gter gnas zung 'jug yin pa ste mdo khams nā ga ko ṭa'i rā dza badz+ra ā yur wā gīs e waṃ du shog ser nas bshus so/

/sarba maṅga laṃ// // ga) dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las: khyab 'jug gtor 'bul byad ma rtsad brlag bzhugs so: rdo rje gtum po rab tu 'bar ba la gus pas 'dud: de yang thun gtor 'bul ba ni: lcags zangs bhan+dha'i snod gang du: dpal gtor g.yas gcus 'khor gsum la: dmar rgyan bcas pas spras nas su: hūm̐ dzaḥ bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i pho brang nas: mngon spyod las mdzad ki kang mi bsrun pa: khyab 'jug chen po 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: dug khrag nag po ngad ldan rlabs su 'phyur: dmar chen gtor ma bcud ldan ri ltar brjid: dgra bgegs don snying nang rol dbang po'i tshogs: drang srong ki kang rgyal po'i zhal du 'bul: sde brgyad stong rtsa brgyad kyi zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs cham la phob: gsang sngags gnyan la gdug pa'i dgra dar na: mthu ldan chos skyong khyed kyis sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ hrīḥrā hu la ki kang hrīḥshag ru raṃ dgra bgegs kyi bla srog la kha raṃ khā hi: rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter ma'o: nga) dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las: skong ba bar chad kun sel bzhugs so: bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas skong ba bya ba'i rim pa ni: phyi nang gsang ba'i nyer mkho mchod rdzas rnams tshang bar bsags shing : yid dmigs ting 'dzin rnam gsum dang ma bral bar g.yo med khyab brdal ye shes chen po'i rnal 'byor gyi ngang nas skong ba bya'o: hūm̐: lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: gtum chen khro rgyal he ru kaḥ gsang bdag dregs pa zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus pa: thugs dam bskang phyir gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam gyi gdan la bzhugs: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: phyi mchod 'dod yon lha mo'i tshogs:

nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dga' ba bzhi: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga: rten gtor rtag gtor thun gtor dang : ga ṇa tshogs kyi longs spyod rdzas: bdud rtsi su ra chang gi phud: spyan gzigs gzugs 'gros sna tshogs pa: blos blangs dngos 'byor yid sprul nas: ma tshang med pa'i bskang rdzas 'dis: gsang bdag gtum po'i thugs dam bskang : ye shes khyung gi thugs dam bskang : gza' mchog rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : gter srung dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bskang ba skye med ngang du bskang : mchod du med de gnyis med mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug sbyor: sgrol du med de dug lnga sgrol: bshags su med de dbyings su bshags: ye mchod ye grol chen po 'dis: thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur cig: phyi nang dam tshig nyams pa sol: las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen zil gnon lha tshogs dgongs: bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur pa'i: nyams chag nyes ltung ci mchis pa: mthol lo bshags so bzod par gsol: om̐ badz+ra sogs? sa twa āḥ sogs yig brgya brjod: rjes shes mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go: mthar tshogs bshags bsgral ba lhag ma phyin chad bya'o: zhes dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags rdo rje'i go cha'i skong bsdus so: sarba maṅga laṃ/ e ka pre tsa// // ca) dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las: smad las pha rol byad ma rgol 'joms bzhugs so: bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang dpal chen gsang bdag gi: las mtha' byad bzlog bstan pa la: lcags snod dam ni gang rung du: ma traṃ dbus su chos 'byung steng : liṅga gzhug cing 'gugs gzhug bya: de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi bri: phyi rol rdo rje me ris bskor:

'bru nag dpal gtor che ba la: chung ba bzhi dang khrag skyus bskor: mdun du gza' gtor g.yas gcus bzhag: rtsang dang zor rdzas mtha' ru bskor: drag po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas: rnga brdung dung 'bud rak+tas bran: sa ma ya: dang po sgrub pa'i lha bskyed ni: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid drag po'i zhing : gtum drag 'byung ba bang rim bsnol mar brtsegs: sa gzhi smug nag dur khrod me dpung klong : bh+rūm̐ las sra mkhregs gnam lcags gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i tog: de dbus nyi zla ti ra bam chen steng : mthing nag hūm̐ las gsang bdag dpal chen sku: mthing nag zhal gsum gdangs shing spyan rtsa g.yo: sma ra smin ma dbu skra me ltar 'bar: bhan+dha skam po'i rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: tshwa tshwa 'khrugs pa'i dar nag cod pan 'phur: dug sbrul rigs lngas skra bcing lhu tshigs brgyan: g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri phyar: za byed rngam pa'i khro bo me ltar 'bar: g.yon gsum khyung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul zhags 'phen: gsod byed khro mo sha za chu ltar khol: stobs bcu'i dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs: zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgegs dpung sa la bsgyil: sku la stong khams sreg pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: 'jigs byed dpa' bo stobs ldan sku ru gsal: spyi bor thugs kyi sprul pa ga ru ṭaḥ lcags ru zangs mchu gser mig sder gshog bgrad: klu dang sa bdag ma rungs zil gyis gnon: mdun du khyab 'jug dud kha dbu dgu pa: phyag bzhi ral gri chu srin mda' gzhu sbrul: sku lus mig brgyan lte zhal sbrul mjug 'khyil: ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal: hūm̐: shar du ban byed 'joms pa'i stag gdong ma: sku mdog dmar nag rngam pa'i nga ro can: phyag g.yas me zor g.yon pas chu zor bsnams: lho ru bon byed 'joms pa'i dred gdong ma: sku mdog kham nag gdug pa'i mche ba gtsigs:

phyag g.yas kong zor g.yon pas thun zor bsnams: nub tu 'dre rgod 'joms pa'i dom gdong ma: sku mdog mthing nag gtum chen drag sngags can: phyag g.yas nyungs zor g.yon pas khram zor bsnams: byang du dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i spyang gdong ma: sku mdog ljang nag sha khrag dgyes pa mo'i: g.yas pas mtshe zor g.yon pas khrag zor bsnams: thams cad gar stabs dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: ha ha dgyes pa'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrog: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha 'joms par gsal: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: gsang bdag khro rgyal lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: 'og min lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: gtum chen khro rgyal lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: dbus phyogs ri rgyal 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas: khyung chen mkha' lding rgyal po gshegs su gsol: nam mkha' dbyings kyi dug rlangs 'tshubs dbus nas: gza' mchog ki kang 'bar ba gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi thod mkhar me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus: srog gcod ma mo rigs bzhi gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas pho brang gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: ye shes sku gsum lha la phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ gsum pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid kyi tshogs: sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs mchod pa bla med 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas byad ma bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe sogs?nas shab+da sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa bstod pa ni: hūm̐: gtum chen khro rgyal gsang bdag he ru kaḥ lha srin dregs pa 'dul ba'i mthu stobs can: ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar gcod pa: thugs mchog khro rgyal sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: spyi bor thugs kyi sprul pa ga ru ṭaḥ gnam lcags rwa ldan rdo rje'i mchu sder bgrad: ma rungs sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul bar byed: bya khyung 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dzaḥ snang srid dbu ma dbyings kyi las byed pa: stong khams 'di ru drag rtsal ldan pa yi: lho nub gnas pa'i ki kang rā hu la: gza' mchog khyab 'jug sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ drag shul rngam pa'i dpa' stobs gar dgus brgyan: snang srid yongs kyi byad kha dgra la 'bebs: las la chas byed srog bdag khro mo'i tshogs: ma rungs rgol ba 'joms mdzad bzhi la bstod: lnga pa bsnyen pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid gtum po'i thugs ka ru: gser gyi mchod rten ser po'i dbus: me long nyi zla 'khor lo'i steng : hūm̐ mthing tshwa tshwa 'phros pa'i mthar: rtsa sngags g.yas su 'khor ba yis: lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bsregs: yar 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mchod: mar 'phros stong gsum dgra bgegs bcom: tshur 'dus srog thim gzi brjid skyed: slar yang khro bo 'khor la phog: rab 'phros pha rol byad kha bzlog: kun kyang gzi brjid 'bar bar bsgom: gtum chen sngags phreng ni: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ khyung sngags ni: om̐ khroṃ raṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ khyab 'jug gi sngags ni: om̐ ki kang hrīḥrā hu la ke sha ke ta hūm̐ dza dzaḥ khro mo'i sngags ni: oṃ kro ti raṃ bh+yo tsa tur mu kha tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces gtum po'i sngags rtags ma byung bar du bzla: khyung dang khyab 'jug de'i bcu cha tsam: khro mo las rung ni khri yis chog: byad bzlog zor thun gyi sngags ni: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa he kro ta kā la sa ha tsakra lo hi tsakra ti tri tsakra ya gnod byed 'byung po byad ma rnams kyi srog rtsa la rbad rbad: om̐ kri ti ma tri baṃ bh+yo tsa tur mu kha ram̐ ha la ya: pha rol gyi byad zor phur kha ngan pa thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

zlog sngags ni: hūm̐ trig rā dza ya thun bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yoḥ dgra la zlog: raṃ ha la mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yoḥ dgra la zlog: trag ha la nā ga ye bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yoḥ dgra la zlog: shag rak+ta rbad tri ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yoḥ dgra la zlog: mā ra ya rbad thun bh+yo rak+sha bh+yoḥ zhes bzlog thun gyi char phab pas pha rol byad ma rdul du brlags nas ming yang med par bsam: sa ma ya: de nas bsad pa'i las la 'jug pa ni: mdun du gser skyems gtsang bshos: hom khung nang du nya bo dang : g.yab dar bya rog 'ug pa'i sgro: mtshon cha thun rdzas bsgral chas bsag: sngags 'chang nga rgyal dang ldan pas: gzu dpang mkhyen par gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum dang yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong srung ma bcas: khyad par dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs dang : sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol: bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shing : dben par bla ma lha dang yi dam gyi: bsnyen sgrub bskyed sngags rdzogs gsum gzhir bzung nas: phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par dam bcas kyang : gnod byed dam med 'di yis mi ster ro: dgongs shig kun mkhyen khyed kyis gzigs mdzod la: bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma sgrol: mthu rtsal nus phyungs mngon spyod phrin las mdzod:

gser skyems rim par 'thor: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : sgyu 'phrul zhi khro rab 'byams dregs 'dul tshogs: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: khyad par dpal chen phyag na rdo rje dang : mkha' lding khyab 'jug khro mo rigs bzhi yis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: dpal chen chos srung dam can srung ma'i tshogs: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad yul bdag gnas: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: mkha' la rgyu ba'i dregs ldan 'khor bcas kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: rbad pa'i dam can srung ma mthu ma chung : deng 'dir bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hom bskyed ni: phaṭḥ mdun du gnam lcags las grub pa'i btson khang nag po kha dog la: mthil yangs pa: zin na thar pa med pa: nṛ tri las skyes pa'i gnod byed byad ma'i gzugs phung sngo la ham pa skya la rid pa kha ngu ba mig shi mig: yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams shing nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gyur: na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du yang dpal chen phyag na rdo rje dregs 'dul drag sngags kyi bka' bden pa dang : thugs sprul bya khyung 'bar ba'i bka' bden pa dang : gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu'i bka' bden pa dang : bka' sdod dregs tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi bka' bden pa dang : lha sngags ting 'dzin rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : rnal 'byor bdag gi drag sngags dmod pa'i mthu la brten nas: gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs dam sri byad phur mnan gtad ngan sngags byed pa'i dgra gdon mi dang mi min spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra:

dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra: sgos rnal 'byor pa bdag la sdang ba: mdor na bsam sbyor ngan pa 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong dam log bdud rigs bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i lha srung mgon byed dang bcas pa thams cad: skad cig rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cig: nṛ tri yaṃ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas 'gugs shing pho nya 'gyed pa ni: bh+yoḥ dzaḥlas rdo rje lcags kyu ma: dgra bo'i snying nas zungs la shog: hūm̐ las rin chen zhags pa ma: dgra bo'i mgul nas chings la shog: baṃ las pad+ma lcags sgrog ma: dgra bo'i yan lag sdoms la shog: hoḥlas karma dril bu ma: dgra bo'i dran pa myos su chug: rang dbang med par khug la shog: rbad pa'i pho nya mthu ma chung : badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ pā sha hoḥ s+pho ṭa baṃḥ ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ lha dbye bya ba ni bya rog 'ug sgro thogs la: hūm̐: khā kha mu kha bya rog gdong : phyag na spu gri dmar po bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo lha dang phyes: srung skyob mgon byed phral bar gyis: hu lu mu kha 'ug pa'i mgo: phyag na rlung gi 'khor lo 'dzin: dam nyams dgra bo bdud dang sprod: bcings shing byad du bcug par gyis: om̐ khā kha mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: hu lu mu kha dgra bo rbad thum ril trig nan mā ra ya rbad: de nas phur pa thogs la: hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa'i sras: gtum chen badz+ra kī la ya'i: phyag gnyis ri rab phur pa bsgril: rgya mdud 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: 'chang bzung glog dmar khyugs se khyug: chu srin ser ba chi li li: zur gsum thog rgod sha ra ra: rtse mor tshwa tshwa si li li: btab bo badz+ra kī la ya: dkar nag snying gi rtsa chod la: myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya gnod byed 'byung po tshal pa shag gtub mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces pas bsgral zhing rnam shes spar: 'o khyod kyi rnam shes āḥyig dkar por gyur nas 'og min gyi gnas su phaṭḥ

ces pas 'og min gyi gnas su 'phang : de nas thun rdzas btab cing : hūm̐: nyungs thun khro bo sha ra ra: dug thun bu yug chi li li: me thun dmar nag lhabs se lhab: khrag thun nad rlangs thibs se thib: rdo thun zi ra khyugs se khyug: mtshe thun las rlung 'u ru ru: rdo rje'i thog rgod sha ra ra: phur thun drag po hri li li: ral gri mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ myog thun tshal pa ya shig shig: ces pas gtubs shing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gtum chen khro rgyal he ru kaḥ dpal chen phyag rdor lha tshogs kyi: zhal phyes dgra bo'i sha khrag 'bul: dug lnga skye med dbyings su rol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: zhes phul byad ma dgra bgegs dngos su gsol bar bsam: sa ma ya: de nas zlog thabs bstan pa ni: dmar gtor liṅga lha grangs bshams: 'gugs gzhug drag po lan gsum bya: rkang gling rol mo dar nag g.yab: sha chen gsur btang rak+tas bran: hūm̐: 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: dpal chen phyag rdor dregs pa zil gnon pa: gtum chen drag po'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dmag dpung skyed la bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gtum chen khro rgyal rab 'jigs he ru kaḥ sku mdog mthing nag chos sku 'gyur ba med: dkar dmar mthing bzhad dgyes la khro ba yis: sku gsum sgrib pa'i nyon mongs dgra la zlog: rab 'jigs zhal nas hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: ye shes khro bo'i drag sngags dgra la zlog: spyan rtsa sdang mig glog ltar 'khyugs pa yis: 'jig rten khro bo'i dmod pa dgra la zlog: dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzis pa yis: lha khams yom zhing 'gul ba'i ltas ngan zlog: thod skam rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa yis: rigs lnga'i sa lam bar chad dgra la zlog:

dar nag cod pan rgyan 'phyang 'phur ba yis: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i sun ma dgra la zlog: phyag g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri yis: snang srid lha 'dres zil gnon dgra la zlog: phyag g.yon khyung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul zhags kyis: srid gsum gdon bgegs 'byung po dgra la zlog: rdo rje'i sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs pa yis: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha dgra la zlog: glang ko zhing lpags stag sham brjid pa yis: nyon mongs dug lnga'i 'khrul 'dzin dgra la zlog: rdo rje'i go khrab rus rgyan chu srin gyis: bdud srin dam sri 'gong po dgra la zlog: sbrul gdugs rgyan phreng rin chen spras pa yis: 'khor 'das rtog pas zil gnon dgra la zlog: zhabs bzhi lha srin steng du 'gyings pa yis: che btsan kun gyis zil gnon dgra la zlog: sku la dus mtha'i me dpung 'bar ba yis: stong khams yom zhing 'khrug pa dgra la zlog: bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon lha tshogs kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad zor bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: spyi bor thugs kyi sprul pa ga ru ṭaraḥ gnam lcags rwa ldan rdo rje'i mchu sder bgrad: ma rungs klu gnyan sa bdag bzlog tu gsol: me gshog rdeb cing gser mig 'khyil ba yis: dregs pa yongs kyi cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: dug sbrul gsol zhing gdol pa 'dzin pa yis: bdud dang klu srin ma rungs bzlog tu gsol: bya khyung rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa yis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad zor bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: dzaḥ snang srid dbu ma dbyings kyi las byed pa: lho nub gnas pa'i klu srin rā hu la: sku mdog dud kha dbu dgu bya rog mgos: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ru tra bzlog tu gsol: phyag g.yas ral gri gnam lcags thog mda' yis: ma rungs dgra bgegs 'byung po bzlog tu gsol: phyag g.yon rgyal mtshan sbrul nag zhags pa yis:

bdag la sdang ba'i byad ma bzlog tu gsol: sku lus thams cad mig gis brgyan pa yis: dregs pa yongs kyi byad zor bzlog tu gsol: lte ba srid pa'i zhal gdangs khros pa yis: nyon mongs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzlog tu gsol: sbrul mjug rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khyil ba yis: 'byung lnga'i tsha grang 'thab pa bzlog tu gsol: rdzu 'phrul gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs pa yis: bdud sdes mtshon char 'bebs pa bzlog tu gsol: drang srong gza' mchog rgyal po'i lha tshogs kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad zor bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ thod mkhar dmar nag me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus: khrag mtsho nyi zla bam gyi gdan gyi steng : shar du stag gdong dmar nag rngam pa yis: ban de'i byad zor phur kha bzlog tu gsol: lho ru dred gdong kham nag khros pa yis: bon po'i byad zor mdzo dmar bzlog tu gsol: nub tu dom gdong mthing nag gtum pa yis: 'dre rgod 'byung po'i byad zor bzlog tu gsol: byang du spyang gdong ljang nag dgyes pa yis: pha rol dgra bo'i byad zor bzlog tu gsol: g.yas g.yon phyag na zor chen 'phen pa yis: byad zor phur kha 'bebs pa bzlog tu gsol: thams cad gar stabs dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: dur khrod ma mo'i khrag nad bzlog tu gsol: ha ha dgyes pa'i gad mo sgrog pa yis: pha rol gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol: las byed srog bdag khro mo sde bzhi yis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs rgol ba 'joms pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags bzlog tu gsol: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags bzlog tu gsol: yi dam mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad bzlog tu gsol: sde brgyad dregs pa'i pho nya bzlog tu gsol: phyogs skyong bcu yi dmod pa bzlog tu gsol: gling bzhi skye bo'i mda' zor bzlog tu gsol:

yugs sa bud med dmod zor bzlog tu gsol: 'dre rgod 'byung po'i glags lta bzlog tu gsol: yul lha gzhi bdag cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol: ma bdud srin mo'i bla rkun bzlog tu gsol: ban de sngags pa'i hoṃ sbar bzlog tu gsol: g.yung drung bon gyi mthu gtad bzlog tu gsol: drag sngags sna tshogs sbyor ba bzlog tu gsol: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs bzlog tu gsol: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rigs bzlog tu gsol: tshe 'phrang bdud kyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chod bzlog tu gsol: bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma'i dbal gyis zlog: bsgyur ro zhing bcu tshang ba dgra la sgyur: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong dang bcas pa mā ra ya rbad rbad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces dgra bgegs byad ma yul mkhar rjes med du brlags par bsam: sa ma ya: drag po'i rtsang bzlog bya ba ni: rak+ta mchod cing 'di skad gyer: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: pho nya rtsang gi lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: las mkhan shan pas bzlog bsgyur dus la bab: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: rno dbal zhe sdang drag po'i rtsang phur 'di: chos skyong dam can pho nya 'tshogs pa'i gnas: che chung tshad ni ri rab 'bar ba tsam: mang nyung tshad ni bskal pa'i bye ma tsam: mtho dman tshad ni srid gsum dbyings dang mnyam: rno ngar tshad ni bdun 'gyur chu gri tsam: myur mgyogs tshad ni ki kang 'gyu ba'i gzugs: gtum drag tshad ni gsod byed gshin rje rngam: rtse mor hūm̐ las me ri wa la la: sked par bh+yo yig dam can 'tshogs pa'i gnas: rtsa bar dzaḥyig mun pa thibs se thib: las kyi pho nya rngam pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: pha rol byad ma rbod gtong rtsang gis zlog:

hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: lha srin 'khrugs pa'i cho 'phrul zlog: gza' dang lha srin bar chod zlog: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs zlog: bzlog bzlog phyi nang bar chad zlog: bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: rbad myog shag thum baṃ ril mā ra ya zlog zlog: ces phrin las bcol zhing khro tshogs rnams kyis bzlog pa'i las mdzad par bsam: sa ma ya: dang po sgo'i phyi ru gser skyems sbrengs nas dar nag gzengs shing khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis 'di skad do: hūm̐: phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: yi dam zhi khro mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang : dam can gter srung myur mgyogs pho nya rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: lha srin sde brgyad gzhi bdag drag rtsal can: mkha' la rgyu zhing gdong la gnas pa dang : lo zla zhag dus chu tshod dbang ba rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir drag po gtor ma'i zor lam phyes: gdong du ma sdod g.yas g.yon sku gzur la: ma rungs dam nyams dgra la zor sna drongs: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas gser skyems 'thor zhing sgo dbye bya ba ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs sgo ma lcags kyu mas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang shar sgo phyes: dmag dpung bskyed cing bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: lho phyogs sgo ma zhags pa mas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang lho sgo phyes: dmag dpung bskyed cing bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: nub phyogs sgo ma lcags sgrog mas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la:

drag po'i pho brang nub sgo phyes: dmag dpung bskyed cing bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: byang phyogs sgo ma dril bu mas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang byang sgo phyes: dmag dpung bskyed cing bzhes su gsol: ces sgo phye zhing phrin las bcol: de nas zor bskul bya ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon thugs rje'i klong nas bzhengs: dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor: rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: zor sna sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces yi dam pho rgyud mo rgyud chos skyong dang bcas pas bdag gi grogs mdzad par bsam: de nas khro mo rigs bzhi'i zor rnams rim par thogs la: bh+yoḥ shar du ban byed 'joms pa'i stag gdong ma: sku mdog dmar nag rngam pa'i nga ro can: phyag g.yas me zor g.yon pas chu zor 'dzin: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rnams: rdul du brlags nas rjes shul med par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo ma tri mu kha ye ha la byad ma bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: bh+yoḥ lho ru bon byed 'joms pa'i dred gdong ma: sku mdog kham nag gdug pa'i mche ba gtsigs: phyag g.yas kong zor g.yon pas thun zor bsnams: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rnams: rdul du brlags nas rjes shul med par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo ma tri mu kha ye ha la byad ma bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: bh+yoḥ nub tu 'dre rgod 'joms pa'i dom gdong ma: sku mdog mthing nag gtum pa'i drag sngags can: g.yas pas nyungs zor g.yon pas khram zor 'phen: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rnams: rdul du brlags nas rjes shul med par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo ma tri mu kha ye ha la byad ma bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: bh+yoḥ byang du dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i spyang gdong ma: sku mdog ljang nag sha khrag dgyes pa mo:

g.yas pas mtshe zor g.yon pas khrag zor 'phen: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rnams: rdul du brlags nas rjes shul med par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo ma tri mu kha ye ha la byad ma bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

ces 'phang ngo : de nas zor chen thogs la: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings nas khro rgyal lha tshogs bzhengs: deng 'dir bdag gi rgyab rten phrin las bskul: sangs rgyas bstan dgra dam nyams byad ma la: drag po'i dmar nag zor chen snying la ya: bsad cing rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ byad ma 'byung po 'dre rgod snying la mā ra ya rbad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces dgra phyogs su 'phang ngo : de nas dgongs gsol bya ba ni: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: gzigs su gsol lo: gsan du gsol lo: hoḥ 'og min chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing khams nas: zhi khro 'dus pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: rang byung lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: dpal chen phyag na rdo rje dregs pa zil gnon gyi lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: dbus phyogs ri rab 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas: sprul pa'i mkha' lding khyung chen 'bar ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: snang srid dbu ma dbyings kyi pho brang nas: gza' mchog dug gdong 'bar ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: drag shul rngam brjid rol pa'i dur khrod nas: sha za khro mo rigs bzhi'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: gaṅgā rba klong 'khrugs pa'i gnas mchog nas: gter srung klu yi dge bsnyen dang : gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo: hoḥ zhing bcu tshang ba'i bstan pa'i spyi dgra: dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra: rnal 'byor pa bdag la tshad btsugs shing ya bo 'dzin pa: dmag sna rkun sna ston pa'i dgra bo byad ma: ngo log rgyab ston byed pa: bka' las 'gal zhing dam las log pa: mi med lha med zer ba: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba: brnag pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di: lo zla zhag dus ma bzhag par drag po bka' yi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes shig: rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: om̐ badz+ra ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa ga ru ṭa rā hu la tri dgra bo byad ma mā ra ya rbad rbad chings chings nan nan:

zhes dar nag g.yab cing phrin las bcol: brtan ma skyong la gtor bro brdung : dmag dpon khyung gis sgab 'dre bcad: nang du log la tshe 'gugs bya: gtang rag tshogs mchod rten 'brel legs par brtag: bkra shis bsngo smon bgyid cing mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: phyi rabs skal ldan las can rnams kyi don: byad zor ltas ngan log lta bzlog pa'i ched: dus mtha'i sngags pa dug sbrul 'dra ba yis: dregs pa bsgrubs nas chos pa kun la 'tshe: de phyir ma rungs de dag rnams la bsngags: smad las zab mo pha rol rgol 'joms rgya: shes rab snying rje can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: 7o rgyan gter bdag gling pa'i zab gter nyid cung zad dkrugs bsdebs bgyis te rong smyon pas spel ba dge'o// //
